`CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(gexec LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if (MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W3 /wd4100 /wd4200 /wd4201)
    add_definitions(-D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()

# core interpreter, built as a static lib. embedders pick this up or copy
# src/ + include/ into their driver project directly.
add_library(gexec STATIC
    src/loader.c
    src/verify.c
    src/exec.c
)
target_include_directories(gexec PUBLIC include)

# text assembler:  .gasm -> .gmod
add_executable(gasm tools/gasm/gasm.c)
target_include_directories(gasm PRIVATE include)

# module inspector
add_executable(gmodinfo tools/gmodinfo/gmodinfo.c)
target_include_directories(gmodinfo PRIVATE include)

# x86-64 PE lifter (uses vendored Zydis)
add_subdirectory(tools/gvmlift)

# user-mode runner: loads a .gmod, runs it, prints results
add_executable(gexec-run
    examples/um-runner/main.c
    examples/um-runner/host_um.c
)
target_link_libraries(gexec-run PRIVATE gexec)
target_include_directories(gexec-run PRIVATE include examples/um-runner)

```

`README.md`:

```md
# gexec

Register-machine bytecode interpreter for Windows kernel drivers. No JIT.
with a text assembler (`gasm`), x86-64 PE lifter (`gvmlift`), needs alot of work still thinkin remill but discarded project.

## Build

```
cmake -S . -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64
cmake --build build --config Release
```

## Run

```
build\gasm.exe modules\fib.gasm fib.gmod
build\gexec-run.exe fib.gmod fib 10
```

Lift a PE:

```
build\gvmlift.exe input.exe out.gmod
build\gmodinfo.exe out.gmod
```

## Embed

Add `src/loader.c`, `src/verify.c`, `src/exec.c` and `include/` to your
driver. Provide a host table (see `examples/km-driver/host_kernel.c`).

```c
#include <gexec/gexec.h>

gexec_module* mod;
char err[128];
gexec_load(bytes, size, &mod, err, sizeof err);
gexec_verify(mod, err, sizeof err);

gexec_ctx ctx = { .mod = mod, .fuel = GEXEC_DEFAULT_FUEL };
int fn = gexec_find_export(mod, "run");
uint64_t rv = gexec_call(&ctx, (uint32_t)fn, NULL, 0);
gexec_free(mod);
```

## Bytecode

- Register machine, 256 x u64 per function
- 16-byte fixed instructions
- Packed x86 EFLAGS in a nominated register
- v128 as adjacent register pairs
- SEH: TRY / FILTER / CATCH / FINALLY / RAISE
- ~180 opcodes: int/float arith, bitwise, cmov, setcc, mem load/store,
  lea, memcpy/memset/rep_movs, direct/indirect call, host_call, atomics

Full spec in `include/gexec/gir.h`.

## Credits

Zydis by Florian Bernd and Joel Hoener. https://github.com/zyantific/zydis (MIT).

## License

MIT.

```

`examples/km-driver/driver.c`:

```c
/* driver.c - DriverEntry */
#include <ntddk.h>
#include <gexec/gexec.h>
#include "km_ioctl.h"

extern NTSTATUS gexec_table_init(void);
extern void     gexec_table_teardown(void);
extern NTSTATUS gexec_ioctl_load  (PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp);
extern NTSTATUS gexec_ioctl_call  (PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp);
extern NTSTATUS gexec_ioctl_unload(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp);
extern NTSTATUS gexec_ioctl_list  (PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp);
extern NTSTATUS gexec_ioctl_info  (PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp);

static UNICODE_STRING g_devname = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\Device\\gexec");
static UNICODE_STRING g_symlink = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\DosDevices\\gexec");
static PDEVICE_OBJECT g_devobj  = NULL;

/* embedders point this at their own logging channel (etw, dbg-ring, etc). */
void
host_log(const char* fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vDbgPrintExWithPrefix("[gexec] ", DPFLTR_IHVDRIVER_ID, DPFLTR_INFO_LEVEL, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
}

static NTSTATUS
dispatch_devctl(PDEVICE_OBJECT dev, PIRP irp)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(dev);
    PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp = IoGetCurrentIrpStackLocation(irp);
    NTSTATUS st = STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_REQUEST;

    switch (sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.IoControlCode) {
    case IOCTL_GEXEC_LOAD:   st = gexec_ioctl_load(irp, sp);   break;
    case IOCTL_GEXEC_CALL:   st = gexec_ioctl_call(irp, sp);   break;
    case IOCTL_GEXEC_UNLOAD: st = gexec_ioctl_unload(irp, sp); break;
    case IOCTL_GEXEC_LIST:   st = gexec_ioctl_list(irp, sp);   break;
    case IOCTL_GEXEC_INFO:   st = gexec_ioctl_info(irp, sp);   break;
    default: break;
    }

    irp->IoStatus.Status = st;
    IoCompleteRequest(irp, IO_NO_INCREMENT);
    return st;
}

static NTSTATUS
dispatch_pass(PDEVICE_OBJECT dev, PIRP irp)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(dev);
    irp->IoStatus.Status = STATUS_SUCCESS;
    irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
    IoCompleteRequest(irp, IO_NO_INCREMENT);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

static VOID
DriverUnload(PDRIVER_OBJECT drv)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(drv);
    IoDeleteSymbolicLink(&g_symlink);
    if (g_devobj) IoDeleteDevice(g_devobj);
    gexec_table_teardown();
}

NTSTATUS
DriverEntry(PDRIVER_OBJECT drv, PUNICODE_STRING reg)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(reg);

    NTSTATUS st = gexec_table_init();
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(st)) return st;

    st = IoCreateDevice(drv, 0, &g_devname, FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, 0, FALSE, &g_devobj);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(st)) { gexec_table_teardown(); return st; }

    st = IoCreateSymbolicLink(&g_symlink, &g_devname);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(st)) { IoDeleteDevice(g_devobj); gexec_table_teardown(); return st; }

    drv->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CREATE]         = dispatch_pass;
    drv->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CLOSE]          = dispatch_pass;
    drv->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL] = dispatch_devctl;
    drv->DriverUnload                          = DriverUnload;

    host_log("driver loaded");
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

```

`examples/km-driver/host_kernel.c`:

```c
/* host_kernel.c - host function table */
#include <gexec/gexec.h>
#include <intrin.h>

#define CAP_ALLOC       (1u << 0)
#define CAP_READ_KMEM   (1u << 1)
#define CAP_WRITE_KMEM  (1u << 2)
#define CAP_MSR_READ    (1u << 3)
#define CAP_MSR_WRITE   (1u << 4)
#define CAP_PHYSMEM     (1u << 5)
#define CAP_CPUID_TSC   (1u << 6)
#define CAP_CALLBACKS   (1u << 7)
#define CAP_HOSTCALL    (1u << 8)
#define CAP_INTROSPECT  (1u << 9)

extern void host_log(const char* fmt, ...);

static void
set_trap(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint32_t code, const char* msg)
{
    ctx->trap = code;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; i++) {
        char c = msg[i]; ctx->trap_msg[i] = c; if (!c) break;
    }
    ctx->trap_msg[sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1] = 0;
}

static int
guest_range_ok(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint64_t addr, uint32_t len)
{
    uint64_t end = addr + len;
    return (end >= addr) && (end <= ctx->mod->mem_size);
}

static int
kva_ok(uint64_t addr, uint32_t len)
{
    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() > APC_LEVEL) return 0;
    uint64_t end = addr + len;
    if (end < addr) return 0;
    uint64_t hi = addr >> 48;
    if (hi != 0x0000 && hi != 0xFFFF) return 0;
    for (uint64_t p = addr & ~0xFFFull; p < end; p += 0x1000ull) {
        if (!MmIsAddressValid((PVOID)(uintptr_t)p)) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static uint64_t
h_io_log(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc)
{
    if (argc < 2) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "log argc"); return 0; }
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)a[0];
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)a[1];
    if (len > 512) len = 512;
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, off, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "log oob"); return 0; }

    char buf[520];
    RtlCopyMemory(buf, ctx->mod->mem + off, len);
    buf[len] = 0;
    host_log("%s", buf);
    return 0;
}

static uint64_t
h_mem_base(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctx->mod->mem;
}

static uint64_t
h_mem_size(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return ctx->mod->mem_size;
}

static uint64_t
h_mem_alloc(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    SIZE_T sz = (SIZE_T)a[0];
    if (sz == 0 || sz > (16u << 20)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "alloc size"); return 0; }
    PVOID p = ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, sz, 'oMxG');
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p;
}

static uint64_t
h_mem_free(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (a[0]) ExFreePoolWithTag((PVOID)(uintptr_t)a[0], 'oMxG');
    return 0;
}

static uint64_t
h_k_read8(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 1)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "read8 addr"); return 0; }
    return *(volatile uint8_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0];
}
static uint64_t
h_k_read16(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 2)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "read16 addr"); return 0; }
    return *(volatile uint16_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0];
}
static uint64_t
h_k_read32(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 4)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "read32 addr"); return 0; }
    return *(volatile uint32_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0];
}
static uint64_t
h_k_read64(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 8)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "read64 addr"); return 0; }
    return *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0];
}

static uint64_t
h_k_write8(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 1)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "write8 addr"); return 0; }
    *(volatile uint8_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0] = (uint8_t)a[1]; return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_k_write16(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 2)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "write16 addr"); return 0; }
    *(volatile uint16_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0] = (uint16_t)a[1]; return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_k_write32(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 4)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "write32 addr"); return 0; }
    *(volatile uint32_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0] = (uint32_t)a[1]; return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_k_write64(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (!kva_ok(a[0], 8)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "write64 addr"); return 0; }
    *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)a[0] = a[1]; return 0;
}

/* copy bytes from a kernel VA into the guest linear memory. */
static uint64_t
h_k_read_bytes(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint64_t kva = a[0];
    uint32_t goff = (uint32_t)a[1];
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)a[2];
    if (len == 0) return 0;
    if (len > (1u << 20)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "read_bytes size"); return 0; }
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, goff, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "read_bytes goff"); return 0; }
    if (!kva_ok(kva, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "read_bytes kva"); return 0; }
    RtlCopyMemory(ctx->mod->mem + goff, (const void*)(uintptr_t)kva, len);
    return len;
}

static uint64_t
h_k_write_bytes(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint64_t kva = a[0];
    uint32_t goff = (uint32_t)a[1];
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)a[2];
    if (len == 0) return 0;
    if (len > (1u << 20)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "write_bytes size"); return 0; }
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, goff, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "write_bytes goff"); return 0; }
    if (!kva_ok(kva, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "write_bytes kva"); return 0; }
    RtlCopyMemory((void*)(uintptr_t)kva, ctx->mod->mem + goff, len);
    return len;
}

static uint64_t
h_proc_pid(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)PsGetCurrentProcessId();
}
static uint64_t
h_proc_tid(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)PsGetCurrentThreadId();
}
static uint64_t
h_proc_irql(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return KeGetCurrentIrql();
}

static uint64_t
h_cpu_rdtsc(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return __rdtsc();
}
static uint64_t
h_cpu_cpuid(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    int leaf    = (int)(uint32_t)a[0];
    int subleaf = (int)(uint32_t)a[1];
    uint32_t goff = (uint32_t)a[2];  /* out buffer, 16 bytes */
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, goff, 16)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "cpuid out"); return 0; }
    int r[4] = {0};
    __cpuidex(r, leaf, subleaf);
    RtlCopyMemory(ctx->mod->mem + goff, r, 16);
    return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_msr_read(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return __readmsr((unsigned long)a[0]);
}
static uint64_t
h_msr_write(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    __writemsr((unsigned long)a[0], a[1]); return 0;
}

/* resolve an nt export by name. reads a UTF-8 name out of guest memory,
 * builds a UNICODE_STRING, calls MmGetSystemRoutineAddress. returns 0 on
 * miss so guests can branch. */
static uint64_t
h_nt_resolve(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint32_t goff = (uint32_t)a[0];
    uint32_t len  = (uint32_t)a[1];
    if (len == 0 || len > 128) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "resolve len"); return 0; }
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, goff, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "resolve name"); return 0; }

    WCHAR wbuf[130];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; i++) wbuf[i] = ctx->mod->mem[goff + i];
    wbuf[len] = 0;
    UNICODE_STRING us;
    us.Buffer = wbuf;
    us.Length = (USHORT)(len * sizeof(WCHAR));
    us.MaximumLength = (USHORT)((len + 1) * sizeof(WCHAR));
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)MmGetSystemRoutineAddress(&us);
}

/* call a resolved kernel function with up to 4 uint64 args. thin FFI for
 * the common case of calling nt/hal exports. */
static uint64_t
h_nt_invoke(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    if (argc < 2) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "invoke argc"); return 0; }
    uint64_t fnv = a[0];
    if (!fnv) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "invoke null"); return 0; }
    unsigned n = (unsigned)a[1];
    if (n > 4) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "invoke max 4 args"); return 0; }
    if (argc < 2 + n) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "invoke short args"); return 0; }
    typedef uint64_t (*fn0_t)(void);
    typedef uint64_t (*fn1_t)(uint64_t);
    typedef uint64_t (*fn2_t)(uint64_t, uint64_t);
    typedef uint64_t (*fn3_t)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
    typedef uint64_t (*fn4_t)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
    switch (n) {
    case 0: return ((fn0_t)(uintptr_t)fnv)();
    case 1: return ((fn1_t)(uintptr_t)fnv)(a[2]);
    case 2: return ((fn2_t)(uintptr_t)fnv)(a[2], a[3]);
    case 3: return ((fn3_t)(uintptr_t)fnv)(a[2], a[3], a[4]);
    case 4: return ((fn4_t)(uintptr_t)fnv)(a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* memory copy / zero */

static uint64_t
h_mem_copy(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint32_t dst = (uint32_t)a[0], src = (uint32_t)a[1], len = (uint32_t)a[2];
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, dst, len) || !guest_range_ok(ctx, src, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "mem_copy oob"); return 0; }
    RtlMoveMemory(ctx->mod->mem + dst, ctx->mod->mem + src, len);
    return len;
}
static uint64_t
h_mem_zero(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)a[0], len = (uint32_t)a[1];
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, off, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "mem_zero oob"); return 0; }
    RtlZeroMemory(ctx->mod->mem + off, len);
    return len;
}
static uint64_t
h_mem_fill(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)a[0], len = (uint32_t)a[1];
    uint8_t val = (uint8_t)a[2];
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, off, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "mem_fill oob"); return 0; }
    RtlFillMemory(ctx->mod->mem + off, len, val);
    return len;
}

/* kernel-va copy / zero / probe */

static uint64_t
h_k_copy(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint64_t dst = a[0], src = a[1], len = a[2];
    if (len > (16u << 20)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "k_copy size"); return 0; }
    if (!kva_ok(dst, (uint32_t)len) || !kva_ok(src, (uint32_t)len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "k_copy"); return 0; }
    RtlMoveMemory((void*)(uintptr_t)dst, (const void*)(uintptr_t)src, (size_t)len);
    return len;
}
static uint64_t
h_k_zero(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint64_t dst = a[0], len = a[1];
    if (len > (16u << 20)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "k_zero size"); return 0; }
    if (!kva_ok(dst, (uint32_t)len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED, "k_zero"); return 0; }
    RtlZeroMemory((void*)(uintptr_t)dst, (size_t)len);
    return len;
}
static uint64_t
h_k_probe(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return kva_ok(a[0], (uint32_t)a[1]) ? 1 : 0;
}

/* threading / synchronization */

static uint64_t
h_thread_sleep_100ns(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    LARGE_INTEGER li; li.QuadPart = -(int64_t)a[0];
    KeDelayExecutionThread(KernelMode, FALSE, &li);
    return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_thread_yield(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    LARGE_INTEGER li; li.QuadPart = 0;
    KeDelayExecutionThread(KernelMode, FALSE, &li);
    return 0;
}

/* spin lock primitives. lock lives in guest memory at a given offset (must
 * be 8-byte aligned). guest owns lifetime; we just do the interlocked ops.
 * ANY thread that holds the lock must call release before yielding to APCs. */
static uint64_t
h_lock_spin_acquire(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)a[0];
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, off, 8) || (off & 7)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_ALIGNMENT, "spin lock addr"); return 0; }
    volatile LONG64* lock = (volatile LONG64*)(ctx->mod->mem + off);
    while (InterlockedCompareExchange64(lock, 1, 0) != 0) YieldProcessor();
    return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_lock_spin_release(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)a[0];
    if (!guest_range_ok(ctx, off, 8) || (off & 7)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_ALIGNMENT, "spin lock addr"); return 0; }
    volatile LONG64* lock = (volatile LONG64*)(ctx->mod->mem + off);
    InterlockedExchange64(lock, 0);
    return 0;
}

/* IRQL management. only allowed while a call is on a passive/APC context. */
static uint64_t
h_irql_get(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return KeGetCurrentIrql();
}
static uint64_t
h_irql_raise_to_dispatch(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() > APC_LEVEL) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "irql already elevated"); return 0; }
    KIRQL old;
    KeRaiseIrql(DISPATCH_LEVEL, &old);
    return old;
}
static uint64_t
h_irql_lower(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    KIRQL old = (KIRQL)a[0];
    KeLowerIrql(old);
    return 0;
}

/* process/thread lookup */

static uint64_t
h_proc_by_pid(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    PEPROCESS ep = NULL;
    NTSTATUS s = PsLookupProcessByProcessId((HANDLE)(uintptr_t)a[0], &ep);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(s)) return 0;
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep;
}
static uint64_t
h_proc_deref(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (a[0]) ObDereferenceObject((PVOID)(uintptr_t)a[0]);
    return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_proc_eprocess_current(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)PsGetCurrentProcess();
}
static uint64_t
h_thread_ethread_current(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)PsGetCurrentThread();
}

/* image / module bases */
static uint64_t
h_image_of_kva(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ctx); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    /* linear scan of PsLoadedModuleList could be added; v1 punts by
     * returning the input aligned down to page. real driver code that
     * needs image base should walk PsLoadedModuleList manually. */
    return a[0] & ~0xFFFull;
}

static uint64_t
h_seh_last_code(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return ctx->last_exception_code;
}
static uint64_t
h_seh_last_addr(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(a); UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    return ctx->last_exception_addr;
}

/* segment base setters. guest calls these before invoking lifted code that
 * uses FSLOAD/GSLOAD so the interpreter can compute effective addresses. */
static uint64_t
h_seg_set_fsbase(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (ctx->top == 0) return 0;
    gexec_frame* f = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
    uint64_t* regs = &ctx->mod->reg_stack[f->reg_base];
    if (f->fn->n_regs <= GIR_REG_FSBASE) return 0;
    regs[GIR_REG_FSBASE] = a[0];
    return 0;
}
static uint64_t
h_seg_set_gsbase(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(argc);
    if (ctx->top == 0) return 0;
    gexec_frame* f = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
    uint64_t* regs = &ctx->mod->reg_stack[f->reg_base];
    if (f->fn->n_regs <= GIR_REG_GSBASE) return 0;
    regs[GIR_REG_GSBASE] = a[0];
    return 0;
}

static int
name_eq(const char* a, const char* b)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GIR_NAME_LEN; i++) {
        if (a[i] != b[i]) return 0;
        if (a[i] == 0) return 1;
    }
    return 1;
}

const gexec_host_entry*
gexec_host_lookup(const char* name)
{
    if (!name) return NULL;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(g_hosts) / sizeof(g_hosts[0]); i++) {
        if (name_eq(g_hosts[i].name, name)) return &g_hosts[i];
    }
    return NULL;
}

uint32_t
gexec_host_count(void)
{
    return (uint32_t)(sizeof(g_hosts) / sizeof(g_hosts[0]));
}

const gexec_host_entry*
gexec_host_by_index(uint32_t idx)
{
    if (idx >= gexec_host_count()) return NULL;
    return &g_hosts[idx];
}

```

`examples/km-driver/ioctl.c`:

```c
/* ioctl.c - ioctl handlers */
#include <gexec/gexec.h>
#include "km_ioctl.h"
#include <ntstrsafe.h>

extern void host_log(const char* fmt, ...);

static unsigned long long
fnv1a64(const unsigned char* p, size_t n)
{
    unsigned long long h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { h ^= p[i]; h *= 0x100000001b3ULL; }
    return h;
}

static void
copy_str(char* dst, size_t sz, const char* src)
{
    if (!dst || sz == 0) return;
    dst[0] = 0;
    if (src) RtlStringCbCopyA(dst, sz, src);
}

typedef struct {
    gexec_ctx*        ctx;
    uint32_t          fn_idx;
    const uint64_t*   args;
    unsigned          argc;
    uint64_t          rv;
} call_env;

static VOID
call_callout(_In_ PVOID p)
{
    call_env* e = (call_env*)p;
    /* save fp/xmm state so interpreter float ops don't clobber the guest
     * kernel thread's saved xmm regs. cheap at call boundary. */
    KFLOATING_SAVE fs;
    NTSTATUS s = KeSaveFloatingPointState(&fs);
    e->rv = gexec_call(e->ctx, e->fn_idx, e->args, e->argc);
    if (NT_SUCCESS(s)) KeRestoreFloatingPointState(&fs);
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_load(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    ULONG in_len  = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.InputBufferLength;
    ULONG out_len = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.OutputBufferLength;
    void* buf     = irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;

    if (in_len < sizeof(gexec_load_in) || out_len < sizeof(gexec_load_out) || !buf) {
        irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    gexec_load_in in;
    RtlCopyMemory(&in, buf, sizeof(in));
    if (in.blob_size == 0 || in.blob_size > (16u << 20)) {
        irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    if (in_len < sizeof(gexec_load_in) + in.blob_size) {
        irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    gexec_load_out out = { 0 };
    unsigned char* blob = (unsigned char*)buf + sizeof(gexec_load_in);
    unsigned long long h = fnv1a64(blob, in.blob_size);

    gexec_slot* existing = gexec_table_find_by_hash(h, in.blob_size);
    if (existing) {
        out.module_id = existing->id;
        copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "reused");
        goto done;
    }

    gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_alloc();
    if (!s) { out.status = -1; copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "table full"); goto done; }

    s->blob = ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, in.blob_size, GEXEC_TAG_MOD);
    if (!s->blob) { gexec_table_free(s); out.status = -2; copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "blob alloc"); goto done; }
    RtlCopyMemory(s->blob, blob, in.blob_size);
    s->blob_size = in.blob_size;
    s->hash      = h;
    copy_str(s->name, sizeof(s->name), in.name[0] ? in.name : "module");

    char err[192] = {0};
    NTSTATUS st = gexec_load(s->blob, s->blob_size, &s->mod, err, sizeof(err));
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(st)) {
        gexec_table_free(s);
        out.status = -3;
        copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), err[0] ? err : "load failed");
        goto done;
    }

    st = gexec_verify(s->mod, err, sizeof(err));
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(st)) {
        gexec_table_free(s);
        out.status = -4;
        out.trap   = GIR_TRAP_VERIFIER;
        copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), err[0] ? err : "verify failed");
        goto done;
    }

    /* preallocate the interpreter's register stack now so calls stay simple.
     * sized for max call depth * max regs so nested calls in lifted code
     * (including recursive functions) can always push a new frame. */
    s->mod->reg_stack_slots = GEXEC_MAX_CALL_DEPTH * GIR_MAX_REGS;
    SIZE_T rs_bytes = (SIZE_T)s->mod->reg_stack_slots * sizeof(uint64_t);
    s->mod->reg_stack = ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, rs_bytes, GEXEC_TAG_MEM);
    if (!s->mod->reg_stack) {
        gexec_table_free(s);
        out.status = -5;
        copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "reg stack alloc");
        goto done;
    }

    out.module_id = s->id;
    out.status    = 0;
    copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "loaded");
    host_log("gexec load id=%u size=%u caps=%08x", s->id, in.blob_size, s->mod->caps);

done:
    RtlCopyMemory(buf, &out, sizeof(out));
    irp->IoStatus.Information = sizeof(out);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_call(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    ULONG in_len  = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.InputBufferLength;
    ULONG out_len = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.OutputBufferLength;
    void* buf     = irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;

    if (in_len < sizeof(gexec_call_in) || out_len < sizeof(gexec_call_out) || !buf) {
        irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    gexec_call_in in;
    RtlCopyMemory(&in, buf, sizeof(in));

    gexec_call_out out = { 0 };
    gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_get(in.module_id);
    if (!s || !s->mod) { out.status = -1; copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "no module"); goto done; }

    in.export_name[sizeof(in.export_name) - 1] = 0;
    int fi = gexec_find_export(s->mod, in.export_name);
    if (fi < 0) { out.status = -2; copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "no export"); goto done; }

    if (in.argc > 8) { out.status = -3; copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "argc > 8"); goto done; }

    KeWaitForSingleObject(&s->call_mutex, Executive, KernelMode, FALSE, NULL);

    gexec_ctx ctx = { 0 };
    ctx.mod  = s->mod;
    ctx.fuel = GEXEC_DEFAULT_FUEL;
    if (in.timeout_ms) {
        LARGE_INTEGER freq, now;
        now = KeQueryPerformanceCounter(&freq);
        ULONG64 ticks = ((ULONG64)freq.QuadPart * in.timeout_ms) / 1000ULL;
        ctx.deadline_qpc = (ULONG64)now.QuadPart + ticks;
    }

    call_env env = { &ctx, (uint32_t)fi, in.argv, in.argc, 0 };
    NTSTATUS kst = KeExpandKernelStackAndCalloutEx(call_callout, &env, 64 * 1024, FALSE, NULL);

    KeReleaseMutex(&s->call_mutex, FALSE);

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(kst)) {
        out.status = -4;
        copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "kstack callout failed");
        goto done;
    }
    if (ctx.trap) {
        out.trap   = ctx.trap;
        out.status = -5;
        copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), ctx.trap_msg);
        goto done;
    }
    out.rv     = env.rv;
    out.status = 0;
    copy_str(out.err_msg, sizeof(out.err_msg), "ok");

done:
    RtlCopyMemory(buf, &out, sizeof(out));
    irp->IoStatus.Information = sizeof(out);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_unload(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    ULONG in_len = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.InputBufferLength;
    void* buf    = irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;
    if (in_len < sizeof(gexec_unload_in) || !buf) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;

    gexec_unload_in in;
    RtlCopyMemory(&in, buf, sizeof(in));

    gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_get(in.module_id);
    if (!s) return STATUS_NOT_FOUND;
    gexec_table_free(s);
    irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_info(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    ULONG in_len  = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.InputBufferLength;
    ULONG out_len = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.OutputBufferLength;
    void* buf     = irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;
    if (in_len < sizeof(gexec_info_in) || out_len < sizeof(gexec_info_out) || !buf) {
        irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    gexec_info_in in;
    RtlCopyMemory(&in, buf, sizeof(in));

    gexec_info_out* out = ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, sizeof(*out), GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    if (!out) { irp->IoStatus.Information = 0; return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; }
    RtlZeroMemory(out, sizeof(*out));

    gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_get(in.module_id);
    if (!s || !s->mod) {
        out->status = -1;
        copy_str(out->err_msg, sizeof(out->err_msg), "no module");
        goto done;
    }
    out->base.id        = s->id;
    out->base.blob_size = s->blob_size;
    out->base.hash      = s->hash;
    out->base.exports   = s->mod->n_exports;
    out->base.mem_pages = s->mod->mem_pages;
    out->base.caps      = s->mod->caps;
    RtlStringCbCopyA(out->base.name, sizeof(out->base.name), s->name);

    uint32_t ne = s->mod->n_exports;
    if (ne > GEXEC_MAX_INFO_EXPORTS) ne = GEXEC_MAX_INFO_EXPORTS;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        RtlStringCbCopyA(out->exports[i], sizeof(out->exports[i]), s->mod->exports[i].name);
    }
    out->export_count = ne;

    uint32_t ni = s->mod->n_imports;
    if (ni > GEXEC_MAX_INFO_IMPORTS) ni = GEXEC_MAX_INFO_IMPORTS;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        RtlStringCbCopyA(out->imports[i], sizeof(out->imports[i]), s->mod->imports[i].name);
    }
    out->import_count = ni;
    out->status = 0;

done:
    RtlCopyMemory(buf, out, sizeof(*out));
    ExFreePoolWithTag(out, GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    irp->IoStatus.Information = sizeof(gexec_info_out);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_read_guest(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    ULONG in_len  = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.InputBufferLength;
    ULONG out_len = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.OutputBufferLength;
    void* buf     = irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;
    if (in_len < sizeof(gexec_read_guest_in) || out_len < sizeof(gexec_read_guest_out) || !buf) {
        irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    gexec_read_guest_in in;
    RtlCopyMemory(&in, buf, sizeof(in));

    gexec_read_guest_out* out = ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, sizeof(*out), GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    if (!out) { irp->IoStatus.Information = 0; return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; }
    RtlZeroMemory(out, sizeof(*out));

    if (in.length > GEXEC_MAX_READ_GUEST_BYTES) {
        out->status = -1;
        copy_str(out->err_msg, sizeof(out->err_msg), "length too large");
        goto done;
    }
    gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_get(in.module_id);
    if (!s || !s->mod) {
        out->status = -2;
        copy_str(out->err_msg, sizeof(out->err_msg), "no module");
        goto done;
    }
    if ((uint64_t)in.offset + in.length > s->mod->mem_size) {
        out->status = -3;
        copy_str(out->err_msg, sizeof(out->err_msg), "range out of memory");
        goto done;
    }
    RtlCopyMemory(out->data, s->mod->mem + in.offset, in.length);
    out->length = in.length;
    out->status = 0;

done:
    RtlCopyMemory(buf, out, sizeof(*out));
    ExFreePoolWithTag(out, GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    irp->IoStatus.Information = sizeof(gexec_read_guest_out);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_unload_all(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(sp);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GEXEC_MAX_MODULES; i++) {
        gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_iter(i);
        if (s && s->used) gexec_table_free(s);
    }
    irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
gexec_ioctl_list(PIRP irp, PIO_STACK_LOCATION sp)
{
    ULONG out_len = sp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.OutputBufferLength;
    void* buf     = irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;
    if (out_len < sizeof(gexec_list_out) || !buf) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;

    gexec_list_out out = { 0 };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GEXEC_MAX_MODULES; i++) {
        gexec_slot* s = gexec_table_iter(i);
        if (!s || !s->used || !s->mod) continue;
        gexec_module_entry* e = &out.entries[out.count++];
        e->id        = s->id;
        e->blob_size = s->blob_size;
        e->hash      = s->hash;
        e->exports   = s->mod->n_exports;
        e->mem_pages = s->mod->mem_pages;
        e->caps      = s->mod->caps;
        RtlStringCbCopyA(e->name, sizeof(e->name), s->name);
    }
    RtlCopyMemory(buf, &out, sizeof(out));
    irp->IoStatus.Information = sizeof(out);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

#pragma once

#include <initguid.h>

#define GEXEC_DEVICE_TYPE       0x8000

`examples/km-driver/table.c`:

```c
/* table.c - module slot allocator */
#include <gexec/gexec.h>
#include "km_ioctl.h"

static gexec_slot g_slots[GEXEC_MAX_MODULES];
static KSPIN_LOCK g_lock;

NTSTATUS
gexec_table_init(void)
{
    RtlZeroMemory(g_slots, sizeof(g_slots));
    KeInitializeSpinLock(&g_lock);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GEXEC_MAX_MODULES; i++)
        KeInitializeMutex(&g_slots[i].call_mutex, 0);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

void
gexec_table_teardown(void)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GEXEC_MAX_MODULES; i++) {
        if (g_slots[i].used) {
            g_slots[i].refcount = 1;
            gexec_table_free(&g_slots[i]);
        }
    }
}

gexec_slot*
gexec_table_alloc(void)
{
    KIRQL irql;
    gexec_slot* out = NULL;
    KeAcquireSpinLock(&g_lock, &irql);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GEXEC_MAX_MODULES; i++) {
        if (!g_slots[i].used) {
            g_slots[i].used     = 1;
            g_slots[i].id       = i + 1;
            g_slots[i].refcount = 1;
            KeInitializeMutex(&g_slots[i].call_mutex, 0);
            out = &g_slots[i];
            break;
        }
    }
    KeReleaseSpinLock(&g_lock, irql);
    return out;
}

gexec_slot*
gexec_table_get(unsigned int id)
{
    if (id == 0 || id > GEXEC_MAX_MODULES) return NULL;
    gexec_slot* s = &g_slots[id - 1];
    return s->used ? s : NULL;
}

gexec_slot*
gexec_table_find_by_hash(unsigned long long hash, unsigned int expected_size)
{
    KIRQL irql;
    gexec_slot* out = NULL;
    KeAcquireSpinLock(&g_lock, &irql);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GEXEC_MAX_MODULES; i++) {
        if (g_slots[i].used && g_slots[i].hash == hash && g_slots[i].blob_size == expected_size) {
            InterlockedIncrement(&g_slots[i].refcount);
            out = &g_slots[i];
            break;
        }
    }
    KeReleaseSpinLock(&g_lock, irql);
    return out;
}

gexec_slot*
gexec_table_iter(unsigned int idx)
{
    if (idx >= GEXEC_MAX_MODULES) return NULL;
    return &g_slots[idx];
}

void
gexec_table_free(gexec_slot* s)
{
    if (!s || !s->used) return;
    if (InterlockedDecrement(&s->refcount) > 0) return;

    KeWaitForSingleObject(&s->call_mutex, Executive, KernelMode, FALSE, NULL);

    if (s->mod)  { gexec_free(s->mod); s->mod  = NULL; }
    if (s->blob) { ExFreePoolWithTag(s->blob, GEXEC_TAG_MOD); s->blob = NULL; }
    s->blob_size = 0;
    s->hash      = 0;
    s->used      = 0;

    KeReleaseMutex(&s->call_mutex, FALSE);
}

/* gtest.h - gt_ aliases over gexec types */

`examples/um-runner/host_um.c`:

```c
/* host.c - user-mode host imports for the test tool.
 * covers the subset of driver imports that make sense outside the kernel:
 * io.log (stdout), mem.* (linear memory ops), seh.last_code/addr, and a
 * couple of introspection stubs that return fake values. any driver-only
 * import is missing here, which causes gt_load to reject modules that need
 * kmem or msr access. that's intentional: user-mode tests exercise pure
 * logic modules. */
#include "gtest.h"

static void set_trap(gt_ctx* ctx, uint32_t code, const char* msg) {
    ctx->trap = code;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; i++) { char c = msg[i]; ctx->trap_msg[i] = c; if (!c) break; }
}

static int guest_ok(gt_ctx* ctx, uint32_t off, uint32_t len) {
    uint64_t end = (uint64_t)off + len;
    return end >= off && end <= ctx->mod->mem_size;
}

static uint64_t h_io_log(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    (void)argc;
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)a[0], len = (uint32_t)a[1];
    if (len > 512) len = 512;
    if (!guest_ok(ctx, off, len)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "log oob"); return 0; }
    fwrite(ctx->mod->mem + off, 1, len, stdout);
    fputc('\n', stdout);
    return 0;
}

static uint64_t h_mem_base(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)a; (void)argc; return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctx->mod->mem; }
static uint64_t h_mem_size(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)a; (void)argc; return ctx->mod->mem_size; }

static uint64_t h_mem_copy(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    (void)argc;
    uint32_t d=(uint32_t)a[0], s=(uint32_t)a[1], n=(uint32_t)a[2];
    if (!guest_ok(ctx, d, n) || !guest_ok(ctx, s, n)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "copy oob"); return 0; }
    memmove(ctx->mod->mem + d, ctx->mod->mem + s, n); return n;
}
static uint64_t h_mem_zero(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    (void)argc;
    uint32_t off=(uint32_t)a[0], n=(uint32_t)a[1];
    if (!guest_ok(ctx, off, n)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "zero oob"); return 0; }
    memset(ctx->mod->mem + off, 0, n); return n;
}
static uint64_t h_mem_fill(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) {
    (void)argc;
    uint32_t off=(uint32_t)a[0], n=(uint32_t)a[1]; uint8_t v=(uint8_t)a[2];
    if (!guest_ok(ctx, off, n)) { set_trap(ctx, GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB, "fill oob"); return 0; }
    memset(ctx->mod->mem + off, v, n); return n;
}

/* stub introspection: return synthetic ids so tests can rely on them */
static uint64_t h_proc_pid(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)ctx; (void)a; (void)argc; return 0x1234; }
static uint64_t h_proc_tid(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)ctx; (void)a; (void)argc; return 0x5678; }
static uint64_t h_proc_irql(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)ctx; (void)a; (void)argc; return 0; }

static uint64_t h_seh_last_code(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)a; (void)argc; return ctx->last_exception_code; }
static uint64_t h_seh_last_addr(gt_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* a, unsigned argc) { (void)a; (void)argc; return ctx->last_exception_addr; }

#define CAP_ALLOC       (1u << 0)
#define CAP_INTROSPECT  (1u << 9)

static const gt_host_entry g_hosts[] = {
    { "io.log",         h_io_log,        0,              2, 2 },
    { "mem.base",       h_mem_base,      0,              0, 0 },
    { "mem.size",       h_mem_size,      0,              0, 0 },
    { "mem.copy",       h_mem_copy,      0,              3, 3 },
    { "mem.zero",       h_mem_zero,      0,              2, 2 },
    { "mem.fill",       h_mem_fill,      0,              3, 3 },
    { "proc.pid",       h_proc_pid,      CAP_INTROSPECT, 0, 0 },
    { "proc.tid",       h_proc_tid,      CAP_INTROSPECT, 0, 0 },
    { "proc.irql",      h_proc_irql,     CAP_INTROSPECT, 0, 0 },
    { "seh.last_code",  h_seh_last_code, 0,              0, 0 },
    { "seh.last_addr",  h_seh_last_addr, 0,              0, 0 },
};

static int name_eq(const char* a, const char* b) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GIR_NAME_LEN; i++) { if (a[i] != b[i]) return 0; if (a[i] == 0) return 1; }
    return 1;
}

const gt_host_entry* gt_host_lookup(const char* name) {
    if (!name) return NULL;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(g_hosts)/sizeof(g_hosts[0]); i++) if (name_eq(g_hosts[i].name, name)) return &g_hosts[i];
    return NULL;
}
uint32_t gt_host_count(void) { return (uint32_t)(sizeof(g_hosts)/sizeof(g_hosts[0])); }
const gt_host_entry* gt_host_by_index(uint32_t idx) { return idx < gt_host_count() ? &g_hosts[idx] : NULL; }

```

`examples/um-runner/main.c`:

```c
/* main.c - gexec-run cli: run|check|info */
#include "gtest.h"

static uint8_t*
slurp(const char* path, size_t* out_sz)
{
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    if (n <= 0) { fclose(f); return NULL; }
    uint8_t* b = malloc(n);
    if ((long)fread(b, 1, n, f) != n) { free(b); fclose(f); return NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    *out_sz = (size_t)n;
    return b;
}

static gt_module*
load_and_verify(const char* path)
{
    size_t sz;
    uint8_t* b = slurp(path, &sz);
    if (!b) { fprintf(stderr, "cant read %s\n", path); return NULL; }
    gt_module* m = NULL;
    char err[256] = {0};
    if (gt_load(b, (uint32_t)sz, &m, err, sizeof(err)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "load failed: %s\n", err);
        free(b); return NULL;
    }
    if (gt_verify(m, err, sizeof(err)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "verify failed: %s\n", err);
        gt_free(m); free(b); return NULL;
    }
    free(b);
    return m;
}

static int
cmd_run(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gtest run file.gmod export [args...]\n"); return 1; }
    gt_module* m = load_and_verify(argv[2]);
    if (!m) return 2;

    int fi = gt_find_export(m, argv[3]);
    if (fi < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "no export '%s'\n", argv[3]); gt_free(m); return 3; }

    uint64_t args[GIR_MAX_REGS] = {0};
    int argn = argc - 4;
    if (argn > 8) argn = 8;
    for (int i = 0; i < argn; i++) {
        const char* s = argv[4 + i];
        args[i] = (s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X')) ? strtoull(s + 2, NULL, 16) : strtoull(s, NULL, 10);
    }

    gt_ctx ctx = { 0 };
    ctx.mod = m;
    ctx.fuel = GT_DEFAULT_FUEL;
    uint64_t rv = gt_call(&ctx, (uint32_t)fi, args, (unsigned)argn);
    if (ctx.trap) {
        printf("trap %u: %s\n", ctx.trap, ctx.trap_msg);
        gt_free(m); return 4;
    }
    printf("rv = %llu (0x%llx)\n", (unsigned long long)rv, (unsigned long long)rv);
    gt_free(m);
    return 0;
}

typedef struct {
    int   passed;
    int   failed;
} check_stats;

static int
hex_nib(char c)
{
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') return 10 + (c - 'a');
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') return 10 + (c - 'A');
    return -1;
}

static void
apply_mem(gt_module* m, const char* line)
{
    /* line looks like: mem <hex_off> "..." OR mem <hex_off> hex:AABBCC... */
    const char* p = line;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    if (strncmp(p, "mem", 3) != 0) return;
    p += 3;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    uint32_t off = (uint32_t)strtoul(p, (char**)&p, 0);
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;

    if (*p == '"') {
        p++;
        while (*p && *p != '"' && off < m->mem_size) {
            uint8_t c = (uint8_t)*p++;
            if (c == '\\' && *p) {
                char e = *p++;
                switch (e) {
                case 'n': c = '\n'; break;
                case 't': c = '\t'; break;
                case 'r': c = '\r'; break;
                case '0': c = 0;    break;
                case '"': c = '"';  break;
                case '\\': c = '\\'; break;
                case 'x': { int hi=hex_nib(p[0]), lo=hex_nib(p[1]); if (hi<0||lo<0) return; c=(uint8_t)((hi<<4)|lo); p+=2; break; }
                default: c = (uint8_t)e; break;
                }
            }
            m->mem[off++] = c;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (strncmp(p, "hex:", 4) == 0) {
        p += 4;
        while (*p && off < m->mem_size) {
            while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
            if (!*p || *p == '\r' || *p == '\n') break;
            int hi = hex_nib(p[0]);
            int lo = hex_nib(p[1]);
            if (hi < 0 || lo < 0) return;
            m->mem[off++] = (uint8_t)((hi << 4) | lo);
            p += 2;
        }
    }
}

static int
run_check_line(gt_module* m, const char* line, check_stats* s)
{
    char buf[2048];
    strncpy(buf, line, sizeof(buf) - 1); buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = 0;
    char* p = buf;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    if (*p == 0 || *p == '#' || *p == '\n' || *p == '\r') return 0;

    /* mem directive: apply to module and return */
    if (strncmp(p, "mem", 3) == 0 && (p[3] == ' ' || p[3] == '\t')) {
        char* eol = strpbrk(p, "\r\n");
        if (eol) *eol = 0;
        apply_mem(m, p);
        return 0;
    }

    char* eol = strpbrk(p, "\r\n");
    if (eol) *eol = 0;

    char* toks[32]; int n = 0;
    char* q = p;
    while (*q && n < 32) {
        while (*q == ' ' || *q == '\t') q++;
        if (!*q) break;
        toks[n++] = q;
        while (*q && *q != ' ' && *q != '\t') q++;
        if (*q) *q++ = 0;
    }
    if (n < 4 || strcmp(toks[0], "run") != 0) return 0;

    const char* exp_name = toks[1];
    int argc = atoi(toks[2]);
    if (argc < 0 || argc > 8) { fprintf(stderr, "bad argc %d\n", argc); return -1; }

    int need = 3 + argc + 2;   /* run, exp, argc, [args], "=>", expected */
    if (n < need) { fprintf(stderr, "malformed check: %s\n", p); return -1; }

    uint64_t args[8] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < argc; i++) {
        const char* s = toks[3 + i];
        args[i] = (s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X')) ? strtoull(s + 2, NULL, 16) : strtoull(s, NULL, 10);
    }
    if (strcmp(toks[3 + argc], "=>") != 0) { fprintf(stderr, "expected '=>' in: %s\n", p); return -1; }

    const char* want = toks[3 + argc + 1];
    int fi = gt_find_export(m, exp_name);
    if (fi < 0) { printf("  FAIL %s: no such export\n", exp_name); s->failed++; return 0; }

    gt_ctx ctx = { 0 };
    ctx.mod = m;
    ctx.fuel = GT_DEFAULT_FUEL;
    uint64_t rv = gt_call(&ctx, (uint32_t)fi, args, (unsigned)argc);

    if (strncmp(want, "trap:", 5) == 0) {
        uint32_t want_code = (uint32_t)atoi(want + 5);
        if (ctx.trap == want_code) { printf("  ok   %s (trap %u %s)\n", exp_name, ctx.trap, ctx.trap_msg); s->passed++; }
        else { printf("  FAIL %s: expected trap %u, got trap=%u rv=%llu (%s)\n", exp_name, want_code, ctx.trap, (unsigned long long)rv, ctx.trap_msg); s->failed++; }
        return 0;
    }
    if (ctx.trap) {
        printf("  FAIL %s: unexpected trap %u %s\n", exp_name, ctx.trap, ctx.trap_msg);
        s->failed++;
        return 0;
    }
    uint64_t exp_v = (want[0] == '0' && (want[1] == 'x' || want[1] == 'X')) ? strtoull(want + 2, NULL, 16) : strtoull(want, NULL, 10);
    if (rv == exp_v) { printf("  ok   %s -> %llu\n", exp_name, (unsigned long long)rv); s->passed++; }
    else { printf("  FAIL %s: expected %llu, got %llu\n", exp_name, (unsigned long long)exp_v, (unsigned long long)rv); s->failed++; }
    return 0;
}

static int
cmd_check(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gtest check file.gmod file.test\n"); return 1; }
    gt_module* m = load_and_verify(argv[2]);
    if (!m) return 2;

    FILE* f = fopen(argv[3], "r");
    if (!f) { fprintf(stderr, "cant open %s\n", argv[3]); gt_free(m); return 3; }

    printf("== %s ==\n", argv[3]);
    check_stats s = { 0 };
    char line[1024];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) run_check_line(m, line, &s);
    fclose(f);
    printf("== %d passed, %d failed ==\n", s.passed, s.failed);
    gt_free(m);
    return s.failed ? 5 : 0;
}

static int
cmd_info(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gtest info file.gmod\n"); return 1; }
    gt_module* m = load_and_verify(argv[2]);
    if (!m) return 2;
    printf("caps        0x%08x\n", m->caps);
    printf("mem_pages   %u\n", m->mem_pages);
    printf("stack_pages %u\n", m->stack_pages);
    printf("imports     %u\n", m->n_imports);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m->n_imports; i++) printf("  [%u] %s (host_idx=%u)\n", i, m->imports[i].name, m->imports[i].host_idx);
    printf("exports     %u\n", m->n_exports);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m->n_exports; i++) printf("  [%u] %-24s -> fn %u\n", i, m->exports[i].name, m->exports[i].fn_idx);
    printf("functions   %u\n", m->n_fns);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m->n_fns; i++) {
        gt_function* fn = &m->fns[i];
        printf("  [%u] %-24s regs=%u args=%u ret=%u insns=%u\n", i, fn->name, fn->n_regs, fn->n_args, fn->returns, fn->n_insns);
    }
    printf("ftable      %u\n", m->n_ftable);
    printf("seh         %u\n", m->n_seh);
    gt_free(m);
    return 0;
}

int
main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: gtest {run|check|info} ...\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(argv[1], "run") == 0)   return cmd_run(argc, argv);
    if (strcmp(argv[1], "check") == 0) return cmd_check(argc, argv);
    if (strcmp(argv[1], "info") == 0)  return cmd_info(argc, argv);
    fprintf(stderr, "unknown command %s\n", argv[1]);
    return 1;
}

```h
/* gexec.h - public embedder API */
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>
#include "gir.h"
#include "gexec_platform.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define GEXEC_MAX_CALL_DEPTH   128
#define GEXEC_DEFAULT_FUEL     (1ull << 32)
#define GEXEC_STACK_ALIGN      16

/* one function in a loaded module. */
typedef struct _gexec_function {
    gir_insn*   insns;
    uint32_t    n_insns;
    uint16_t    n_regs;
    uint16_t    n_args;
    uint16_t    returns;
    uint16_t    _pad;
    uint32_t    stack_slots;
    char        name[GIR_NAME_LEN];
} gexec_function;

typedef struct _gexec_export {
    char     name[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint32_t fn_idx;
} gexec_export;

typedef struct _gexec_import {
    char     name[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint32_t host_idx;
} gexec_import;

/* fully parsed, verified, ready to execute. one instance per loaded .gmod. */
typedef struct _gexec_module {
    uint32_t          caps;
    uint32_t          flags;
    uint32_t          mem_pages;
    uint32_t          stack_pages;
    uint8_t*          mem;
    uint32_t          mem_size;
    uint32_t          stack_base;
    uint32_t          stack_top;

    gexec_function*   fns;
    uint32_t          n_fns;

    gexec_export*     exports;
    uint32_t          n_exports;

    gexec_import*     imports;
    uint32_t          n_imports;

    uint32_t*         ftable;
    uint32_t          n_ftable;

    gir_seh_scope*    seh;
    uint32_t          n_seh;

    uint32_t          entry_fn;

    /* preallocated register window for every possible frame. serialized by
     * the embedder's per-module call mutex. */
    uint64_t*         reg_stack;
    uint32_t          reg_stack_slots;
} gexec_module;

enum {
    GEXEC_POST_NONE            = 0,
    GEXEC_POST_SEH_FILTER      = 1,
    GEXEC_POST_SEH_FIN_UNWIND  = 2,
    GEXEC_POST_SEH_FIN_NORMAL  = 3
};

typedef struct _gexec_frame {
    const gexec_function* fn;
    uint32_t              pc;
    uint32_t              reg_base;
    uint32_t              seh_stack_depth;
    uint16_t              dst_reg;
    uint16_t              returns_void;
    uint32_t              post_action;
    uint32_t              post_scope;
    uint32_t              post_code;
    uint64_t              post_addr;
} gexec_frame;

typedef struct _gexec_seh_active {
    uint32_t scope_idx;
    uint32_t frame_idx;
} gexec_seh_active;

/* one per call chain. holds fuel, deadline, and the frame stack. embedders
 * allocate this on the caller stack. safe to reuse for the next call as
 * long as it's zeroed. */
typedef struct _gexec_ctx {
    gexec_module*     mod;
    uint64_t          fuel;
    uint64_t          deadline_qpc;
    uint32_t          call_depth;
    uint32_t          trap;
    char              trap_msg[128];
    gexec_frame       frames[GEXEC_MAX_CALL_DEPTH];
    uint32_t          top;

    gexec_seh_active  seh_stack[64];
    uint32_t          seh_depth;
    uint32_t          last_exception_code;
    uint64_t          last_exception_addr;
} gexec_ctx;

/* host function signature. embedder supplies functions matching this and
 * publishes them via a table the loader can walk. */
typedef uint64_t (*gexec_host_fn)(gexec_ctx* ctx, const uint64_t* args, unsigned argc);

typedef struct _gexec_host_entry {
    const char*     name;
    gexec_host_fn   fn;
    uint32_t        required_caps;
    uint32_t        min_argc;
    uint32_t        max_argc;
} gexec_host_entry;

/* loader.c */
gexec_status_t  gexec_load(const void* bytes, uint32_t size, gexec_module** out_mod, char* err, uint32_t err_sz);
void            gexec_free(gexec_module* mod);
int             gexec_find_export(const gexec_module* mod, const char* name);

/* verify.c */
gexec_status_t  gexec_verify(const gexec_module* mod, char* err, uint32_t err_sz);

/* exec.c */
uint64_t        gexec_call(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint32_t fn_idx, const uint64_t* args, unsigned argc);

/* host.c (embedder-provided) */
const gexec_host_entry* gexec_host_lookup(const char* name);
uint32_t                gexec_host_count(void);
const gexec_host_entry* gexec_host_by_index(uint32_t idx);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

/* gexec_platform.h - KM/UM portability shim */
#pragma once

#ifdef _KERNEL_MODE

#include <ntddk.h>

typedef NTSTATUS gexec_status_t;

#define GEXEC_STATUS_SUCCESS         STATUS_SUCCESS
#define GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM   STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
#define GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT  STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT
#define GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY       STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES
#define GEXEC_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED     STATUS_REVISION_MISMATCH
#define GEXEC_STATUS_VERIFY_FAIL     STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_HASH
#define GEXEC_STATUS_TRAP            STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL

#define GEXEC_SUCCESS(s)             NT_SUCCESS(s)

#ifndef gexec_alloc
#define gexec_alloc(sz, tag)         ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, (sz), (tag))
#endif
#ifndef gexec_free_
#define gexec_free_(p, tag)          ExFreePoolWithTag((p), (tag))
#endif
#define gexec_memcpy(d, s, n)        RtlCopyMemory((d), (s), (n))
#define gexec_memzero(p, n)          RtlZeroMemory((p), (n))

#else  /* user mode */

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef int gexec_status_t;

#define GEXEC_STATUS_SUCCESS          0
#define GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM   -1
#define GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT  -2
#define GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY       -3
#define GEXEC_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED     -4
#define GEXEC_STATUS_VERIFY_FAIL     -5
#define GEXEC_STATUS_TRAP            -6

#define GEXEC_SUCCESS(s)             ((s) == GEXEC_STATUS_SUCCESS)

#ifndef gexec_alloc
static inline void* gexec__um_alloc(size_t n, unsigned long tag) { (void)tag; return malloc(n); }
#define gexec_alloc(sz, tag)         gexec__um_alloc((size_t)(sz), (tag))
#endif
#ifndef gexec_free_
#define gexec_free_(p, tag)          ((void)(tag), free(p))
#endif
#define gexec_memcpy(d, s, n)        memcpy((d), (s), (n))
#define gexec_memzero(p, n)          memset((p), 0, (n))

#endif  /* _KERNEL_MODE */

/* pool tags used across the core. embedders may override these. */
#ifndef GEXEC_TAG_MOD
#define GEXEC_TAG_MOD    'oMxG'
#endif
#ifndef GEXEC_TAG_MEM
#define GEXEC_TAG_MEM    'eMxG'
#endif
#ifndef GEXEC_TAG_INSN
#define GEXEC_TAG_INSN   'nIxG'
#endif
#ifndef GEXEC_TAG_TBL
#define GEXEC_TAG_TBL    'bTxG'
#endif
#ifndef GEXEC_TAG_SEH
#define GEXEC_TAG_SEH    'hSxG'
#endif

`include/gexec/gir.h`:

```h
/* gir.h - gexec intermediate representation.
 *
 * shared UM/KM. register machine, fixed 16-byte instructions, 64-bit register
 * width for scalar values. 128-bit values live in pairs of adjacent slots.
 *
 * module layout on disk (.gmod):
 *   [file_header]
 *   [import_names]                n_imports * GIR_NAME_LEN
 *   [exports]                     n_exports * gir_export
 *   [functions]                   n_functions * (fn_header + insns)
 *   [data segments]               n_data * (data_header + bytes)
 *   [function table]              n_ftable * u32 fn_idx
 *   [seh scopes]                  n_seh * gir_seh_scope
 *   [debug info blob]             debug_size bytes (optional)
 *
 * everything little-endian. no padding except where noted. reader validates
 * every offset against file size before dereferencing.
 *
 * register file layout convention (enforced only by the verifier when the
 * module was produced by the pe lifter). custom modules can use any layout
 * they want within n_regs:
 *
 *   reg[0..15]      x86 GPRs                          rax rcx rdx rbx rsp rbp rsi rdi r8..r15
 *   reg[16..31]     lifter scratch temporaries
 *   reg[32..95]     xmm0..xmm31 as adjacent pairs     xmm[i] = (reg[32+2i], reg[33+2i])
 *   reg[96..127]    lifter spill area
 *   reg[128..255]   free for guest use
 *
 * eflags packing (matches x86 EFLAGS bit positions so mask math is direct):
 *   bit 0  CF   carry
 *   bit 2  PF   parity
 *   bit 4  AF   adjust
 *   bit 6  ZF   zero
 *   bit 7  SF   sign
 *   bit 10 DF   direction (used by string ops)
 *   bit 11 OF   overflow
 */
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

#define GIR_MAGIC              0x444F4D47u   /* "GMOD" */
#define GIR_VERSION            2u

#define GIR_NAME_LEN           32
#define GIR_MAX_REGS           256
#define GIR_MAX_FUNC_INSNS     (1u << 20)
#define GIR_MAX_MEM_PAGES      4096u
#define GIR_PAGE_SIZE          65536u
#define GIR_MAX_IMPORTS        512
#define GIR_MAX_EXPORTS        512
#define GIR_MAX_FUNCTIONS      16384
#define GIR_MAX_CALL_ARGS      6
#define GIR_MAX_SEH_SCOPES     4096

/* windows x64 abi register indices when produced by the lifter. */
#define GIR_REG_RAX  0
#define GIR_REG_RCX  1
#define GIR_REG_RDX  2
#define GIR_REG_RBX  3
#define GIR_REG_RSP  4
#define GIR_REG_RBP  5
#define GIR_REG_RSI  6
#define GIR_REG_RDI  7
#define GIR_REG_R8   8
#define GIR_REG_R9   9
#define GIR_REG_R10  10
#define GIR_REG_R11  11
#define GIR_REG_R12  12
#define GIR_REG_R13  13
#define GIR_REG_R14  14
#define GIR_REG_R15  15

#define GIR_REG_FLAGS      16   /* single packed eflags reg for the lifter */
#define GIR_REG_TMP0       17
#define GIR_REG_TMP1       18
#define GIR_REG_TMP2       19
#define GIR_REG_TMP3       20
#define GIR_REG_TMP4       21
#define GIR_REG_TMP5       22
#define GIR_REG_TMP6       23
#define GIR_REG_TMP7       24
#define GIR_REG_FSBASE     25
#define GIR_REG_GSBASE     26

#define GIR_XMM_REG(i)     (32 + 2 * (i))

/* eflags bits, x86-compatible so a lifted arith op can pack directly. */
#define GIR_EF_CF          0x0001ull
#define GIR_EF_PF          0x0004ull
#define GIR_EF_AF          0x0010ull
#define GIR_EF_ZF          0x0040ull
#define GIR_EF_SF          0x0080ull
#define GIR_EF_DF          0x0400ull
#define GIR_EF_OF          0x0800ull
#define GIR_EF_ALL         (GIR_EF_CF|GIR_EF_PF|GIR_EF_AF|GIR_EF_ZF|GIR_EF_SF|GIR_EF_OF)

/* condition codes match intel encoding (Jcc opcode - 0x70). */
enum {
    GIR_CC_O   = 0,  GIR_CC_NO  = 1,
    GIR_CC_B   = 2,  GIR_CC_AE  = 3,
    GIR_CC_E   = 4,  GIR_CC_NE  = 5,
    GIR_CC_BE  = 6,  GIR_CC_A   = 7,
    GIR_CC_S   = 8,  GIR_CC_NS  = 9,
    GIR_CC_P   = 10, GIR_CC_NP  = 11,
    GIR_CC_L   = 12, GIR_CC_GE  = 13,
    GIR_CC_LE  = 14, GIR_CC_G   = 15
};

typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t version;
    uint32_t flags;
    uint32_t caps;
    uint32_t mem_pages;
    uint32_t stack_pages;        /* pages reserved at end of linear memory for guest stack */
    uint32_t n_imports;
    uint32_t n_exports;
    uint32_t n_functions;
    uint32_t n_data;
    uint32_t n_ftable;
    uint32_t n_seh;
    uint32_t entry_fn;
    uint32_t debug_size;
    uint32_t reserved[2];
} gir_file_header;

typedef struct {
    char     name[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint32_t fn_idx;
    uint32_t _pad;
} gir_export;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t n_regs;
    uint32_t n_insns;
    uint32_t n_args;
    uint32_t returns;
    uint32_t stack_slots;        /* extra spill/local slots reserved above n_regs */
    uint32_t _reserved;
} gir_fn_header;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t offset;
    uint32_t length;
} gir_data_header;

/* seh scope entry. lifted from .xdata unwind info. begin/end are gir insn
 * indices within the owning function; handler is either a filter fn idx
 * (kind == GIR_SEH_EXCEPT) or a finally fn idx (kind == GIR_SEH_FINALLY). */
enum {
    GIR_SEH_EXCEPT  = 1,
    GIR_SEH_FINALLY = 2
};

typedef struct {
    uint32_t fn_idx;             /* function that owns the scope */
    uint32_t begin_insn;
    uint32_t end_insn;
    uint32_t handler_fn;
    uint32_t kind;
    uint32_t _pad;
} gir_seh_scope;

/* fixed 16-byte instruction. word0 packs opcode + three register indices,
 * word1 is a 64-bit immediate (branch target, memory offset, constant, or
 * additional operand fields packed as 16-bit halves). */
typedef struct {
    uint16_t op;
    uint16_t dst;
    uint16_t src1;
    uint16_t src2;
    uint64_t imm;
} gir_insn;

/* opcode enumeration. keep sorted by category. new opcodes append; the
 * verifier and interpreter reject unknown ones so old modules stay valid. */
enum {
    GIR_NOP              = 0x0000,
    GIR_TRAP             = 0x0001,   /* imm = trap code */
    GIR_UNREACHABLE      = 0x0002,
    GIR_MEM_FENCE        = 0x0003,
    GIR_MEM_LFENCE       = 0x0004,
    GIR_MEM_SFENCE       = 0x0005,
    GIR_HALT             = 0x0006,   /* traps: guest asked to stop */
    GIR_INT3             = 0x0007,   /* traps: debugger break */
    GIR_CPU_PAUSE        = 0x0008,   /* hint, becomes _mm_pause */

    GIR_CONST_I32        = 0x0010,
    GIR_CONST_I64        = 0x0011,
    GIR_CONST_V128       = 0x0012,   /* dst pair = imm at (imm, insn+1.imm); i.e. 16-byte const follows inline */
    GIR_MOV              = 0x0013,
    GIR_MOV_V128         = 0x0014,   /* dst pair = src pair */

    GIR_NEG_I32          = 0x0020,
    GIR_NEG_I64          = 0x0021,
    GIR_NOT_I32          = 0x0022,
    GIR_NOT_I64          = 0x0023,
    GIR_CLZ_I32          = 0x0024,
    GIR_CLZ_I64          = 0x0025,
    GIR_CTZ_I32          = 0x0026,
    GIR_CTZ_I64          = 0x0027,
    GIR_POPCNT_I32       = 0x0028,
    GIR_POPCNT_I64       = 0x0029,
    GIR_BSWAP_I32        = 0x002A,
    GIR_BSWAP_I64        = 0x002B,
    GIR_EXTEND_I32_S     = 0x002C,
    GIR_EXTEND_I32_U     = 0x002D,
    GIR_EXTEND_I16_S     = 0x002E,
    GIR_EXTEND_I16_U     = 0x002F,
    GIR_EXTEND_I8_S      = 0x0030,
    GIR_EXTEND_I8_U      = 0x0031,
    GIR_WRAP_I64         = 0x0032,
    GIR_WRAP_I32         = 0x0033,
    GIR_WRAP_I16         = 0x0034,

    GIR_ADD_I32          = 0x0040,
    GIR_ADD_I64          = 0x0041,
    GIR_SUB_I32          = 0x0042,
    GIR_SUB_I64          = 0x0043,
    GIR_MUL_I32          = 0x0044,
    GIR_MUL_I64          = 0x0045,
    GIR_MUL_HI_S_I64     = 0x0046,   /* high 64 of signed multiplication for imul r/m64 */
    GIR_MUL_HI_U_I64     = 0x0047,
    GIR_DIV_S_I32        = 0x0048,
    GIR_DIV_S_I64        = 0x0049,
    GIR_DIV_U_I32        = 0x004A,
    GIR_DIV_U_I64        = 0x004B,
    GIR_REM_S_I32        = 0x004C,
    GIR_REM_S_I64        = 0x004D,
    GIR_REM_U_I32        = 0x004E,
    GIR_REM_U_I64        = 0x004F,

    GIR_AND_I32          = 0x0050,
    GIR_AND_I64          = 0x0051,
    GIR_OR_I32           = 0x0052,
    GIR_OR_I64           = 0x0053,
    GIR_XOR_I32          = 0x0054,
    GIR_XOR_I64          = 0x0055,
    GIR_SHL_I32          = 0x0056,
    GIR_SHL_I64          = 0x0057,
    GIR_SHR_S_I32        = 0x0058,
    GIR_SHR_S_I64        = 0x0059,
    GIR_SHR_U_I32        = 0x005A,
    GIR_SHR_U_I64        = 0x005B,
    GIR_ROTL_I32         = 0x005C,
    GIR_ROTL_I64         = 0x005D,
    GIR_ROTR_I32         = 0x005E,
    GIR_ROTR_I64         = 0x005F,

    GIR_ADD_IMM_I32      = 0x0060,
    GIR_ADD_IMM_I64      = 0x0061,
    GIR_SUB_IMM_I32      = 0x0062,
    GIR_SUB_IMM_I64      = 0x0063,
    GIR_AND_IMM_I64      = 0x0064,
    GIR_OR_IMM_I64       = 0x0065,
    GIR_XOR_IMM_I64      = 0x0066,
    GIR_SHL_IMM_I64      = 0x0067,
    GIR_SHR_U_IMM_I64    = 0x0068,
    GIR_SHR_S_IMM_I64    = 0x0069,
    GIR_MUL_IMM_I64      = 0x006A,
    GIR_CMP_IMM_I32      = 0x006B,   /* like sub but only writes flags reg (imm[63:16]=flag_reg, low 16=imm value not used, actual imm value in src2 as literal) - reuses flag pattern below */
    GIR_CMP_IMM_I64      = 0x006C,

    /* comparisons: dst = (0 or 1). two operand comparisons; unlike x86 CMP,
     * these DO write dst but do NOT write flags. use *_F variants for the
     * flags-writing versions. */
    GIR_EQ_I32           = 0x0070,
    GIR_EQ_I64           = 0x0071,
    GIR_NE_I32           = 0x0072,
    GIR_NE_I64           = 0x0073,
    GIR_LT_S_I32         = 0x0074,
    GIR_LT_S_I64         = 0x0075,
    GIR_LT_U_I32         = 0x0076,
    GIR_LT_U_I64         = 0x0077,
    GIR_LE_S_I32         = 0x0078,
    GIR_LE_S_I64         = 0x0079,
    GIR_LE_U_I32         = 0x007A,
    GIR_LE_U_I64         = 0x007B,
    GIR_GT_S_I32         = 0x007C,
    GIR_GT_S_I64         = 0x007D,
    GIR_GT_U_I32         = 0x007E,
    GIR_GT_U_I64         = 0x007F,
    GIR_GE_S_I32         = 0x0080,
    GIR_GE_S_I64         = 0x0081,
    GIR_GE_U_I32         = 0x0082,
    GIR_GE_U_I64         = 0x0083,
    GIR_EQZ_I32          = 0x0084,
    GIR_EQZ_I64          = 0x0085,

    /* linear-memory load/store. addr = reg[src1] + (int32_t)imm. */
    GIR_LOAD_I8_S        = 0x0090,
    GIR_LOAD_I8_U        = 0x0091,
    GIR_LOAD_I16_S       = 0x0092,
    GIR_LOAD_I16_U       = 0x0093,
    GIR_LOAD_I32_S       = 0x0094,
    GIR_LOAD_I32_U       = 0x0095,
    GIR_LOAD_I64         = 0x0096,
    GIR_LOAD_V128        = 0x0097,   /* dst pair = 16 bytes from linear memory */
    GIR_STORE_I8         = 0x0098,
    GIR_STORE_I16        = 0x0099,
    GIR_STORE_I32        = 0x009A,
    GIR_STORE_I64        = 0x009B,
    GIR_STORE_V128       = 0x009C,   /* pair src reg -> 16 bytes */

    /* indirect-mode linear-memory load/store: base + index*scale + disp.
     * imm packs {disp:32, scale_log2:8, index_reg:16, unused:8}. src1 = base
     * reg (0xFFFF = no base), src2 = value reg for stores or dst for loads. */
    GIR_LOAD_IDX_I32_U   = 0x00A0,
    GIR_LOAD_IDX_I64     = 0x00A1,
    GIR_STORE_IDX_I32    = 0x00A2,
    GIR_STORE_IDX_I64    = 0x00A3,

    /* kernel-VA load/store. addr = reg[src1] + (int32_t)imm. cap-gated. */
    GIR_KLOAD_I8         = 0x00B0,
    GIR_KLOAD_I16        = 0x00B1,
    GIR_KLOAD_I32        = 0x00B2,
    GIR_KLOAD_I64        = 0x00B3,
    GIR_KLOAD_V128       = 0x00B4,
    GIR_KSTORE_I8        = 0x00B5,
    GIR_KSTORE_I16       = 0x00B6,
    GIR_KSTORE_I32       = 0x00B7,
    GIR_KSTORE_I64       = 0x00B8,
    GIR_KSTORE_V128      = 0x00B9,
    /* base + index*scale + disp kernel-VA. same imm packing as LOAD_IDX. */
    GIR_KLOAD_IDX_I64    = 0x00BA,
    GIR_KSTORE_IDX_I64   = 0x00BB,

    /* segment-relative load. src1 = offset reg, imm = disp. base comes from
     * FSBASE or GSBASE (the guest exposes these via host imports so they can
     * be populated with KPCR/PRCB pointers before running lifted code). */
    GIR_FSLOAD_I64       = 0x00C0,
    GIR_GSLOAD_I64       = 0x00C1,
    GIR_FSSTORE_I64      = 0x00C2,
    GIR_GSSTORE_I64      = 0x00C3,

    /* control flow. imm = target instruction index within current function. */
    GIR_BR               = 0x00D0,
    GIR_BR_IF            = 0x00D1,
    GIR_BR_IF_NOT        = 0x00D2,
    GIR_BR_TABLE         = 0x00D3,
    GIR_RETURN           = 0x00D4,
    GIR_JCC              = 0x00D5,   /* dst=cc_code, src1=flags_reg, imm=target */

    /* calls. */
    GIR_CALL             = 0x00E0,   /* imm = target fn idx; args start at reg[src1] */
    GIR_CALL_INDIRECT    = 0x00E1,   /* fn = ftable[reg[src1]]; args from reg[src2]; imm[63:32] = argc */
    GIR_HOST_CALL        = 0x00E2,   /* dst = hosts[imm](reg[src1..src1+src2-1]); src2 = argc */
    GIR_CALL_ABS_KVA     = 0x00E3,   /* raw kernel-va call. src1 = fn kva reg, args reg[src2..src2+argc-1], imm[63:32]=argc. cap-gated. */

    /* conditional move / set / select. */
    GIR_SELECT           = 0x00F0,   /* dst = reg[src1] ? reg[src2] : reg[(uint16_t)imm] */
    GIR_CMOV             = 0x00F1,   /* if cc(flags) then dst = src2 (dst=out, src1=flags_reg, imm[15:0]=cc_code) */
    GIR_SETCC            = 0x00F2,   /* dst = cc(flags) ? 1 : 0 (src1=flags_reg, src2=cc_code) */

    /* bit test / set / reset / complement. addr in reg[src1], bit in reg[src2].
     * for BT variants dst gets old bit as 0/1. BTS/BTR/BTC write the bit back. */
    GIR_BT_I64           = 0x0100,
    GIR_BTS_I64          = 0x0101,
    GIR_BTR_I64          = 0x0102,
    GIR_BTC_I64          = 0x0103,
    GIR_BSF_I32          = 0x0104,   /* forward bit scan */
    GIR_BSF_I64          = 0x0105,
    GIR_BSR_I32          = 0x0106,   /* reverse bit scan */
    GIR_BSR_I64          = 0x0107,
    GIR_LZCNT_I32        = 0x0108,
    GIR_LZCNT_I64        = 0x0109,
    GIR_TZCNT_I32        = 0x010A,
    GIR_TZCNT_I64        = 0x010B,

    /* flag-writing arithmetic. same operands as the plain versions plus a
     * flags-dst register carried in imm[15:0]. writes the resulting eflags
     * bit pattern (CF/PF/AF/ZF/SF/OF packed x86-style) into reg[flag_reg]. */
    GIR_ADD_F_I32        = 0x0120,
    GIR_ADD_F_I64        = 0x0121,
    GIR_SUB_F_I32        = 0x0122,
    GIR_SUB_F_I64        = 0x0123,
    GIR_MUL_F_I32        = 0x0124,
    GIR_MUL_F_I64        = 0x0125,
    GIR_AND_F_I32        = 0x0126,
    GIR_AND_F_I64        = 0x0127,
    GIR_OR_F_I32         = 0x0128,
    GIR_OR_F_I64         = 0x0129,
    GIR_XOR_F_I32        = 0x012A,
    GIR_XOR_F_I64        = 0x012B,
    GIR_SHL_F_I32        = 0x012C,
    GIR_SHL_F_I64        = 0x012D,
    GIR_SHR_U_F_I32      = 0x012E,
    GIR_SHR_U_F_I64      = 0x012F,
    GIR_SHR_S_F_I32      = 0x0130,
    GIR_SHR_S_F_I64      = 0x0131,
    GIR_NEG_F_I32        = 0x0132,
    GIR_NEG_F_I64        = 0x0133,
    GIR_INC_F_I32        = 0x0134,   /* inc/dec do not touch CF, matching x86 */
    GIR_INC_F_I64        = 0x0135,
    GIR_DEC_F_I32        = 0x0136,
    GIR_DEC_F_I64        = 0x0137,
    /* CMP/TEST equivalents: compute flags without writing dst. */
    GIR_CMP_F_I32        = 0x0138,   /* flags = a - b, dst unused */
    GIR_CMP_F_I64        = 0x0139,
    GIR_TEST_F_I32       = 0x013A,   /* flags = a & b, dst unused */
    GIR_TEST_F_I64       = 0x013B,

    /* string primitives. imm packs {size_log2:8, dir_reg:16, count_reg:16, unused:24}.
     * these implement REP MOVS/STOS/CMPS/SCAS from x86. addr regs and
     * counter reg are read-modified by the interpreter to match REP
     * semantics. dst gets the final ZF for CMPS/SCAS, 0 for MOVS/STOS. */
    GIR_REP_MOVSB        = 0x0150,   /* src2 = src ptr, src1 = dst ptr */
    GIR_REP_STOSB        = 0x0151,   /* src2 = value reg (uses low 8), src1 = dst ptr */
    GIR_REP_CMPSB        = 0x0152,
    GIR_REP_SCASB        = 0x0153,
    GIR_REP_MOVSW        = 0x0154,
    GIR_REP_STOSW        = 0x0155,
    GIR_REP_MOVSD        = 0x0156,
    GIR_REP_STOSD        = 0x0157,
    GIR_REP_MOVSQ        = 0x0158,
    GIR_REP_STOSQ        = 0x0159,

    /* sse integer ops. all operate on xmm reg pairs. dst refers to the
     * FIRST slot of the pair. */
    GIR_XMM_PXOR         = 0x0180,
    GIR_XMM_POR          = 0x0181,
    GIR_XMM_PAND         = 0x0182,
    GIR_XMM_PANDN        = 0x0183,
    GIR_XMM_PADDB        = 0x0184,
    GIR_XMM_PADDW        = 0x0185,
    GIR_XMM_PADDD        = 0x0186,
    GIR_XMM_PADDQ        = 0x0187,
    GIR_XMM_PSUBB        = 0x0188,
    GIR_XMM_PSUBW        = 0x0189,
    GIR_XMM_PSUBD        = 0x018A,
    GIR_XMM_PSUBQ        = 0x018B,
    GIR_XMM_PCMPEQB      = 0x018C,
    GIR_XMM_PCMPEQW      = 0x018D,
    GIR_XMM_PCMPEQD      = 0x018E,
    GIR_XMM_PSHUFB       = 0x018F,
    GIR_XMM_PMOVMSKB     = 0x0190,   /* gpr dst = movemask(src pair) */
    GIR_XMM_PSLLQ_IMM    = 0x0191,
    GIR_XMM_PSRLQ_IMM    = 0x0192,
    GIR_XMM_PUNPCKLBW    = 0x0193,
    GIR_XMM_PUNPCKHBW    = 0x0194,
    GIR_XMM_MOVQ_TO_GPR  = 0x0195,   /* gpr dst = low 64 of xmm src */
    GIR_XMM_MOVQ_FROM_GPR= 0x0196,   /* xmm dst = zero-extended gpr src */

    /* atomics on kernel VAs. locked, hardware-ordered. */
    GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I32  = 0x01B0,
    GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I64  = 0x01B1,
    GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I32   = 0x01B2,
    GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I64   = 0x01B3,
    GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I32   = 0x01B4,
    GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I64   = 0x01B5,
    GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I32   = 0x01B6,
    GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I64   = 0x01B7,
    GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I32    = 0x01B8,
    GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I64    = 0x01B9,
    GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I32   = 0x01BA,
    GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I64   = 0x01BB,
    GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I32   = 0x01BC,   /* imm[15:0] = exp reg */
    GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I64   = 0x01BD,
    GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I128  = 0x01BE,   /* imm[15:0]=exp low reg, imm[31:16]=exp high reg. dst gets 1/0 on success */
    GIR_ATOMIC_BTS_I64   = 0x01BF,
    GIR_ATOMIC_BTR_I64   = 0x01C0,

    /* guest stack management. GIR guarantees a scratch region at the top of
     * linear memory sized stack_pages; RSP starts pointing at the top. */
    GIR_STACK_PUSH       = 0x01D0,   /* [rsp - 8] = src1; rsp -= 8 */
    GIR_STACK_POP        = 0x01D1,   /* dst = [rsp]; rsp += 8 */
    GIR_STACK_ALLOC      = 0x01D2,   /* rsp -= imm */
    GIR_STACK_FREE       = 0x01D3,   /* rsp += imm */

    /* seh scaffolding. TRY_BEGIN/END delimit a protected range. RAISE raises
     * an exception with a synthesized ExceptionRecord code in imm. the
     * interpreter matches the innermost enclosing scope; if none, traps. */
    GIR_TRY_BEGIN        = 0x01E0,   /* imm = scope idx into gir_seh_scope table */
    GIR_TRY_END          = 0x01E1,
    GIR_RAISE            = 0x01E2,   /* imm = exception code (matches EXCEPTION_RECORD.ExceptionCode) */
    GIR_RESUME           = 0x01E3,   /* branch back into the parent function after a handler returns */

    /* control-flow guard: verify that reg[src1] is a legal indirect call
     * target within the module. traps if not. lifter emits before CALL_INDIRECT
     * when the source PE was built with /guard:cf. */
    GIR_CFG_CHECK        = 0x01F0,

    /* debug intrinsics. cheap, always allowed, useful for tracing lifted code. */
    GIR_DBG_MARK         = 0x0200,   /* imm = marker id */
    GIR_DBG_TRACE        = 0x0201,   /* prints reg values, argc packed in src2 */

    /* floating point */
    GIR_CONST_F32        = 0x0220,   /* dst = (uint32_t)imm, treated as f32 bit pattern */
    GIR_CONST_F64        = 0x0221,   /* dst = imm, treated as f64 bit pattern */

    GIR_FADD_F32         = 0x0222,
    GIR_FADD_F64         = 0x0223,
    GIR_FSUB_F32         = 0x0224,
    GIR_FSUB_F64         = 0x0225,
    GIR_FMUL_F32         = 0x0226,
    GIR_FMUL_F64         = 0x0227,
    GIR_FDIV_F32         = 0x0228,
    GIR_FDIV_F64         = 0x0229,
    GIR_FNEG_F32         = 0x022A,
    GIR_FNEG_F64         = 0x022B,
    GIR_FABS_F32         = 0x022C,
    GIR_FABS_F64         = 0x022D,
    GIR_FSQRT_F32        = 0x022E,
    GIR_FSQRT_F64        = 0x022F,
    GIR_FMIN_F32         = 0x0230,
    GIR_FMIN_F64         = 0x0231,
    GIR_FMAX_F32         = 0x0232,
    GIR_FMAX_F64         = 0x0233,
    GIR_FCEIL_F32        = 0x0234,
    GIR_FCEIL_F64        = 0x0235,
    GIR_FFLOOR_F32       = 0x0236,
    GIR_FFLOOR_F64       = 0x0237,
    GIR_FTRUNC_F32       = 0x0238,
    GIR_FTRUNC_F64       = 0x0239,
    GIR_FNEAREST_F32     = 0x023A,
    GIR_FNEAREST_F64     = 0x023B,
    GIR_FCOPYSIGN_F32    = 0x023C,
    GIR_FCOPYSIGN_F64    = 0x023D,

    /* f cmps produce 0/1 in dst; NaN operands always yield 0 for LT/LE/GT/GE
     * and always yield 0 for EQ / 1 for NE (IEEE unordered behavior). */
    GIR_FEQ_F32          = 0x0240,
    GIR_FEQ_F64          = 0x0241,
    GIR_FNE_F32          = 0x0242,
    GIR_FNE_F64          = 0x0243,
    GIR_FLT_F32          = 0x0244,
    GIR_FLT_F64          = 0x0245,
    GIR_FLE_F32          = 0x0246,
    GIR_FLE_F64          = 0x0247,
    GIR_FGT_F32          = 0x0248,
    GIR_FGT_F64          = 0x0249,
    GIR_FGE_F32          = 0x024A,
    GIR_FGE_F64          = 0x024B,

    GIR_F32_TO_F64       = 0x0250,
    GIR_F64_TO_F32       = 0x0251,
    /* float -> int: saturating truncation. NaN yields 0; out-of-range values
     * clamp to the target type's min/max. matches wasm's saturating conversion. */
    GIR_F32_TO_I32_S     = 0x0252,
    GIR_F32_TO_I32_U     = 0x0253,
    GIR_F32_TO_I64_S     = 0x0254,
    GIR_F32_TO_I64_U     = 0x0255,
    GIR_F64_TO_I32_S     = 0x0256,
    GIR_F64_TO_I32_U     = 0x0257,
    GIR_F64_TO_I64_S     = 0x0258,
    GIR_F64_TO_I64_U     = 0x0259,
    GIR_I32_S_TO_F32     = 0x025A,
    GIR_I32_U_TO_F32     = 0x025B,
    GIR_I32_S_TO_F64     = 0x025C,
    GIR_I32_U_TO_F64     = 0x025D,
    GIR_I64_S_TO_F32     = 0x025E,
    GIR_I64_U_TO_F32     = 0x025F,
    GIR_I64_S_TO_F64     = 0x0260,
    GIR_I64_U_TO_F64     = 0x0261,
    /* bit-level reinterpret (no numeric conversion) */
    GIR_F32_REINT_I32    = 0x0262,
    GIR_F64_REINT_I64    = 0x0263,
    GIR_I32_REINT_F32    = 0x0264,
    GIR_I64_REINT_F64    = 0x0265,

    /* pseudo op, removed by verifier if it survives. */
    GIR_PHI              = 0x0FF0,

    GIR_OP_MAX           = 0x1000
};

/* trap codes reported back to the driver / user. */
enum {
    GIR_TRAP_NONE            = 0,
    GIR_TRAP_UNREACHABLE     = 1,
    GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO     = 2,
    GIR_TRAP_INT_OVERFLOW    = 3,
    GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB         = 4,
    GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED     = 5,
    GIR_TRAP_CAP_DENIED      = 6,
