```h
    GIR_TRAP_INDIRECT_TYPE   = 8,
    GIR_TRAP_HOST_INDEX_OOB  = 9,
    GIR_TRAP_FN_INDEX_OOB    = 10,
    GIR_TRAP_FUEL_EXHAUSTED  = 11,
    GIR_TRAP_DEADLINE        = 12,
    GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR      = 13,
    GIR_TRAP_VERIFIER        = 14,
    GIR_TRAP_INT3            = 15,
    GIR_TRAP_HLT             = 16,
    GIR_TRAP_SEH_UNCAUGHT    = 17,
    GIR_TRAP_CFG_VIOLATION   = 18,

    GIR_TRAP_STACK_MISALIGN  = 20,
    GIR_TRAP_ALIGNMENT       = 21,
    GIR_TRAP_UNSUPPORTED_OP  = 22
};

#define GIR_FLAG_LIFTED_PE      (1u << 0)
```

```gasm
; signed max via cmpf64 + cmov 'g'.
.func smax regs=6 args=2 returns=1
    mov      r2, r0

    cmov     r2, r3, r1, b
    return   r2
.end
```

`modules/fib.gasm`:

```gasm
.module     "fib"
.caps       0
.mem_pages  1

.export fib

; recursive fib. exercises internal CALL and RETURN.
.func fib regs=8 args=1 returns=1
    const64  r1, 2
    ltu64    r2, r0, r1        ; r2 = n < 2
    br_if    r2, base
    ; r3 = fib(n - 1)
    const64  r4, 1
    sub64    r5, r0, r4
    mov      r6, r5             ; args_base = r6, put n-1 at r6
    call     r3, fib, r6
    ; r4 = fib(n - 2)
    const64  r7, 2
    sub64    r5, r0, r7
    mov      r6, r5
    call     r4, fib, r6
    add64    r0, r3, r4
    return   r0
base:
    return   r0
.end
```

`modules/pslist.gasm`:

```gasm
.module     "pslist"
.caps       read_kmem | hostcall | introspect
.mem_pages  2

.import     nt.resolve
.import     k.read64
.import     k.read_bytes
.import     io.log

; the ansi form of "PsLoadedModuleList" as UTF-16, laid out in linear mem
; so nt.resolve can look it up. total 36 bytes = 18 UTF-16 code units.
.data 0    "PsLoadedModuleList\0"

; scratch buffer for module names copied out of kernel memory.
; base name is stored at KLDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY + 0x58 (UNICODE_STRING).
;   +0x58 (2 bytes) length in bytes
;   +0x5A (2 bytes) max length
;   +0x60 (8 bytes) buffer pointer (KVA)
.data 128  "\0"

.export     count_modules

; count_modules() returns the number of entries in PsLoadedModuleList,
; walking the doubly-linked list forward until it wraps back to the head.
; each entry begins with a LIST_ENTRY {Flink, Blink}. we read Flink at
; offset +0 of each node.
.func count_modules regs=16 args=0 returns=1
    ; resolve the symbol -> its KVA is the address of the LIST_ENTRY head
    const32  r0, 0                ; name off in guest mem
    const32  r1, 18               ; name length in UTF-16 code units
    hostcall r2, nt.resolve, r0, 2
    const64  r3, 0
    eq64     r4, r2, r3
    br_if    r4, done_zero        ; symbol not found

    ; walk. r2 = &head, r5 = current node
    mov      r5, r2
    const64  r6, 1                ; count starts at 1 (we'll walk to head)
    hostcall r7, k.read64, r5, 1
    mov      r5, r7                ; current = head->Flink
    const64  r8, 0                ; entries seen

loop:
    eq64     r9, r5, r2            ; back to head?
    br_if    r9, done
    addi64   r8, r8, 1
    hostcall r7, k.read64, r5, 1
    mov      r5, r7
    ; safety cap so a corrupt list doesn't spin forever
    const64  r10, 4096
    ltu64    r11, r8, r10
    br_if    r11, loop
done:
    mov      r0, r8
    return   r0
done_zero:
    const64  r0, 0
    return   r0
.end

```

`modules/seh_demo.gasm`:

```gasm
.module     "seh_demo"
.caps       0
.mem_pages  1

.import     seh.last_code

.export     try_it
.export     try_propagate

; try { raise 0xC0000005 } __except(filter) { after-scope reads last_code }
; the filter returns 1 (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) so control resumes past
; try_end where we query last_code and return it.

.func try_it regs=6 args=0 returns=1
try_start:
    try_begin 0
    raise    0xC0000005
try_end:
    try_end  0
    hostcall r0, seh.last_code, r0, 0
    return   r0
.end

; filter that catches everything
.func filter_catch regs=4 args=2 returns=1
    const64  r0, 1
    return   r0
.end

; filter that never catches -> exception propagates out of the module
.func filter_pass regs=4 args=2 returns=1
    const64  r0, 0
    return   r0
.end

; second entry demonstrating filter returning 0. this MUST trap
; SEH_UNCAUGHT (17) since there's no outer scope.
.func try_propagate regs=4 args=0 returns=1
propagate_start:
    try_begin 1
    raise    0xDEADBEEF
propagate_end:
    try_end  1
    const64  r0, 0
    return   r0
.end

.seh try_it        begin=try_start       end=try_end       handler=filter_catch kind=except
.seh try_propagate begin=propagate_start end=propagate_end handler=filter_pass  kind=except

```

`modules/seh_demo.test`:

```test

# the saved exception code via seh.last_code
```

`modules/seh_finally.gasm`:

```gasm
.module     "seh_finally"
.caps       0
.mem_pages  1

.export     normal_path
.export     raise_path

; a shared "finally counter" in linear memory at offset 0
.data 0 "\0\0\0\0\0\0\0\0"

; the finally handler increments the counter each time it runs. it receives
; (code, addr) but ignores both; its return value is discarded.
.func fin_bump regs=4 args=2 returns=1
    const64  r2, 0
    load64   r3, r2, 0
    addi64   r3, r3, 1
    store64  r2, r3, 0
    const64  r0, 0
    return   r0
.end

; normal_path: run try body normally; finally bumps once; return counter.
.func normal_path regs=4 args=0 returns=1
start_n:
    try_begin 0
    const64  r0, 42          ; dummy body
end_n:
    try_end   0
    const64  r1, 0
    load64   r0, r1, 0
    return   r0
.end

; raise_path: try body raises; finally still runs during unwind. no outer
; scope catches so we get SEH_UNCAUGHT trap. before the trap, finally bumps
; the counter; the trap prevents us from returning it, but the test just
; checks that the trap fires with code 17.
.func raise_path regs=4 args=0 returns=1
start_r:
    try_begin 1
    raise    0xC0000005
end_r:
    try_end   1
    const64  r0, 0
    return   r0
.end

.seh normal_path begin=start_n end=end_n handler=fin_bump kind=finally
.seh raise_path  begin=start_r end=end_r handler=fin_bump kind=finally

```

`modules/seh_finally.test`:

```test
# seh_finally.gasm.
# normal_path: try body runs, finally bumps counter to 1, returns it.
run normal_path 0 => 1

# raise_path: try body raises, finally runs during unwind, then SEH_UNCAUGHT
# because no outer scope catches.

```

`modules/stack_recursion.gasm`:

```gasm
.module      "stack_recursion"
.caps        0
.mem_pages   4
.stack_pages 2

.export fact

; classic recursive factorial. exercises push/pop on the guest stack around
; the recursive call so callee-clobbered scratch is preserved. arg0=n.
.func fact regs=8 args=1 returns=1
    const64  r1, 1
    ltu64    r2, r0, r1               ; n < 1 ?
    br_if    r2, base
    push     r0                        ; save n across call
    subi64   r0, r0, 1                 ; recurse(n-1)
    call     r3, fact, r0
    pop      r0                        ; restore n
    mul64    r0, r0, r3                ; r0 = n * fact(n-1)
    return   r0
base:
    const64  r0, 1
    return   r0
.end

```

`modules/substr_search.gasm`:

```gasm
.module     "substr_search"
.caps       0
.mem_pages  1

.export     find

; find(haystack_off, hay_len, needle_off, needle_len) -> offset of first match,
; or 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF if no match. exercises nested loops, load8, cmov, jcc.
;
; args: r0=hay_off, r1=hay_len, r2=needle_off, r3=needle_len

.func find regs=16 args=4 returns=1
    const64  r4, 0                ; i (outer index into haystack)

outer:
    ; if i + needle_len > hay_len: return -1
    addf64   r5, r4, r3, r15       ; r5 = i + needle_len; r15 = flags
    ltu64    r6, r1, r5
    br_if    r6, notfound

    const64  r7, 0                ; j (inner index)
inner:
    eq64     r8, r7, r3            ; done matching?
    br_if    r8, matched

    ; hay_byte = mem[hay_off + i + j]
    add64    r9, r0, r4
    add64    r9, r9, r7
    load8u   r10, r9, 0

    ; needle_byte = mem[needle_off + j]
    add64    r11, r2, r7
    load8u   r12, r11, 0

    ne64     r13, r10, r12
    br_if    r13, next_i

    addi64   r7, r7, 1
    br       inner

matched:
    mov      r0, r4
    return   r0

next_i:
    addi64   r4, r4, 1
    br       outer

notfound:
    const64  r0, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    return   r0
.end

```

`modules/substr_search.test`:

```test

# needle at offset 64: "brown"

# needle at offset 112: "cat" (not present)

# needle longer than haystack -> not found
```

`modules/xmm_hash.gasm`:

```gasm
.module     "xmm_hash"
.caps       0
.mem_pages  1

; simple 128-bit accumulator: reads a 16-byte block from linear memory at
; offset arg0 and folds it into an accumulator via pxor + paddq, returns
; the low 64 bits. demonstrates xmm register pairs r32:r33, r34:r35.
.export fold128

.func fold128 regs=64 args=1 returns=1
    load_v128  r32, r0, 0          ; xmm0 = mem[arg0 .. +16]
    const64    r34, 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15
    const64    r35, 0xBB67AE8584CAA73B
    pxor       r32, r32, r34       ; xmm0 ^= xmm1
    paddq      r32, r32, r34       ; xmm0 += xmm1 (packed 2x64)
    movq2gpr   r0, r32             ; low 64 of xmm0 -> r0
    return     r0
.end

```

`src/exec.c`:

```c
/* exec.c - interpreter dispatch loop */
#include "gexec.h"
#include "gexec_platform.h"
#ifdef _KERNEL_MODE
#include <intrin.h>
#endif

/* the compiler emits a reference to _fltused whenever it sees any float
 * op; the kernel CRT doesn't provide it so define our own. */
int _fltused = 0;

/* float helpers. kernel-mode float use requires KeSaveFloatingPointState
 * which the ioctl_call path wraps around the entire interpreter run.
 * we cannot link against libm in a driver, so all math is done via
 * hardware instructions expressed through SSE intrinsics or by direct
 * computation. */
static float    _u32_to_f32(uint32_t u) { union { uint32_t u; float f; } c; c.u = u; return c.f; }
static uint32_t _f32_to_u32(float f)    { union { uint32_t u; float f; } c; c.f = f; return c.u; }
static double   _u64_to_f64(uint64_t u) { union { uint64_t u; double d; } c; c.u = u; return c.d; }
static uint64_t _f64_to_u64(double d)   { union { uint64_t u; double d; } c; c.d = d; return c.u; }

static int _isnan32(float f) { return f != f; }
static int _isnan64(double d) { return d != d; }

static float _sqrtf_hw(float x) {
    __m128 v = _mm_set_ss(x);
    v = _mm_sqrt_ss(v);
    return _mm_cvtss_f32(v);
}
static double _sqrt_hw(double x) {
    __m128d v = _mm_set_sd(x);
    v = _mm_sqrt_sd(v, v);
    return _mm_cvtsd_f64(v);
}

/* SSE4.1 rounding requires the mode be a compile-time constant, so each
 * rounding kind needs its own wrapper. 0x08 = suppress-exception flag. */
static float  _ceilf_hw(float x)  { __m128 v=_mm_set_ss(x); v=_mm_round_ss(v, v, 2 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtss_f32(v); }
static float  _floorf_hw(float x) { __m128 v=_mm_set_ss(x); v=_mm_round_ss(v, v, 1 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtss_f32(v); }
static float  _truncf_hw(float x) { __m128 v=_mm_set_ss(x); v=_mm_round_ss(v, v, 3 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtss_f32(v); }
static float  _rintf_hw(float x)  { __m128 v=_mm_set_ss(x); v=_mm_round_ss(v, v, 0 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtss_f32(v); }
static double _ceil_hw(double x)  { __m128d v=_mm_set_sd(x); v=_mm_round_sd(v, v, 2 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtsd_f64(v); }
static double _floor_hw(double x) { __m128d v=_mm_set_sd(x); v=_mm_round_sd(v, v, 1 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtsd_f64(v); }
static double _trunc_hw(double x) { __m128d v=_mm_set_sd(x); v=_mm_round_sd(v, v, 3 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtsd_f64(v); }
static double _rint_hw(double x)  { __m128d v=_mm_set_sd(x); v=_mm_round_sd(v, v, 0 | 0x08); return _mm_cvtsd_f64(v); }

static uint64_t _fsat_i32_s(double v) {
    if (_isnan64(v)) return 0;
    if (v <= -2147483648.0) return (uint32_t)0x80000000u;
    if (v >=  2147483647.0) return (uint32_t)0x7FFFFFFFu;
    return (uint32_t)(int32_t)v;
}
static uint64_t _fsat_i32_u(double v) {
    if (_isnan64(v) || v <= 0) return 0;
    if (v >= 4294967295.0) return 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    return (uint32_t)v;
}
static uint64_t _fsat_i64_s(double v) {
    if (_isnan64(v)) return 0;
    if (v <= -9223372036854775808.0) return (uint64_t)0x8000000000000000ull;
    if (v >=  9223372036854775807.0) return (uint64_t)0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
    return (uint64_t)(int64_t)v;
}
static uint64_t _fsat_i64_u(double v) {
    if (_isnan64(v) || v <= 0) return 0;
    if (v >= 18446744073709551615.0) return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
    return (uint64_t)v;
}

/* helper macros */

#define TRAP(code, msg) do {                                    \
    ctx->trap = (code);                                         \
    for (unsigned _i = 0; _i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; _i++){\
        char _c = (msg)[_i];                                    \
        ctx->trap_msg[_i] = _c;                                 \
        if (!_c) break;                                         \
    }                                                           \
    ctx->trap_msg[sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1] = 0;               \
    return 0;                                                   \
} while (0)

#ifdef _KERNEL_MODE
#define CHECK_DEADLINE()                                        \
    if (ctx->deadline_qpc) {                                    \
        LARGE_INTEGER _n = KeQueryPerformanceCounter(NULL);     \
        if ((ULONG64)_n.QuadPart > ctx->deadline_qpc)           \
            TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DEADLINE, "execution deadline");      \
    }
#else
#define CHECK_DEADLINE() do { } while (0)
#endif

#define BURN_FUEL(n) do {                                       \
    if (ctx->fuel) {                                            \
        if (ctx->fuel <= (n)) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_FUEL_EXHAUSTED, "fuel");\
        ctx->fuel -= (n);                                       \
    }                                                           \
} while (0)

/* flag computation */

static const uint8_t g_parity_lut[256] = {
#define P2(n)  n,     n^1,   n^1,   n
#define P4(n)  P2(n), P2(n^1), P2(n^1), P2(n)
#define P6(n)  P4(n), P4(n^1), P4(n^1), P4(n)
    P6(0), P6(1), P6(1), P6(0)
};

static uint64_t
flags_arith(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t r, uint32_t size, int is_sub, int carry_out)
{
    uint64_t f = 0;
    uint64_t mask   = (size == 4) ? 0xFFFFFFFFull : ~0ull;
    uint64_t signbit = (size == 4) ? 0x80000000ull : 0x8000000000000000ull;
    uint64_t ra = r & mask;
    uint64_t aa = a & mask;
    uint64_t bb = b & mask;

    if (ra == 0) f |= GIR_EF_ZF;
    if (ra & signbit) f |= GIR_EF_SF;
    if (g_parity_lut[ra & 0xFF]) f |= GIR_EF_PF;

    /* AF: carry/borrow from bit 3 to bit 4 */
    uint64_t af_bit;
    if (is_sub) af_bit = ((aa & 0xF) < ((bb & 0xF) + (carry_out & 1))) ? GIR_EF_AF : 0;
    else        af_bit = (((aa & 0xF) + (bb & 0xF) + (carry_out & 1)) & 0x10) ? GIR_EF_AF : 0;
    f |= af_bit;

    /* CF and OF */
    if (is_sub) {
        if (aa < bb) f |= GIR_EF_CF;
        uint64_t ov = ((aa ^ bb) & (aa ^ ra)) & signbit;
        if (ov) f |= GIR_EF_OF;
    } else {
        uint64_t sum_hi = (aa >> 1) + (bb >> 1) + (((aa & 1) + (bb & 1)) >> 1);
        if (sum_hi & signbit) f |= GIR_EF_CF;
        uint64_t ov = (~(aa ^ bb) & (aa ^ ra)) & signbit;
        if (ov) f |= GIR_EF_OF;
    }
    return f;
}

static uint64_t
flags_logic(uint64_t r, uint32_t size)
{
    uint64_t f = 0;
    uint64_t mask   = (size == 4) ? 0xFFFFFFFFull : ~0ull;
    uint64_t signbit = (size == 4) ? 0x80000000ull : 0x8000000000000000ull;
    uint64_t ra = r & mask;
    if (ra == 0) f |= GIR_EF_ZF;
    if (ra & signbit) f |= GIR_EF_SF;
    if (g_parity_lut[ra & 0xFF]) f |= GIR_EF_PF;
    /* AND/OR/XOR leave CF=0, OF=0, AF undefined per intel (we set 0) */
    return f;
}

static uint64_t
flags_shift(uint64_t r, uint64_t last_out_bit, uint32_t size, int count)
{
    uint64_t f = 0;
    if (count == 0) return 0;                       /* zero-count shifts leave flags unchanged; caller handles */
    uint64_t mask = (size == 4) ? 0xFFFFFFFFull : ~0ull;
    uint64_t signbit = (size == 4) ? 0x80000000ull : 0x8000000000000000ull;
    uint64_t ra = r & mask;
    if (ra == 0) f |= GIR_EF_ZF;
    if (ra & signbit) f |= GIR_EF_SF;
    if (g_parity_lut[ra & 0xFF]) f |= GIR_EF_PF;
    if (last_out_bit & 1) f |= GIR_EF_CF;
    /* OF for count == 1 defined; otherwise undefined. we always compute. */
    return f;
}

static int
cc_true(uint32_t cc, uint64_t flags)
{
    switch (cc & 15) {
    case GIR_CC_O:  return (flags & GIR_EF_OF) != 0;
    case GIR_CC_NO: return (flags & GIR_EF_OF) == 0;
    case GIR_CC_B:  return (flags & GIR_EF_CF) != 0;
    case GIR_CC_AE: return (flags & GIR_EF_CF) == 0;
    case GIR_CC_E:  return (flags & GIR_EF_ZF) != 0;
    case GIR_CC_NE: return (flags & GIR_EF_ZF) == 0;
    case GIR_CC_BE: return (flags & (GIR_EF_CF | GIR_EF_ZF)) != 0;
    case GIR_CC_A:  return (flags & (GIR_EF_CF | GIR_EF_ZF)) == 0;
    case GIR_CC_S:  return (flags & GIR_EF_SF) != 0;
    case GIR_CC_NS: return (flags & GIR_EF_SF) == 0;
    case GIR_CC_P:  return (flags & GIR_EF_PF) != 0;
    case GIR_CC_NP: return (flags & GIR_EF_PF) == 0;
    case GIR_CC_L:  return ((flags & GIR_EF_SF) != 0) != ((flags & GIR_EF_OF) != 0);
    case GIR_CC_GE: return ((flags & GIR_EF_SF) != 0) == ((flags & GIR_EF_OF) != 0);
    case GIR_CC_LE: return (flags & GIR_EF_ZF) != 0 ||
                           (((flags & GIR_EF_SF) != 0) != ((flags & GIR_EF_OF) != 0));
    case GIR_CC_G:  return (flags & GIR_EF_ZF) == 0 &&
                           (((flags & GIR_EF_SF) != 0) == ((flags & GIR_EF_OF) != 0));
    }
    return 0;
}

/* memory bounds checks */

static int
mem_check(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint64_t addr, uint32_t size)
{
    uint64_t end = addr + size;
    if (end < addr || end > ctx->mod->mem_size) {
        ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_MEM_OOB;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; i++) {
            char c = "linear memory OOB"[i]; ctx->trap_msg[i] = c; if (!c) break;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
kmem_check(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint64_t addr, uint32_t size)
{
#ifdef _KERNEL_MODE
    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() > APC_LEVEL) {
        ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; i++) { char c = "kmem above APC_LEVEL"[i]; ctx->trap_msg[i] = c; if (!c) break; }
        return 0;
    }
    uint64_t end = addr + size;
    if (end < addr) { ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED; return 0; }
    uint64_t hi = addr >> 48;
    if (hi != 0x0000 && hi != 0xFFFF) { ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED; return 0; }
    for (uint64_t p = addr & ~0xFFFull; p < end; p += 0x1000ull) {
        if (!MmIsAddressValid((PVOID)(uintptr_t)p)) {
            ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_KMEM_DENIED;
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; i++) { char c = "kmem target not mapped"[i]; ctx->trap_msg[i] = c; if (!c) break; }
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
#else
    (void)ctx; (void)addr; (void)size;
    return 0;
#endif
}

/* frame stack management */

static int
push_frame(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint32_t fn_idx, uint16_t dst, uint16_t returns_void,
           const uint64_t* args, unsigned argc)
{
    if (ctx->top >= GEXEC_MAX_CALL_DEPTH) {
        ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_STACK_OVERFLOW; return 0;
    }
    if (fn_idx >= ctx->mod->n_fns) {
        ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_FN_INDEX_OOB; return 0;
    }
    const gexec_function* fn = &ctx->mod->fns[fn_idx];

    uint32_t next_base = 0;
    if (ctx->top > 0) {
        gexec_frame* pf = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
        next_base = pf->reg_base + pf->fn->n_regs;
    }
    if ((uint64_t)next_base + fn->n_regs > ctx->mod->reg_stack_slots) {
        ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_STACK_OVERFLOW; return 0;
    }

    gexec_frame* nf = &ctx->frames[ctx->top++];
    nf->fn              = fn;
    nf->pc              = 0;
    nf->reg_base        = next_base;
    nf->dst_reg         = dst;
    nf->returns_void    = returns_void;
    nf->seh_stack_depth = ctx->seh_depth;
    nf->post_action     = GEXEC_POST_NONE;
    nf->post_scope      = 0;
    nf->post_code       = 0;
    nf->post_addr       = 0;

    uint64_t* regs = &ctx->mod->reg_stack[next_base];
    gexec_memzero(regs, fn->n_regs * sizeof(uint64_t));
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < argc && i < fn->n_args; i++) regs[i] = args[i];
    /* initialize RSP for the frame if the module uses the stack model. */
    if (ctx->mod->stack_pages && fn->n_regs > GIR_REG_RSP) {
        if (ctx->top == 1) regs[GIR_REG_RSP] = ctx->mod->stack_top;
        else regs[GIR_REG_RSP] = ctx->mod->reg_stack[ctx->frames[ctx->top - 2].reg_base + GIR_REG_RSP];
    }
    return 1;
}

/* seh unwinding. walks seh_stack top-down looking for a scope that can
 * receive the exception. filter/finally handlers are dispatched as fresh
 * call frames carrying a post_action so the RETURN handler can drive the
 * next step of the state machine. */
static int
raise_exception(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint32_t code, uint64_t addr_hint)
{
    ctx->last_exception_code = code;
    ctx->last_exception_addr = addr_hint;

    while (ctx->seh_depth > 0) {
        gexec_seh_active top = ctx->seh_stack[ctx->seh_depth - 1];
        if (top.scope_idx >= ctx->mod->n_seh) { ctx->seh_depth--; continue; }
        const gir_seh_scope* sc = &ctx->mod->seh[top.scope_idx];

        /* unwind frames above the scope's owner */
        while (ctx->top > top.frame_idx + 1) {
            ctx->top--;
            if (ctx->seh_depth > 0 && ctx->seh_stack[ctx->seh_depth - 1].frame_idx >= ctx->top) ctx->seh_depth--;
        }
        ctx->seh_depth--;   /* consume this scope entry */

        uint64_t args[2] = { code, addr_hint };
        if (!push_frame(ctx, sc->handler_fn, 0, 1, args, 2)) return 0;
        gexec_frame* hf = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
        hf->post_action = (sc->kind == GIR_SEH_FINALLY) ? GEXEC_POST_SEH_FIN_UNWIND : GEXEC_POST_SEH_FILTER;
        hf->post_scope  = top.scope_idx;
        hf->post_code   = code;
        hf->post_addr   = addr_hint;
        return 1;
    }

    ctx->trap = GIR_TRAP_SEH_UNCAUGHT;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ctx->trap_msg) - 1; i++) { char c = "uncaught SEH"[i]; ctx->trap_msg[i] = c; if (!c) break; }
    return 0;
}

/* string operation helpers */

static int
do_rep_movs(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint64_t* regs, uint16_t dst_reg, uint16_t src_reg,
            uint16_t cnt_reg, uint32_t elem_size, int df)
{
    uint64_t dst = regs[dst_reg];
    uint64_t src = regs[src_reg];
    uint64_t cnt = regs[cnt_reg];
    int64_t step = df ? -(int64_t)elem_size : (int64_t)elem_size;

    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        if (!mem_check(ctx, src, elem_size) || !mem_check(ctx, dst, elem_size)) return 0;
        gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + dst, ctx->mod->mem + src, elem_size);
        src = (uint64_t)((int64_t)src + step);
        dst = (uint64_t)((int64_t)dst + step);
    }
    regs[dst_reg] = dst;
    regs[src_reg] = src;
    regs[cnt_reg] = 0;
    return 1;
}

static int
do_rep_stos(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint64_t* regs, uint16_t dst_reg, uint16_t val_reg,
            uint16_t cnt_reg, uint32_t elem_size, int df)
{
    uint64_t dst = regs[dst_reg];
    uint64_t val = regs[val_reg];
    uint64_t cnt = regs[cnt_reg];
    int64_t step = df ? -(int64_t)elem_size : (int64_t)elem_size;

    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        if (!mem_check(ctx, dst, elem_size)) return 0;
        switch (elem_size) {
        case 1: ctx->mod->mem[dst] = (uint8_t)val; break;
        case 2: { uint16_t v = (uint16_t)val; gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + dst, &v, 2); break; }
        case 4: { uint32_t v = (uint32_t)val; gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + dst, &v, 4); break; }
        case 8: gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + dst, &val, 8); break;
        }
        dst = (uint64_t)((int64_t)dst + step);
    }
    regs[dst_reg] = dst;
    regs[cnt_reg] = 0;
    return 1;
}

/* main dispatch */

uint64_t
gexec_call(gexec_ctx* ctx, uint32_t fn_idx, const uint64_t* args, unsigned argc)
{
    if (!ctx || !ctx->mod) return 0;
    ctx->trap = 0;
    ctx->trap_msg[0] = 0;
    ctx->top = 0;
    ctx->seh_depth = 0;

    if (!push_frame(ctx, fn_idx, 0, 1, args, argc)) return 0;

    uint32_t poll = 0;

    for (;;) {
        gexec_frame*     f     = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
        const gir_insn*  insns = f->fn->insns;
        uint32_t         pc    = f->pc;
        uint64_t*        regs  = &ctx->mod->reg_stack[f->reg_base];
        uint32_t         n     = f->fn->n_insns;

        for (;;) {
            if (pc >= n) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_VERIFIER, "pc overran function");
            gir_insn in = insns[pc++];
            if ((++poll & 0x1FFFu) == 0) CHECK_DEADLINE();

            switch (in.op) {

            case GIR_NOP: break;
            case GIR_UNREACHABLE: TRAP(GIR_TRAP_UNREACHABLE, "unreachable");
            case GIR_TRAP:        TRAP((uint32_t)in.imm, "explicit trap");
            case GIR_MEM_FENCE:   _mm_mfence(); break;
            case GIR_MEM_LFENCE:  _mm_lfence(); break;
            case GIR_MEM_SFENCE:  _mm_sfence(); break;
            case GIR_HALT:        TRAP(GIR_TRAP_HLT, "halt");
            case GIR_INT3:        TRAP(GIR_TRAP_INT3, "int3");
            case GIR_CPU_PAUSE:   _mm_pause(); break;

            case GIR_CONST_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)in.imm; break;
            case GIR_CONST_I64: regs[in.dst] = in.imm; break;
            case GIR_CONST_V128: {
                if (pc >= n) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_VERIFIER, "const_v128 truncated");
                gir_insn hi = insns[pc++];
                regs[in.dst]     = in.imm;
                regs[in.dst + 1] = hi.imm;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_MOV:       regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_MOV_V128:
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1];
                regs[in.dst + 1] = regs[in.src1 + 1];
                break;

            case GIR_NEG_I32:    regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)(-(int32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_NEG_I64:    regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_NOT_I32:    regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)~(uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_NOT_I64:    regs[in.dst] = ~regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_BSWAP_I32:  regs[in.dst] = _byteswap_ulong((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_BSWAP_I64:  regs[in.dst] = _byteswap_uint64(regs[in.src1]); break;

            case GIR_CLZ_I32: { uint32_t v = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = v ? (_BitScanReverse(&r, v), 31 - r) : 32; break; }
            case GIR_CLZ_I64: { uint64_t v = regs[in.src1]; unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = v ? (_BitScanReverse64(&r, v), 63 - r) : 64; break; }
            case GIR_CTZ_I32: { uint32_t v = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = v ? (_BitScanForward(&r, v), r) : 32; break; }
            case GIR_CTZ_I64: { uint64_t v = regs[in.src1]; unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = v ? (_BitScanForward64(&r, v), r) : 64; break; }

            case GIR_LZCNT_I32: regs[in.dst] = __lzcnt((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_LZCNT_I64: regs[in.dst] = __lzcnt64(regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_TZCNT_I32: { unsigned long r; uint32_t v = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; regs[in.dst] = _BitScanForward(&r, v) ? r : 32; break; }
            case GIR_TZCNT_I64: { unsigned long r; uint64_t v = regs[in.src1]; regs[in.dst] = _BitScanForward64(&r, v) ? r : 64; break; }
            case GIR_POPCNT_I32: regs[in.dst] = __popcnt((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_POPCNT_I64: regs[in.dst] = __popcnt64(regs[in.src1]); break;

            case GIR_BSF_I32: { unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = _BitScanForward(&r, (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) ? r : 0; break; }
            case GIR_BSF_I64: { unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = _BitScanForward64(&r, regs[in.src1]) ? r : 0; break; }
            case GIR_BSR_I32: { unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = _BitScanReverse(&r, (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) ? r : 0; break; }
            case GIR_BSR_I64: { unsigned long r; regs[in.dst] = _BitScanReverse64(&r, regs[in.src1]) ? r : 0; break; }

            case GIR_EXTEND_I32_S: regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_EXTEND_I32_U: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_EXTEND_I16_S: regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int16_t)(uint16_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_EXTEND_I16_U: regs[in.dst] = (uint16_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_EXTEND_I8_S:  regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int8_t)(uint8_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_EXTEND_I8_U:  regs[in.dst] = (uint8_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_WRAP_I64:     regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_WRAP_I32:     regs[in.dst] = (uint16_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_WRAP_I16:     regs[in.dst] = (uint8_t)regs[in.src1]; break;

            case GIR_EQZ_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] == 0); break;
            case GIR_EQZ_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] == 0); break;

            case GIR_ADD_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] + (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ADD_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] + regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_SUB_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] - (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_SUB_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] - regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_MUL_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] * (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_MUL_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] * regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_MUL_HI_S_I64: {
                int64_t hi;
                _mul128((int64_t)regs[in.src1], (int64_t)regs[in.src2], &hi);
                regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)hi;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_MUL_HI_U_I64: {
                uint64_t hi;
                _umul128(regs[in.src1], regs[in.src2], &hi);
                regs[in.dst] = hi;
                break;
            }

            case GIR_DIV_S_I32: { int32_t a = (int32_t)regs[in.src1], b = (int32_t)regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "div by 0");
                if (a == (int32_t)0x80000000 && b == -1) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_INT_OVERFLOW, "int min / -1");
                regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)(a / b); break;
            }
            case GIR_DIV_S_I64: { int64_t a = (int64_t)regs[in.src1], b = (int64_t)regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "div by 0");
                if (a == (int64_t)0x8000000000000000ll && b == -1) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_INT_OVERFLOW, "int min / -1");
                regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(a / b); break;
            }
            case GIR_DIV_U_I32: { uint32_t a = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1], b = (uint32_t)regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "div by 0");
                regs[in.dst] = a / b; break;
            }
            case GIR_DIV_U_I64: { uint64_t a = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "div by 0");
                regs[in.dst] = a / b; break;
            }
            case GIR_REM_S_I32: { int32_t a = (int32_t)regs[in.src1], b = (int32_t)regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "rem by 0");
                regs[in.dst] = (b == -1) ? 0 : (uint32_t)(a % b); break;
            }
            case GIR_REM_S_I64: { int64_t a = (int64_t)regs[in.src1], b = (int64_t)regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "rem by 0");
                regs[in.dst] = (b == -1) ? 0 : (uint64_t)(a % b); break;
            }
            case GIR_REM_U_I32: { uint32_t a = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1], b = (uint32_t)regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "rem by 0");
                regs[in.dst] = a % b; break;
            }
            case GIR_REM_U_I64: { uint64_t a = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2];
                if (b == 0) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_DIV_BY_ZERO, "rem by 0");
                regs[in.dst] = a % b; break;
            }

            case GIR_AND_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1] & (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_AND_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] & regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_OR_I32:  regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1] | (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_OR_I64:  regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] | regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_XOR_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1] ^ (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]; break;
            case GIR_XOR_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] ^ regs[in.src2]; break;

            case GIR_SHL_I32:   regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] << (regs[in.src2] & 31)); break;
            case GIR_SHL_I64:   regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] << (regs[in.src2] & 63); break;
            case GIR_SHR_U_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1] >> (regs[in.src2] & 31); break;
            case GIR_SHR_U_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] >> (regs[in.src2] & 63); break;
            case GIR_SHR_S_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((int32_t)regs[in.src1] >> (regs[in.src2] & 31)); break;
            case GIR_SHR_S_I64: regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)((int64_t)regs[in.src1] >> (regs[in.src2] & 63)); break;

            case GIR_ROTL_I32: regs[in.dst] = _rotl((uint32_t)regs[in.src1], (int)(regs[in.src2] & 31)); break;
            case GIR_ROTL_I64: regs[in.dst] = _rotl64(regs[in.src1], (int)(regs[in.src2] & 63)); break;
            case GIR_ROTR_I32: regs[in.dst] = _rotr((uint32_t)regs[in.src1], (int)(regs[in.src2] & 31)); break;
            case GIR_ROTR_I64: regs[in.dst] = _rotr64(regs[in.src1], (int)(regs[in.src2] & 63)); break;

            case GIR_ADD_IMM_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] + (uint32_t)(int32_t)in.imm); break;
            case GIR_ADD_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] + in.imm; break;
            case GIR_SUB_IMM_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] - (uint32_t)(int32_t)in.imm); break;
            case GIR_SUB_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] - in.imm; break;
            case GIR_AND_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] & in.imm; break;
            case GIR_OR_IMM_I64:  regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] | in.imm; break;
            case GIR_XOR_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] ^ in.imm; break;
            case GIR_SHL_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] << (in.imm & 63); break;
            case GIR_SHR_U_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] >> (in.imm & 63); break;
            case GIR_SHR_S_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)((int64_t)regs[in.src1] >> (in.imm & 63)); break;
            case GIR_MUL_IMM_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] * in.imm; break;

            case GIR_CMP_IMM_I32: {
                uint64_t a = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1], b = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint64_t r = (uint32_t)(a - b);
                regs[in.dst] = r;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_CMP_IMM_I64: {
                uint64_t r = regs[in.src1] - in.imm;
                regs[in.dst] = r;
                break;
            }

            /* flag-writing arith. imm[15:0] = flag_reg. */
#define BIN_F(size, op) do {                                           \
            uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;                            \
            uint64_t a = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2];             \
            uint64_t r = 0; uint64_t flags = 0; int carry = 0;         \
            switch (op) {                                              \
            case 0: r = a + b; flags = flags_arith(a, b, r, size, 0, 0); break;\
            case 1: r = a - b; flags = flags_arith(a, b, r, size, 1, 0); break;\
            case 2: r = a * b; flags = flags_logic(r, size);                  \
                    if (size == 4) { uint64_t hi = (uint32_t)((uint64_t)(uint32_t)a * (uint64_t)(uint32_t)b >> 32); if (hi) flags |= (GIR_EF_CF | GIR_EF_OF); } break;\
            case 3: r = a & b; flags = flags_logic(r, size); break;    \
            case 4: r = a | b; flags = flags_logic(r, size); break;    \
            case 5: r = a ^ b; flags = flags_logic(r, size); break;    \
            }                                                          \
            (void)carry;                                               \
            regs[in.dst] = (size == 4) ? (uint32_t)r : r;              \
            regs[fr] = flags;                                          \
        } while (0)

            case GIR_ADD_F_I32: BIN_F(4, 0); break;
            case GIR_ADD_F_I64: BIN_F(8, 0); break;
            case GIR_SUB_F_I32: BIN_F(4, 1); break;
            case GIR_SUB_F_I64: BIN_F(8, 1); break;
            case GIR_MUL_F_I32: BIN_F(4, 2); break;
            case GIR_MUL_F_I64: BIN_F(8, 2); break;
            case GIR_AND_F_I32: BIN_F(4, 3); break;
            case GIR_AND_F_I64: BIN_F(8, 3); break;
            case GIR_OR_F_I32:  BIN_F(4, 4); break;
            case GIR_OR_F_I64:  BIN_F(8, 4); break;
            case GIR_XOR_F_I32: BIN_F(4, 5); break;
            case GIR_XOR_F_I64: BIN_F(8, 5); break;

            case GIR_SHL_F_I32: case GIR_SHL_F_I64:
            case GIR_SHR_U_F_I32: case GIR_SHR_U_F_I64:
            case GIR_SHR_S_F_I32: case GIR_SHR_S_F_I64: {
                uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t size = (in.op == GIR_SHL_F_I32 || in.op == GIR_SHR_U_F_I32 || in.op == GIR_SHR_S_F_I32) ? 4 : 8;
                uint64_t a = regs[in.src1];
                int count = (int)(regs[in.src2] & (size == 4 ? 31 : 63));
                uint64_t r = 0; uint64_t last_bit = 0;
                if (in.op == GIR_SHL_F_I32 || in.op == GIR_SHL_F_I64) {
                    r = (count == 0) ? a : (a << count);
                    if (count > 0) last_bit = (a >> ((size * 8) - count)) & 1;
                } else if (in.op == GIR_SHR_U_F_I32 || in.op == GIR_SHR_U_F_I64) {
                    r = (count == 0) ? a : (a >> count);
                    if (count > 0) last_bit = (a >> (count - 1)) & 1;
                } else {
                    int64_t s = (size == 4) ? (int64_t)(int32_t)a : (int64_t)a;
                    r = (count == 0) ? (uint64_t)s : (uint64_t)(s >> count);
                    if (count > 0) last_bit = ((uint64_t)s >> (count - 1)) & 1;
                }
                regs[in.dst] = (size == 4) ? (uint32_t)r : r;
                if (count == 0) regs[fr] = regs[fr];   /* unchanged */
                else regs[fr] = flags_shift(r, last_bit, size, count);
                break;
            }

            case GIR_NEG_F_I32: case GIR_NEG_F_I64: {
                uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t size = (in.op == GIR_NEG_F_I32) ? 4 : 8;
                uint64_t a = regs[in.src1];
                uint64_t r = (size == 4) ? (uint32_t)(-(int32_t)a) : (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)a);
                regs[in.dst] = r;
                regs[fr] = flags_arith(0, a, r, size, 1, 0);
                break;
            }

            case GIR_INC_F_I32: case GIR_INC_F_I64: {
                uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t size = (in.op == GIR_INC_F_I32) ? 4 : 8;
                uint64_t a = regs[in.src1];
                uint64_t r = a + 1;
                uint64_t f = flags_arith(a, 1, r, size, 0, 0);
                f = (f & ~GIR_EF_CF) | (regs[fr] & GIR_EF_CF);   /* INC/DEC preserve CF */
                regs[in.dst] = (size == 4) ? (uint32_t)r : r;
                regs[fr] = f;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_DEC_F_I32: case GIR_DEC_F_I64: {
                uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t size = (in.op == GIR_DEC_F_I32) ? 4 : 8;
                uint64_t a = regs[in.src1];
                uint64_t r = a - 1;
                uint64_t f = flags_arith(a, 1, r, size, 1, 0);
                f = (f & ~GIR_EF_CF) | (regs[fr] & GIR_EF_CF);
                regs[in.dst] = (size == 4) ? (uint32_t)r : r;
                regs[fr] = f;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_CMP_F_I32: case GIR_CMP_F_I64: {
                uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t size = (in.op == GIR_CMP_F_I32) ? 4 : 8;
                uint64_t a = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2];
                uint64_t r = a - b;
                regs[fr] = flags_arith(a, b, r, size, 1, 0);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_TEST_F_I32: case GIR_TEST_F_I64: {
                uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t size = (in.op == GIR_TEST_F_I32) ? 4 : 8;
                uint64_t r = regs[in.src1] & regs[in.src2];
                regs[fr] = flags_logic(r, size);
                break;
            }

            /* plain (non-flag) comparisons. */
            case GIR_EQ_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] == (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_EQ_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] == regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_NE_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] != (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_NE_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] != regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LT_S_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((int32_t)regs[in.src1] <  (int32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LT_S_I64: regs[in.dst] = ((int64_t)regs[in.src1] <  (int64_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LT_U_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] <  (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LT_U_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] <  regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LE_S_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((int32_t)regs[in.src1] <= (int32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LE_S_I64: regs[in.dst] = ((int64_t)regs[in.src1] <= (int64_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LE_U_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] <= (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_LE_U_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] <= regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GT_S_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((int32_t)regs[in.src1] >  (int32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GT_S_I64: regs[in.dst] = ((int64_t)regs[in.src1] >  (int64_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GT_U_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] >  (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GT_U_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] >  regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GE_S_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((int32_t)regs[in.src1] >= (int32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GE_S_I64: regs[in.dst] = ((int64_t)regs[in.src1] >= (int64_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GE_U_I32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1] >= (uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_GE_U_I64: regs[in.dst] = (regs[in.src1] >= regs[in.src2]); break;

            /* bit ops - dst = old bit; may modify addr reg for BTS/BTR/BTC */
            case GIR_BT_I64: {
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2] & 63;
                regs[in.dst] = (v >> b) & 1;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_BTS_I64: {
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2] & 63;
                regs[in.dst] = (v >> b) & 1;
                regs[in.src1] = v | (1ull << b);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_BTR_I64: {
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2] & 63;
                regs[in.dst] = (v >> b) & 1;
                regs[in.src1] = v & ~(1ull << b);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_BTC_I64: {
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src1], b = regs[in.src2] & 63;
                regs[in.dst] = (v >> b) & 1;
                regs[in.src1] = v ^ (1ull << b);
                break;
            }

            /* linear memory load/store */
            case GIR_LOAD_I8_S: case GIR_LOAD_I8_U:
            case GIR_LOAD_I16_S: case GIR_LOAD_I16_U:
            case GIR_LOAD_I32_S: case GIR_LOAD_I32_U:
            case GIR_LOAD_I64: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_LOAD_I64) ? 8 :
                              (in.op == GIR_LOAD_I32_S || in.op == GIR_LOAD_I32_U) ? 4 :
                              (in.op == GIR_LOAD_I16_S || in.op == GIR_LOAD_I16_U) ? 2 : 1;
                if (!mem_check(ctx, addr, sz)) return 0;
                const uint8_t* p = ctx->mod->mem + addr;
                switch (in.op) {
                case GIR_LOAD_I8_S:  regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int8_t)p[0]; break;
                case GIR_LOAD_I8_U:  regs[in.dst] = p[0]; break;
                case GIR_LOAD_I16_S: { int16_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, p, 2); regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)v; break; }
                case GIR_LOAD_I16_U: { uint16_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, p, 2); regs[in.dst] = v; break; }
                case GIR_LOAD_I32_S: { int32_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, p, 4); regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)v; break; }
                case GIR_LOAD_I32_U: { uint32_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, p, 4); regs[in.dst] = v; break; }
                case GIR_LOAD_I64:   { uint64_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, p, 8); regs[in.dst] = v; break; }
                }
                break;
            }
            case GIR_LOAD_V128: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (!mem_check(ctx, addr, 16)) return 0;
                gexec_memcpy(&regs[in.dst], ctx->mod->mem + addr, 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_STORE_I8: case GIR_STORE_I16: case GIR_STORE_I32: case GIR_STORE_I64: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_STORE_I64) ? 8 : (in.op == GIR_STORE_I32) ? 4 : (in.op == GIR_STORE_I16) ? 2 : 1;
                if (!mem_check(ctx, addr, sz)) return 0;
                uint8_t* p = ctx->mod->mem + addr;
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src2];
                switch (in.op) {
                case GIR_STORE_I8:  p[0] = (uint8_t)v; break;
                case GIR_STORE_I16: { uint16_t x = (uint16_t)v; gexec_memcpy(p, &x, 2); break; }
                case GIR_STORE_I32: { uint32_t x = (uint32_t)v; gexec_memcpy(p, &x, 4); break; }
                case GIR_STORE_I64: gexec_memcpy(p, &v, 8); break;
                }
                break;
            }
            case GIR_STORE_V128: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (!mem_check(ctx, addr, 16)) return 0;
                gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + addr, &regs[in.src2], 16);
                break;
            }

            /* base + index*scale + disp */
            case GIR_LOAD_IDX_I32_U: case GIR_LOAD_IDX_I64: {
                int32_t disp = (int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint8_t scale_log2 = (uint8_t)(in.imm >> 40);
                uint16_t idx_r = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                uint64_t base = (in.src1 == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[in.src1];
                uint64_t idx  = (idx_r == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[idx_r] << (scale_log2 & 3);
                uint64_t addr = base + idx + (uint64_t)(int64_t)disp;
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_LOAD_IDX_I64) ? 8 : 4;
                if (!mem_check(ctx, addr, sz)) return 0;
                if (sz == 8) { uint64_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, ctx->mod->mem + addr, 8); regs[in.dst] = v; }
                else         { uint32_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, ctx->mod->mem + addr, 4); regs[in.dst] = v; }
                break;
            }
            case GIR_STORE_IDX_I32: case GIR_STORE_IDX_I64: {
                int32_t disp = (int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint8_t scale_log2 = (uint8_t)(in.imm >> 40);
                uint16_t idx_r = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                uint64_t base = (in.src1 == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[in.src1];
                uint64_t idx  = (idx_r == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[idx_r] << (scale_log2 & 3);
                uint64_t addr = base + idx + (uint64_t)(int64_t)disp;
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_STORE_IDX_I64) ? 8 : 4;
                if (!mem_check(ctx, addr, sz)) return 0;
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src2];
                if (sz == 8) gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + addr, &v, 8);
                else { uint32_t x = (uint32_t)v; gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + addr, &x, 4); }
                break;
            }

            /* kernel VA */
            case GIR_KLOAD_I8: case GIR_KLOAD_I16: case GIR_KLOAD_I32: case GIR_KLOAD_I64: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_KLOAD_I64) ? 8 : (in.op == GIR_KLOAD_I32) ? 4 : (in.op == GIR_KLOAD_I16) ? 2 : 1;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, sz)) return 0;
                switch (in.op) {
                case GIR_KLOAD_I8:  regs[in.dst] = *(volatile uint8_t*)(uintptr_t)addr; break;
                case GIR_KLOAD_I16: regs[in.dst] = *(volatile uint16_t*)(uintptr_t)addr; break;
                case GIR_KLOAD_I32: regs[in.dst] = *(volatile uint32_t*)(uintptr_t)addr; break;
                case GIR_KLOAD_I64: regs[in.dst] = *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)addr; break;
                }
                break;
            }
            case GIR_KLOAD_V128: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, 16)) return 0;
                gexec_memcpy(&regs[in.dst], (void*)(uintptr_t)addr, 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_KSTORE_I8: case GIR_KSTORE_I16: case GIR_KSTORE_I32: case GIR_KSTORE_I64: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_KSTORE_I64) ? 8 : (in.op == GIR_KSTORE_I32) ? 4 : (in.op == GIR_KSTORE_I16) ? 2 : 1;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, sz)) return 0;
                uint64_t v = regs[in.src2];
                switch (in.op) {
                case GIR_KSTORE_I8:  *(volatile uint8_t*)(uintptr_t)addr  = (uint8_t)v; break;
                case GIR_KSTORE_I16: *(volatile uint16_t*)(uintptr_t)addr = (uint16_t)v; break;
                case GIR_KSTORE_I32: *(volatile uint32_t*)(uintptr_t)addr = (uint32_t)v; break;
                case GIR_KSTORE_I64: *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)addr = v; break;
                }
                break;
            }
            case GIR_KSTORE_V128: {
                uint64_t addr = regs[in.src1] + (int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, 16)) return 0;
                gexec_memcpy((void*)(uintptr_t)addr, &regs[in.src2], 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_KLOAD_IDX_I64: case GIR_KSTORE_IDX_I64: {
                int32_t disp = (int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint8_t scale_log2 = (uint8_t)(in.imm >> 40);
                uint16_t idx_r = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                uint64_t base = (in.src1 == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[in.src1];
                uint64_t idx  = (idx_r == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[idx_r] << (scale_log2 & 3);
                uint64_t addr = base + idx + (uint64_t)(int64_t)disp;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, 8)) return 0;
                if (in.op == GIR_KLOAD_IDX_I64) regs[in.dst] = *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)addr;
                else                             *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)addr = regs[in.src2];
                break;
            }

            /* segment-relative. base comes from the guest-visible reg. */
            case GIR_FSLOAD_I64: case GIR_GSLOAD_I64: {
                uint64_t base = (in.op == GIR_FSLOAD_I64) ? regs[GIR_REG_FSBASE] : regs[GIR_REG_GSBASE];
                uint64_t addr = base + regs[in.src1] + (int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, 8)) return 0;
                regs[in.dst] = *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)addr;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_FSSTORE_I64: case GIR_GSSTORE_I64: {
                uint64_t base = (in.op == GIR_FSSTORE_I64) ? regs[GIR_REG_FSBASE] : regs[GIR_REG_GSBASE];
                uint64_t addr = base + regs[in.src1] + (int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (!kmem_check(ctx, addr, 8)) return 0;
                *(volatile uint64_t*)(uintptr_t)addr = regs[in.src2];
                break;
            }

            /* atomics */
            case GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedExchange((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I64: regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG64)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I32:  regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedExchangeAdd((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I64:  regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchangeAdd64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG64)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I32:  regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedExchangeAdd((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], -(LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I64:  regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchangeAdd64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], -(LONG64)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I32:  regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedAnd((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I64:  regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedAnd64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG64)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I32:   regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedOr((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I64:   regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedOr64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG64)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I32:  regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedXor((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I64:  regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedXor64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG64)regs[in.src2]); break;
            case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I32: {
                uint16_t exp_r = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)InterlockedCompareExchange((volatile LONG*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[in.src2], (LONG)(uint32_t)regs[exp_r]);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I64: {
                uint16_t exp_r = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedCompareExchange64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG64)regs[in.src2], (LONG64)regs[exp_r]);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I128: {
                uint16_t exp_lo = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                uint16_t exp_hi = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 16);
                LONG64 exp[2] = { (LONG64)regs[exp_lo], (LONG64)regs[exp_hi] };
                LONG64 val_hi = (LONG64)regs[in.src2 + 1];
                LONG64 val_lo = (LONG64)regs[in.src2];
                regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)InterlockedCompareExchange128((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], val_hi, val_lo, exp);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_ATOMIC_BTS_I64: {
                LONG r = InterlockedBitTestAndSet64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(regs[in.src2] & 63));
                regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(r & 1);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_ATOMIC_BTR_I64: {
                LONG r = InterlockedBitTestAndReset64((volatile LONG64*)(uintptr_t)regs[in.src1], (LONG)(regs[in.src2] & 63));
                regs[in.dst] = (uint64_t)(r & 1);
                break;
            }

            /* control flow */
            case GIR_BR:
                BURN_FUEL(1); pc = (uint32_t)in.imm; break;
            case GIR_BR_IF:
                if (regs[in.src1]) { BURN_FUEL(1); pc = (uint32_t)in.imm; } break;
            case GIR_BR_IF_NOT:
                if (!regs[in.src1]) { BURN_FUEL(1); pc = (uint32_t)in.imm; } break;
            case GIR_JCC: {
                uint32_t cc = in.dst;
                if (cc_true(cc, regs[in.src1])) { BURN_FUEL(1); pc = (uint32_t)in.imm; }
                break;
            }

            case GIR_BR_TABLE: {
                uint32_t count = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                uint64_t idx = regs[in.src1];
                uint32_t slot_i = pc;
                uint32_t k = (idx >= count) ? count : (uint32_t)idx;
                uint32_t target = (k & 1)
                    ? (uint32_t)(insns[slot_i + k / 2].imm >> 32)
                    : (uint32_t)insns[slot_i + k / 2].imm;
                pc = target;
                BURN_FUEL(1);
                break;
            }

            case GIR_SELECT: {
                uint16_t src3 = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] ? regs[in.src2] : regs[src3];
                break;
            }
            case GIR_CMOV: {
                uint16_t cc = (uint16_t)in.imm;
                if (cc_true(cc, regs[in.src1])) regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src2];
                break;
            }
            case GIR_SETCC: {
                uint16_t cc = in.src2;
                regs[in.dst] = cc_true(cc, regs[in.src1]) ? 1 : 0;
                break;
            }

            case GIR_HOST_CALL: {
                uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                const gexec_host_entry* he = gexec_host_by_index(hi);
                if (!he) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_HOST_INDEX_OOB, "host idx oob");
                uint64_t argbuf[GIR_MAX_CALL_ARGS];
                unsigned argc = in.src2;
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < argc; i++) argbuf[i] = regs[in.src1 + i];
                uint64_t rv = he->fn(ctx, argbuf, argc);
                if (ctx->trap) return 0;
                regs[in.dst] = rv;
                break;
            }

            case GIR_CALL: {
                BURN_FUEL(1);
                uint32_t target = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (target >= ctx->mod->n_fns) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_FN_INDEX_OOB, "call target oob");
                const gexec_function* callee = &ctx->mod->fns[target];
                uint64_t argbuf[GIR_MAX_REGS];
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < callee->n_args; i++) argbuf[i] = regs[in.src1 + i];
                f->pc = pc;
                if (!push_frame(ctx, target, in.dst, callee->returns ? 0 : 1, argbuf, callee->n_args)) return 0;
                goto reload_frame;
            }
            case GIR_CALL_INDIRECT: {
                BURN_FUEL(1);
                uint64_t tbl_i = regs[in.src1];
                if (tbl_i >= ctx->mod->n_ftable) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_INDIRECT_TYPE, "indirect idx oob");
                uint32_t target = ctx->mod->ftable[(uint32_t)tbl_i];
                if (target >= ctx->mod->n_fns) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_FN_INDEX_OOB, "indirect fn oob");
                const gexec_function* callee = &ctx->mod->fns[target];
                uint16_t argc = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                if (argc != callee->n_args) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_INDIRECT_TYPE, "indirect argc mismatch");
                uint64_t argbuf[GIR_MAX_REGS];
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < argc; i++) argbuf[i] = regs[in.src2 + i];
                f->pc = pc;
                if (!push_frame(ctx, target, in.dst, callee->returns ? 0 : 1, argbuf, argc)) return 0;
                goto reload_frame;
            }
            case GIR_CALL_ABS_KVA: {
                uint64_t fnv = regs[in.src1];
                if (!fnv) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_HOST_ERROR, "call_abs null");
                uint16_t argc = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                uint64_t args_l[6] = {0};
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < argc; i++) args_l[i] = regs[in.src2 + i];
                typedef uint64_t (*fn0)(void);
                typedef uint64_t (*fn1)(uint64_t);
                typedef uint64_t (*fn2)(uint64_t, uint64_t);
                typedef uint64_t (*fn3)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
                typedef uint64_t (*fn4)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
                typedef uint64_t (*fn5)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
                typedef uint64_t (*fn6)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
                uint64_t rv = 0;
                switch (argc) {
                case 0: rv = ((fn0)(uintptr_t)fnv)(); break;
                case 1: rv = ((fn1)(uintptr_t)fnv)(args_l[0]); break;
                case 2: rv = ((fn2)(uintptr_t)fnv)(args_l[0], args_l[1]); break;
                case 3: rv = ((fn3)(uintptr_t)fnv)(args_l[0], args_l[1], args_l[2]); break;
                case 4: rv = ((fn4)(uintptr_t)fnv)(args_l[0], args_l[1], args_l[2], args_l[3]); break;
                case 5: rv = ((fn5)(uintptr_t)fnv)(args_l[0], args_l[1], args_l[2], args_l[3], args_l[4]); break;
                case 6: rv = ((fn6)(uintptr_t)fnv)(args_l[0], args_l[1], args_l[2], args_l[3], args_l[4], args_l[5]); break;
                }
                regs[in.dst] = rv;
                break;
            }

            case GIR_RETURN: {
                uint64_t rv = (in.src1 == 0xFFFF) ? 0 : regs[in.src1];
                uint32_t leaving_seh_depth = f->seh_stack_depth;
                uint32_t post_action = f->post_action;
                uint32_t post_scope  = f->post_scope;
                uint32_t post_code   = f->post_code;
                uint64_t post_addr   = f->post_addr;
                uint16_t out_ret_void = f->returns_void;
                uint16_t out_dst      = f->dst_reg;

                ctx->top--;
                while (ctx->seh_depth > leaving_seh_depth) ctx->seh_depth--;

                if (post_action == GEXEC_POST_SEH_FILTER) {
                    /* filter returned a disposition. 1 = catch, else propagate. */
                    if (rv == 1) {
                        /* resume in the frame that owned the scope; pc = scope end_insn */
                        const gir_seh_scope* sc = &ctx->mod->seh[post_scope];
                        if (ctx->top == 0) return 0;
                        gexec_frame* target = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
                        target->pc = sc->end_insn;
                        goto reload_frame;
                    } else {
                        if (!raise_exception(ctx, post_code, post_addr)) return 0;
                        goto reload_frame;
                    }
                }
                if (post_action == GEXEC_POST_SEH_FIN_UNWIND) {
                    if (!raise_exception(ctx, post_code, post_addr)) return 0;
                    goto reload_frame;
                }
                if (post_action == GEXEC_POST_SEH_FIN_NORMAL) {
                    /* finally invoked during normal try_end path. control returns
                     * to whatever pc was saved on the target frame; nothing else
                     * to do - the outer loop already reloads from that frame. */
                    if (ctx->top == 0) return 0;
                    goto reload_frame;
                }

                /* normal return path: writeback controlled by the returning
                 * frame's own returns_void + dst_reg, not the caller's. */
                if (ctx->top == 0) return rv;
                if (!out_ret_void) {
                    gexec_frame* caller = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
                    uint64_t* caller_regs = &ctx->mod->reg_stack[caller->reg_base];
                    caller_regs[out_dst] = rv;
                }
                goto reload_frame;
            }

            /* stack ops */
            case GIR_STACK_PUSH: {
                uint64_t rsp = regs[GIR_REG_RSP] - 8;
                if (rsp < ctx->mod->stack_base || rsp + 8 > ctx->mod->stack_top + 16) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_STACK_OVERFLOW, "push overflow");
                regs[GIR_REG_RSP] = rsp;
                gexec_memcpy(ctx->mod->mem + rsp, &regs[in.src1], 8);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_STACK_POP: {
                uint64_t rsp = regs[GIR_REG_RSP];
                if (rsp < ctx->mod->stack_base || rsp + 8 > ctx->mod->mem_size) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_STACK_UNDERFLOW, "pop underflow");
                uint64_t v; gexec_memcpy(&v, ctx->mod->mem + rsp, 8);
                regs[in.dst] = v;
                regs[GIR_REG_RSP] = rsp + 8;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_STACK_ALLOC: {
                uint64_t rsp = regs[GIR_REG_RSP] - in.imm;
                if (rsp < ctx->mod->stack_base) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_STACK_OVERFLOW, "alloca overflow");
                regs[GIR_REG_RSP] = rsp;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_STACK_FREE: {
                uint64_t rsp = regs[GIR_REG_RSP] + in.imm;
                if (rsp > ctx->mod->stack_top + 16) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_STACK_UNDERFLOW, "stack free underflow");
                regs[GIR_REG_RSP] = rsp;
                break;
            }

            /* seh */
            case GIR_TRY_BEGIN: {
                if (ctx->seh_depth >= (sizeof(ctx->seh_stack) / sizeof(ctx->seh_stack[0]))) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_STACK_OVERFLOW, "seh depth");
                ctx->seh_stack[ctx->seh_depth].scope_idx = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                ctx->seh_stack[ctx->seh_depth].frame_idx = ctx->top - 1;
                ctx->seh_depth++;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_TRY_END: {
                uint32_t scope_idx = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                if (ctx->seh_depth > 0 && ctx->seh_stack[ctx->seh_depth - 1].scope_idx == scope_idx) {
                    ctx->seh_depth--;
                    const gir_seh_scope* sc = &ctx->mod->seh[scope_idx];
                    if (sc->kind == GIR_SEH_FINALLY) {
                        /* auto-invoke finally handler with (code=0, addr=0) */
                        uint64_t args[2] = { 0, 0 };
                        f->pc = pc;
                        if (!push_frame(ctx, sc->handler_fn, 0, 1, args, 2)) return 0;
                        gexec_frame* hf = &ctx->frames[ctx->top - 1];
                        hf->post_action = GEXEC_POST_SEH_FIN_NORMAL;
                        hf->post_scope  = scope_idx;
                        goto reload_frame;
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
            case GIR_RAISE: {
                f->pc = pc;
                if (!raise_exception(ctx, (uint32_t)in.imm, 0)) return 0;
                goto reload_frame;
            }
            case GIR_RESUME: {
                pc = (uint32_t)in.imm;
                break;
            }

            case GIR_CFG_CHECK: {
                uint64_t target = regs[in.src1];
                int ok = 0;
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ctx->mod->n_ftable; i++) if (ctx->mod->ftable[i] == target) { ok = 1; break; }
                if (!ok) TRAP(GIR_TRAP_CFG_VIOLATION, "cfg target not in table");
                break;
            }

            /* string primitives */
            case GIR_REP_MOVSB: case GIR_REP_MOVSW: case GIR_REP_MOVSD: case GIR_REP_MOVSQ: {
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_REP_MOVSB) ? 1 : (in.op == GIR_REP_MOVSW) ? 2 : (in.op == GIR_REP_MOVSD) ? 4 : 8;
                uint16_t cnt_r = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 16);
                uint16_t df_r  = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                int df = (df_r != 0xFFFF) && (regs[df_r] & GIR_EF_DF);
                if (!do_rep_movs(ctx, regs, in.src1, in.src2, cnt_r, sz, df)) return 0;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_REP_STOSB: case GIR_REP_STOSW: case GIR_REP_STOSD: case GIR_REP_STOSQ: {
                uint32_t sz = (in.op == GIR_REP_STOSB) ? 1 : (in.op == GIR_REP_STOSW) ? 2 : (in.op == GIR_REP_STOSD) ? 4 : 8;
                uint16_t cnt_r = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 16);
                uint16_t df_r  = (uint16_t)(in.imm >> 32);
                int df = (df_r != 0xFFFF) && (regs[df_r] & GIR_EF_DF);
                if (!do_rep_stos(ctx, regs, in.src1, in.src2, cnt_r, sz, df)) return 0;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_REP_CMPSB: case GIR_REP_SCASB:
                TRAP(GIR_TRAP_UNSUPPORTED_OP, "rep cmps/scas not implemented");

            /* sse xmm ops. all read/write pairs. */
            case GIR_XMM_PXOR:
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1]     ^ regs[in.src2];
                regs[in.dst + 1] = regs[in.src1 + 1] ^ regs[in.src2 + 1];
                break;
            case GIR_XMM_POR:
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1]     | regs[in.src2];
                regs[in.dst + 1] = regs[in.src1 + 1] | regs[in.src2 + 1];
                break;
            case GIR_XMM_PAND:
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1]     & regs[in.src2];
                regs[in.dst + 1] = regs[in.src1 + 1] & regs[in.src2 + 1];
                break;
            case GIR_XMM_PANDN:
                regs[in.dst]     = ~regs[in.src1]     & regs[in.src2];
                regs[in.dst + 1] = ~regs[in.src1 + 1] & regs[in.src2 + 1];
                break;
            case GIR_XMM_PADDB: case GIR_XMM_PADDW: case GIR_XMM_PADDD: case GIR_XMM_PADDQ:
            case GIR_XMM_PSUBB: case GIR_XMM_PSUBW: case GIR_XMM_PSUBD: case GIR_XMM_PSUBQ: {
                uint8_t a[16], b[16], r[16];
                gexec_memcpy(a, &regs[in.src1], 16);
                gexec_memcpy(b, &regs[in.src2], 16);
                int add = (in.op >= GIR_XMM_PADDB && in.op <= GIR_XMM_PADDQ);
                if (in.op == GIR_XMM_PADDB || in.op == GIR_XMM_PSUBB) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = add ? (uint8_t)(a[i] + b[i]) : (uint8_t)(a[i] - b[i]);
                } else if (in.op == GIR_XMM_PADDW || in.op == GIR_XMM_PSUBW) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        uint16_t av = *(uint16_t*)&a[i*2], bv = *(uint16_t*)&b[i*2];
                        uint16_t rv = add ? (uint16_t)(av + bv) : (uint16_t)(av - bv);
                        *(uint16_t*)&r[i*2] = rv;
                    }
                } else if (in.op == GIR_XMM_PADDD || in.op == GIR_XMM_PSUBD) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        uint32_t av = *(uint32_t*)&a[i*4], bv = *(uint32_t*)&b[i*4];
                        uint32_t rv = add ? av + bv : av - bv;
                        *(uint32_t*)&r[i*4] = rv;
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                        uint64_t av = *(uint64_t*)&a[i*8], bv = *(uint64_t*)&b[i*8];
                        uint64_t rv = add ? av + bv : av - bv;
                        *(uint64_t*)&r[i*8] = rv;
                    }
                }
                gexec_memcpy(&regs[in.dst], r, 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_PCMPEQB: case GIR_XMM_PCMPEQW: case GIR_XMM_PCMPEQD: {
                uint8_t a[16], b[16], r[16] = {0};
                gexec_memcpy(a, &regs[in.src1], 16);
                gexec_memcpy(b, &regs[in.src2], 16);
                if (in.op == GIR_XMM_PCMPEQB) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = a[i] == b[i] ? 0xFF : 0x00;
                } else if (in.op == GIR_XMM_PCMPEQW) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        uint16_t av = *(uint16_t*)&a[i*2], bv = *(uint16_t*)&b[i*2];
                        *(uint16_t*)&r[i*2] = av == bv ? 0xFFFF : 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        uint32_t av = *(uint32_t*)&a[i*4], bv = *(uint32_t*)&b[i*4];
                        *(uint32_t*)&r[i*4] = av == bv ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : 0;
                    }
                }
                gexec_memcpy(&regs[in.dst], r, 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_PSHUFB: {
                uint8_t a[16], b[16], r[16];
                gexec_memcpy(a, &regs[in.src1], 16);
                gexec_memcpy(b, &regs[in.src2], 16);
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                    uint8_t s = b[i];
                    r[i] = (s & 0x80) ? 0 : a[s & 0x0F];
                }
                gexec_memcpy(&regs[in.dst], r, 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_PMOVMSKB: {
                uint8_t v[16];
                gexec_memcpy(v, &regs[in.src1], 16);
                uint32_t mask = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) mask |= ((v[i] >> 7) & 1) << i;
                regs[in.dst] = mask;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_PSLLQ_IMM: {
                unsigned sh = (unsigned)(in.imm & 63);
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1]     << sh;
                regs[in.dst + 1] = regs[in.src1 + 1] << sh;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_PSRLQ_IMM: {
                unsigned sh = (unsigned)(in.imm & 63);
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1]     >> sh;
                regs[in.dst + 1] = regs[in.src1 + 1] >> sh;
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_PUNPCKLBW: case GIR_XMM_PUNPCKHBW: {
                uint8_t a[16], b[16], r[16];
                gexec_memcpy(a, &regs[in.src1], 16);
                gexec_memcpy(b, &regs[in.src2], 16);
                int hi = (in.op == GIR_XMM_PUNPCKHBW);
                for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                    r[2*i]     = hi ? a[8 + i] : a[i];
                    r[2*i + 1] = hi ? b[8 + i] : b[i];
                }
                gexec_memcpy(&regs[in.dst], r, 16);
                break;
            }
            case GIR_XMM_MOVQ_TO_GPR:
                regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1];
                break;
            case GIR_XMM_MOVQ_FROM_GPR:
                regs[in.dst]     = regs[in.src1];
                regs[in.dst + 1] = 0;
                break;

            case GIR_DBG_MARK:
                break;
            case GIR_DBG_TRACE:
                break;

            case GIR_CONST_F32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)in.imm; break;
            case GIR_CONST_F64: regs[in.dst] = in.imm; break;

            case GIR_FADD_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) + _u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FADD_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]) + _u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FSUB_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) - _u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FSUB_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]) - _u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FMUL_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) * _u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FMUL_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]) * _u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FDIV_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) / _u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FDIV_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]) / _u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2])); break;
            case GIR_FNEG_F32: regs[in.dst] = ((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]) ^ 0x80000000u; break;
            case GIR_FNEG_F64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] ^ 0x8000000000000000ull; break;
            case GIR_FABS_F32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1] & 0x7FFFFFFFu; break;
            case GIR_FABS_F64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1] & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull; break;
            case GIR_FSQRT_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_sqrtf_hw(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]))); break;
            case GIR_FSQRT_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_sqrt_hw (_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]))); break;
            case GIR_FMIN_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((a<b||_isnan32(a))?a:b); break; }
            case GIR_FMIN_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((a<b||_isnan64(a))?a:b); break; }
            case GIR_FMAX_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((a>b||_isnan32(a))?a:b); break; }
            case GIR_FMAX_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((a>b||_isnan64(a))?a:b); break; }
            case GIR_FCEIL_F32:    regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_ceilf_hw(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1])));  break;
            case GIR_FCEIL_F64:    regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_ceil_hw (_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])));           break;
            case GIR_FFLOOR_F32:   regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_floorf_hw(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]))); break;
            case GIR_FFLOOR_F64:   regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_floor_hw (_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])));           break;
            case GIR_FTRUNC_F32:   regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_truncf_hw(_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]))); break;
            case GIR_FTRUNC_F64:   regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_trunc_hw (_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])));           break;
            case GIR_FNEAREST_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32(_rintf_hw (_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]))); break;
            case GIR_FNEAREST_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64(_rint_hw  (_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])));           break;
            case GIR_FCOPYSIGN_F32: { uint32_t a=(uint32_t)regs[in.src1], b=(uint32_t)regs[in.src2]; regs[in.dst] = (a & 0x7FFFFFFFu) | (b & 0x80000000u); break; }
            case GIR_FCOPYSIGN_F64: { uint64_t a=regs[in.src1], b=regs[in.src2]; regs[in.dst] = (a & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull) | (b & 0x8000000000000000ull); break; }

            case GIR_FEQ_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a==b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FEQ_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a==b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FNE_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a!=b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FNE_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a!=b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FLT_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a<b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FLT_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a<b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FLE_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a<=b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FLE_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a<=b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FGT_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a>b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FGT_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a>b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FGE_F32: { float a=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1]), b=_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a>=b)?1:0; break; }
            case GIR_FGE_F64: { double a=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1]), b=_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src2]); regs[in.dst] = (a>=b)?1:0; break; }

            case GIR_F32_TO_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((double)_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F64_TO_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((float) _u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F32_TO_I32_S: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)_fsat_i32_s((double)_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F32_TO_I32_U: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)_fsat_i32_u((double)_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F32_TO_I64_S: regs[in.dst] = _fsat_i64_s((double)_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1])); break;
```
