```c
            case GIR_F32_TO_I64_U: regs[in.dst] = _fsat_i64_u((double)_u32_to_f32((uint32_t)regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F64_TO_I32_S: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)_fsat_i32_s(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F64_TO_I32_U: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)_fsat_i32_u(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F64_TO_I64_S: regs[in.dst] = _fsat_i64_s(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_F64_TO_I64_U: regs[in.dst] = _fsat_i64_u(_u64_to_f64(regs[in.src1])); break;
            case GIR_I32_S_TO_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((float)(int32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I32_U_TO_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((float)(uint32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I32_S_TO_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((double)(int32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I32_U_TO_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((double)(uint32_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I64_S_TO_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((float)(int64_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I64_U_TO_F32: regs[in.dst] = _f32_to_u32((float)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I64_S_TO_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((double)(int64_t)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_I64_U_TO_F64: regs[in.dst] = _f64_to_u64((double)regs[in.src1]); break;
            case GIR_F32_REINT_I32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_F64_REINT_I64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_I32_REINT_F32: regs[in.dst] = (uint32_t)regs[in.src1]; break;
            case GIR_I64_REINT_F64: regs[in.dst] = regs[in.src1]; break;

            default:
                TRAP(GIR_TRAP_UNSUPPORTED_OP, "opcode not handled by interpreter");
            }
        }

    reload_frame:
        continue;
    }
}

```

`src/loader.c`:

```c
/* loader.c - parse .gmod bytes into gexec_module */
#include "gexec.h"
#include "gexec_platform.h"

typedef struct {
    const uint8_t* base;
    uint32_t       size;
    uint32_t       pos;
} reader;

static int
r_bytes(reader* r, void* out, uint32_t n)
{
    if (r->pos + n > r->size || r->pos + n < r->pos) return 0;
    gexec_memcpy(out, r->base + r->pos, n);
    r->pos += n;
    return 1;
}
static const uint8_t*
r_peek(reader* r, uint32_t n)
{
    if (r->pos + n > r->size || r->pos + n < r->pos) return NULL;
    const uint8_t* p = r->base + r->pos;
    r->pos += n;
    return p;
}
static int
r_u32(reader* r, uint32_t* v) { return r_bytes(r, v, 4); }

static void
say(char* dst, uint32_t sz, const char* msg)
{
    if (!dst || sz == 0) return;
    unsigned i = 0;
    for (; msg[i] && i < sz - 1; i++) dst[i] = msg[i];
    dst[i] = 0;
}

int
gexec_find_export(const gexec_module* mod, const char* name)
{
    if (!mod || !name) return -1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_exports; i++) {
        int match = 1;
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < GIR_NAME_LEN; j++) {
            if (mod->exports[i].name[j] != name[j]) { match = 0; break; }
            if (name[j] == 0) break;
        }
        if (match) return (int)mod->exports[i].fn_idx;
    }
    return -1;
}

void
gexec_free(gexec_module* mod)
{
    if (!mod) return;
    if (mod->fns) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_fns; i++)
            if (mod->fns[i].insns) gexec_free_(mod->fns[i].insns, GEXEC_TAG_INSN);
        gexec_free_(mod->fns, GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    }
    if (mod->exports)   gexec_free_(mod->exports,   GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    if (mod->imports)   gexec_free_(mod->imports,   GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    if (mod->ftable)    gexec_free_(mod->ftable,    GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
    if (mod->seh)       gexec_free_(mod->seh,       GEXEC_TAG_SEH);
    if (mod->reg_stack) gexec_free_(mod->reg_stack, GEXEC_TAG_MEM);
    if (mod->mem)       gexec_free_(mod->mem,       GEXEC_TAG_MEM);
    gexec_free_(mod, GEXEC_TAG_MOD);
}

gexec_status_t
gexec_load(const void* bytes, uint32_t size, gexec_module** out_mod, char* err, uint32_t err_sz)
{
    if (!bytes || size < sizeof(gir_file_header) || !out_mod) {
        say(err, err_sz, "buffer too small"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    reader r = { (const uint8_t*)bytes, size, 0 };
    gir_file_header hdr;
    if (!r_bytes(&r, &hdr, sizeof(hdr)))     { say(err, err_sz, "short header"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    if (hdr.magic != GIR_MAGIC)              { say(err, err_sz, "bad magic"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    if (hdr.version != GIR_VERSION)          { say(err, err_sz, "unsupported version"); return GEXEC_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED; }
    if (hdr.n_imports > GIR_MAX_IMPORTS ||
        hdr.n_exports > GIR_MAX_EXPORTS ||
        hdr.n_functions > GIR_MAX_FUNCTIONS ||
        hdr.mem_pages > GIR_MAX_MEM_PAGES ||
        hdr.n_seh > GIR_MAX_SEH_SCOPES ||
        hdr.stack_pages > hdr.mem_pages) {
        say(err, err_sz, "counts exceed limits"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
    }

    gexec_module* mod = gexec_alloc(sizeof(*mod), GEXEC_TAG_MOD);
    if (!mod) { say(err, err_sz, "no memory for module"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
    gexec_memzero(mod, sizeof(*mod));
    mod->caps        = hdr.caps;
    mod->flags       = hdr.flags;
    mod->mem_pages   = hdr.mem_pages;
    mod->stack_pages = hdr.stack_pages;
    mod->mem_size    = hdr.mem_pages * GIR_PAGE_SIZE;
    mod->n_imports   = hdr.n_imports;
    mod->n_exports   = hdr.n_exports;
    mod->n_fns       = hdr.n_functions;
    mod->n_ftable    = hdr.n_ftable;
    mod->n_seh       = hdr.n_seh;
    mod->entry_fn    = hdr.entry_fn;

    if (mod->stack_pages) {
        mod->stack_base = mod->mem_size - mod->stack_pages * GIR_PAGE_SIZE;
        mod->stack_top  = mod->mem_size - 16;   /* leave a red zone */
    }

    if (mod->mem_size) {
        mod->mem = gexec_alloc(mod->mem_size, GEXEC_TAG_MEM);
        if (!mod->mem) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for linear mem"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
    }

    if (mod->n_imports) {
        mod->imports = gexec_alloc(mod->n_imports * sizeof(gexec_import), GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
        if (!mod->imports) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for imports"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
        gexec_memzero(mod->imports, mod->n_imports * sizeof(gexec_import));
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_imports; i++) {
            if (!r_bytes(&r, mod->imports[i].name, GIR_NAME_LEN)) {
                gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short import name"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
            }
            mod->imports[i].name[GIR_NAME_LEN - 1] = 0;
            mod->imports[i].host_idx = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        }
    }

    if (mod->n_exports) {
        mod->exports = gexec_alloc(mod->n_exports * sizeof(gexec_export), GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
        if (!mod->exports) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for exports"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_exports; i++) {
            gir_export e;
            if (!r_bytes(&r, &e, sizeof(e))) {
                gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short export"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
            }
            gexec_memcpy(mod->exports[i].name, e.name, GIR_NAME_LEN);
            mod->exports[i].name[GIR_NAME_LEN - 1] = 0;
            mod->exports[i].fn_idx = e.fn_idx;
        }
    }

    if (mod->n_fns) {
        mod->fns = gexec_alloc(mod->n_fns * sizeof(gexec_function), GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
        if (!mod->fns) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for fn table"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
        gexec_memzero(mod->fns, mod->n_fns * sizeof(gexec_function));
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_fns; i++) {
            gir_fn_header fh;
            if (!r_bytes(&r, &fh, sizeof(fh))) {
                gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short fn header"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
            }
            if (fh.n_regs > GIR_MAX_REGS || fh.n_insns > GIR_MAX_FUNC_INSNS ||
                fh.n_args > fh.n_regs) {
                gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "fn header oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
            }
            mod->fns[i].n_regs      = (uint16_t)fh.n_regs;
            mod->fns[i].n_insns     = fh.n_insns;
            mod->fns[i].n_args      = (uint16_t)fh.n_args;
            mod->fns[i].returns     = (uint16_t)fh.returns;
            mod->fns[i].stack_slots = fh.stack_slots;

            if (fh.n_insns) {
                uint32_t need = fh.n_insns * (uint32_t)sizeof(gir_insn);
                mod->fns[i].insns = gexec_alloc(need, GEXEC_TAG_INSN);
                if (!mod->fns[i].insns) {
                    gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for insns"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY;
                }
                if (!r_bytes(&r, mod->fns[i].insns, need)) {
                    gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short insn stream"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
                }
            }
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_exports; i++) {
            uint32_t f = mod->exports[i].fn_idx;
            if (f < mod->n_fns) {
                gexec_memcpy(mod->fns[f].name, mod->exports[i].name, GIR_NAME_LEN);
                mod->fns[f].name[GIR_NAME_LEN - 1] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < hdr.n_data; i++) {
        gir_data_header dh;
        if (!r_bytes(&r, &dh, sizeof(dh))) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short data hdr"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
        if ((uint64_t)dh.offset + dh.length > mod->mem_size) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "data oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
        const uint8_t* p = r_peek(&r, dh.length);
        if (!p) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short data bytes"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
        if (dh.length) gexec_memcpy(mod->mem + dh.offset, p, dh.length);
    }

    if (mod->n_ftable) {
        mod->ftable = gexec_alloc(mod->n_ftable * sizeof(uint32_t), GEXEC_TAG_TBL);
        if (!mod->ftable) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for ftable"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_ftable; i++) {
            if (!r_u32(&r, &mod->ftable[i])) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short ftable"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
        }
    }

    if (mod->n_seh) {
        mod->seh = gexec_alloc(mod->n_seh * sizeof(gir_seh_scope), GEXEC_TAG_SEH);
        if (!mod->seh) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "no memory for seh"); return GEXEC_STATUS_NO_MEMORY; }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_seh; i++) {
            if (!r_bytes(&r, &mod->seh[i], sizeof(gir_seh_scope))) {
                gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short seh"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
            }
        }
    }

    /* debug blob is copied ahead but ignored by the runtime; tools like the
     * GUI read it out separately for symbol mapping. */
    if (hdr.debug_size) {
        const uint8_t* d = r_peek(&r, hdr.debug_size);
        if (!d) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "short debug blob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    }

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_imports; i++) {
        const gexec_host_entry* h = gexec_host_lookup(mod->imports[i].name);
        if (h) {
            uint32_t count = gexec_host_count();
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                if (gexec_host_by_index(j) == h) { mod->imports[i].host_idx = j; break; }
            }
        }
    }

    /* rewrite HOST_CALL insns: assembler / lifter encodes imm = import index;
     * interpreter needs imm = host table index. remap once at load. */
    for (uint32_t fi = 0; fi < mod->n_fns; fi++) {
        gexec_function* fn = &mod->fns[fi];
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < fn->n_insns; k++) {
            gir_insn* in = &fn->insns[k];
            if (in->op != GIR_HOST_CALL) continue;
            uint32_t imp_i = (uint32_t)in->imm;
            if (imp_i >= mod->n_imports) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "hostcall import idx oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
            uint32_t hi = mod->imports[imp_i].host_idx;
            if (hi == 0xFFFFFFFFu) { gexec_free(mod); say(err, err_sz, "hostcall unresolved import"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
            in->imm = hi;
        }
    }

    /* init RSP for lifted modules that use the stack model. non-lifted
     * modules ignore the stack region unless they opt in via _rsp reg. */
    /* nothing to do here; ctx->frames[0]'s reg[RSP] is set by ioctl_call
     * from mod->stack_top before the first insn runs. */

    *out_mod = mod;
    return GEXEC_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

```

`src/verify.c`:

```c
/* verify.c - static module verifier */
#include "gexec.h"
#include "gexec_platform.h"

#define CAP_ALLOC       (1u << 0)
#define CAP_READ_KMEM   (1u << 1)
#define CAP_WRITE_KMEM  (1u << 2)
#define CAP_MSR_READ    (1u << 3)
#define CAP_MSR_WRITE   (1u << 4)
#define CAP_PHYSMEM     (1u << 5)
#define CAP_CPUID_TSC   (1u << 6)
#define CAP_CALLBACKS   (1u << 7)
#define CAP_HOSTCALL    (1u << 8)
#define CAP_INTROSPECT  (1u << 9)

static void
say(char* dst, uint32_t sz, const char* msg)
{
    if (!dst || sz == 0) return;
    unsigned i = 0;
    for (; msg[i] && i < sz - 1; i++) dst[i] = msg[i];
    dst[i] = 0;
}

static int reg_ok(uint16_t r, uint16_t n) { return r < n; }

static int
xmm_pair_ok(uint16_t r, uint16_t n) { return (uint32_t)r + 1 < (uint32_t)n; }

static int
op_needs_caps(uint16_t op, uint32_t* out)
{
    switch (op) {
    case GIR_KLOAD_I8:  case GIR_KLOAD_I16:  case GIR_KLOAD_I32:  case GIR_KLOAD_I64:
    case GIR_KLOAD_V128:
    case GIR_KLOAD_IDX_I64:
    case GIR_FSLOAD_I64: case GIR_GSLOAD_I64:
        *out = CAP_READ_KMEM; return 1;
    case GIR_KSTORE_I8: case GIR_KSTORE_I16: case GIR_KSTORE_I32: case GIR_KSTORE_I64:
    case GIR_KSTORE_V128:
    case GIR_KSTORE_IDX_I64:
    case GIR_FSSTORE_I64: case GIR_GSSTORE_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I32: case GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I32:   case GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I64:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I64: case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I128:
    case GIR_ATOMIC_BTS_I64:  case GIR_ATOMIC_BTR_I64:
        *out = CAP_WRITE_KMEM; return 1;
    case GIR_CALL_ABS_KVA:
        *out = CAP_HOSTCALL; return 1;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
}

static int
verify_fn(const gexec_module* mod, uint32_t fi, char* err, uint32_t err_sz)
{
    const gexec_function* fn = &mod->fns[fi];
    if (fn->n_insns == 0) return 1;

    uint16_t n_regs  = fn->n_regs;
    uint32_t n_insns = fn->n_insns;

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n_insns; i++) {
        const gir_insn* in = &fn->insns[i];
        uint16_t op = in->op;

        if (op >= GIR_OP_MAX) { say(err, err_sz, "unknown opcode"); return 0; }

        switch (op) {
        case GIR_NOP: case GIR_UNREACHABLE: case GIR_HALT: case GIR_INT3: case GIR_CPU_PAUSE:
        case GIR_MEM_FENCE: case GIR_MEM_LFENCE: case GIR_MEM_SFENCE:
        case GIR_TRAP:
        case GIR_DBG_MARK:
            break;

        case GIR_DBG_TRACE:
            /* variadic; verifier only checks src1 reg base. */
            if (in->src2 > 6) { say(err, err_sz, "dbg_trace argc>6"); return 0; }
            if (in->src2 && ((uint32_t)in->src1 + in->src2 > n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "dbg_trace reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_CONST_I32: case GIR_CONST_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "const dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_CONST_V128:
            /* v128 const is followed by an inline "gir_insn" slot carrying
             * the high 64 bits in imm. verify presence + xmm pair. */
            if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "const_v128 xmm pair oob"); return 0; }
            if (i + 1 >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "const_v128 truncated"); return 0; }
            i++;   /* skip the payload slot */
            break;

        case GIR_MOV:
        case GIR_NEG_I32: case GIR_NEG_I64: case GIR_NOT_I32: case GIR_NOT_I64:
        case GIR_CLZ_I32: case GIR_CLZ_I64: case GIR_CTZ_I32: case GIR_CTZ_I64:
        case GIR_POPCNT_I32: case GIR_POPCNT_I64:
        case GIR_BSWAP_I32: case GIR_BSWAP_I64:
        case GIR_EXTEND_I32_S: case GIR_EXTEND_I32_U:
        case GIR_EXTEND_I16_S: case GIR_EXTEND_I16_U:
        case GIR_EXTEND_I8_S:  case GIR_EXTEND_I8_U:
        case GIR_WRAP_I64: case GIR_WRAP_I32: case GIR_WRAP_I16:
        case GIR_EQZ_I32: case GIR_EQZ_I64:
        case GIR_BSF_I32: case GIR_BSF_I64:
        case GIR_BSR_I32: case GIR_BSR_I64:
        case GIR_LZCNT_I32: case GIR_LZCNT_I64:
        case GIR_TZCNT_I32: case GIR_TZCNT_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "unary reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_MOV_V128:
            if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "mov_v128 xmm oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_ADD_I32: case GIR_ADD_I64: case GIR_SUB_I32: case GIR_SUB_I64:
        case GIR_MUL_I32: case GIR_MUL_I64:
        case GIR_MUL_HI_S_I64: case GIR_MUL_HI_U_I64:
        case GIR_DIV_S_I32: case GIR_DIV_S_I64: case GIR_DIV_U_I32: case GIR_DIV_U_I64:
        case GIR_REM_S_I32: case GIR_REM_S_I64: case GIR_REM_U_I32: case GIR_REM_U_I64:
        case GIR_AND_I32: case GIR_AND_I64: case GIR_OR_I32: case GIR_OR_I64:
        case GIR_XOR_I32: case GIR_XOR_I64:
        case GIR_SHL_I32: case GIR_SHL_I64:
        case GIR_SHR_S_I32: case GIR_SHR_S_I64:
        case GIR_SHR_U_I32: case GIR_SHR_U_I64:
        case GIR_ROTL_I32: case GIR_ROTL_I64:
        case GIR_ROTR_I32: case GIR_ROTR_I64:
        case GIR_EQ_I32: case GIR_EQ_I64: case GIR_NE_I32: case GIR_NE_I64:
        case GIR_LT_S_I32: case GIR_LT_S_I64: case GIR_LT_U_I32: case GIR_LT_U_I64:
        case GIR_LE_S_I32: case GIR_LE_S_I64: case GIR_LE_U_I32: case GIR_LE_U_I64:
        case GIR_GT_S_I32: case GIR_GT_S_I64: case GIR_GT_U_I32: case GIR_GT_U_I64:
        case GIR_GE_S_I32: case GIR_GE_S_I64: case GIR_GE_U_I32: case GIR_GE_U_I64:
        case GIR_BT_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "binary reg oob"); return 0;
            }
            break;

        case GIR_BTS_I64: case GIR_BTR_I64: case GIR_BTC_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "bts reg oob"); return 0;
            }
            break;

        case GIR_ADD_IMM_I32: case GIR_ADD_IMM_I64:
        case GIR_SUB_IMM_I32: case GIR_SUB_IMM_I64:
        case GIR_AND_IMM_I64: case GIR_OR_IMM_I64: case GIR_XOR_IMM_I64:
        case GIR_SHL_IMM_I64: case GIR_SHR_U_IMM_I64: case GIR_SHR_S_IMM_I64:
        case GIR_MUL_IMM_I64:
        case GIR_CMP_IMM_I32: case GIR_CMP_IMM_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "imm binary reg oob"); return 0;
            }
            break;

        /* flag-writing arith. imm[15:0] = flag_reg. */
        case GIR_ADD_F_I32: case GIR_ADD_F_I64:
        case GIR_SUB_F_I32: case GIR_SUB_F_I64:
        case GIR_MUL_F_I32: case GIR_MUL_F_I64:
        case GIR_AND_F_I32: case GIR_AND_F_I64:
        case GIR_OR_F_I32:  case GIR_OR_F_I64:
        case GIR_XOR_F_I32: case GIR_XOR_F_I64:
        case GIR_SHL_F_I32: case GIR_SHL_F_I64:
        case GIR_SHR_U_F_I32: case GIR_SHR_U_F_I64:
        case GIR_SHR_S_F_I32: case GIR_SHR_S_F_I64:
        case GIR_CMP_F_I32: case GIR_CMP_F_I64:
        case GIR_TEST_F_I32: case GIR_TEST_F_I64: {
            uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in->imm;
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs) || !reg_ok(fr, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "flags binary reg oob"); return 0;
            }
            if (op != GIR_CMP_F_I32 && op != GIR_CMP_F_I64 &&
                op != GIR_TEST_F_I32 && op != GIR_TEST_F_I64) {
                if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "flags dst oob"); return 0; }
            }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_NEG_F_I32: case GIR_NEG_F_I64:
        case GIR_INC_F_I32: case GIR_INC_F_I64:
        case GIR_DEC_F_I32: case GIR_DEC_F_I64: {
            uint16_t fr = (uint16_t)in->imm;
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(fr, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "flags unary reg oob"); return 0;
            }
            break;
        }

        case GIR_LOAD_I8_S: case GIR_LOAD_I8_U:
        case GIR_LOAD_I16_S: case GIR_LOAD_I16_U:
        case GIR_LOAD_I32_S: case GIR_LOAD_I32_U:
        case GIR_LOAD_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "load reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_LOAD_V128:
            if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "load_v128 oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_STORE_I8: case GIR_STORE_I16: case GIR_STORE_I32: case GIR_STORE_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "store reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_STORE_V128:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "store_v128 oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_LOAD_IDX_I32_U: case GIR_LOAD_IDX_I64: {
            uint16_t idx = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 32);
            if (in->src1 != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "load_idx base oob"); return 0; }
            if (idx     != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(idx,       n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "load_idx index oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "load_idx dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_STORE_IDX_I32: case GIR_STORE_IDX_I64: {
            uint16_t idx = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 32);
            if (in->src1 != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "store_idx base oob"); return 0; }
            if (idx     != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(idx,       n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "store_idx index oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "store_idx value oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }

        case GIR_KLOAD_I8: case GIR_KLOAD_I16: case GIR_KLOAD_I32: case GIR_KLOAD_I64:
        case GIR_KLOAD_V128:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kload src reg oob"); return 0; }
            if (op == GIR_KLOAD_V128) { if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kload_v128 pair oob"); return 0; } }
            else if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kload dst reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_KSTORE_I8: case GIR_KSTORE_I16: case GIR_KSTORE_I32: case GIR_KSTORE_I64:
        case GIR_KSTORE_V128:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kstore addr oob"); return 0; }
            if (op == GIR_KSTORE_V128) { if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kstore_v128 pair oob"); return 0; } }
            else if (!reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kstore val oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_KLOAD_IDX_I64: case GIR_KSTORE_IDX_I64: {
            uint16_t idx = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 32);
            if (in->src1 != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kidx base oob"); return 0; }
            if (idx != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(idx, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kidx index oob"); return 0; }
            if (op == GIR_KLOAD_IDX_I64) { if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kload_idx dst oob"); return 0; } }
            else                          { if (!reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kstore_idx val oob"); return 0; } }
            break;
        }

        case GIR_FSLOAD_I64: case GIR_GSLOAD_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "seg load reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_FSSTORE_I64: case GIR_GSSTORE_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "seg store reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_BR:
            if (in->imm >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "br target oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_BR_IF: case GIR_BR_IF_NOT:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || in->imm >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "br_if oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_BR_TABLE: {
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "br_table reg oob"); return 0; }
            uint32_t count = (uint32_t)in->imm;
            uint32_t slots = (count + 1 + 1) / 2;
            if (i + slots >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "br_table truncated"); return 0; }
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k <= count; k++) {
                uint32_t si = i + 1 + k / 2;
                uint32_t half = k & 1;
                uint32_t t = half ? (uint32_t)(fn->insns[si].imm >> 32) : (uint32_t)fn->insns[si].imm;
                if (t >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "br_table target oob"); return 0; }
            }
            i += slots;
            break;
        }
        case GIR_JCC: {
            if (in->dst >= 16) { say(err, err_sz, "jcc cc oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "jcc flags reg oob"); return 0; }
            if (in->imm >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "jcc target oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_RETURN:
            if (in->src1 != 0xFFFF && !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "return reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_CALL: {
            uint32_t t = (uint32_t)in->imm;
            if (t >= mod->n_fns) { say(err, err_sz, "call target oob"); return 0; }
            const gexec_function* callee = &mod->fns[t];
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "call arg base oob"); return 0; }
            if ((uint32_t)in->src1 + callee->n_args > (uint32_t)n_regs) { say(err, err_sz, "call arg range oob"); return 0; }
            if (callee->returns && !reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "call dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_CALL_INDIRECT: {
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "indirect reg oob"); return 0; }
            uint16_t argc = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 32);
            if ((uint32_t)in->src2 + argc > (uint32_t)n_regs) { say(err, err_sz, "indirect arg range oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_CALL_ABS_KVA: {
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kvacall reg oob"); return 0; }
            uint16_t argc = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 32);
            if (argc > 6) { say(err, err_sz, "kvacall argc > 6"); return 0; }
            if ((uint32_t)in->src2 + argc > (uint32_t)n_regs) { say(err, err_sz, "kvacall arg range oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "kvacall dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_HOST_CALL: {
            uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)in->imm;
            if (hi >= gexec_host_count()) { say(err, err_sz, "host idx oob"); return 0; }
            const gexec_host_entry* he = gexec_host_by_index(hi);
            if ((mod->caps & he->required_caps) != he->required_caps) { say(err, err_sz, "host call denied by caps"); return 0; }
            uint16_t argc = in->src2;
            if (argc > GIR_MAX_CALL_ARGS || argc < he->min_argc || argc > he->max_argc) { say(err, err_sz, "host argc mismatch"); return 0; }
            if (argc && (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || (uint32_t)in->src1 + argc > (uint32_t)n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "host arg range oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "host dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }

        case GIR_SELECT: {
            uint16_t src3 = (uint16_t)in->imm;
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) ||
                !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs) || !reg_ok(src3, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "select reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_CMOV: {
            uint16_t cc = (uint16_t)in->imm;
            if (cc >= 16) { say(err, err_sz, "cmov cc oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "cmov reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_SETCC:
            if (in->src2 >= 16) { say(err, err_sz, "setcc cc oob"); return 0; }
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "setcc reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I32: case GIR_ATOMIC_XCHG_I64:
        case GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_ADD_I64:
        case GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_SUB_I64:
        case GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_AND_I64:
        case GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I32:   case GIR_ATOMIC_OR_I64:
        case GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I32:  case GIR_ATOMIC_XOR_I64:
        case GIR_ATOMIC_BTS_I64:  case GIR_ATOMIC_BTR_I64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "atomic reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I32: case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I64: {
            uint16_t exp_r = (uint16_t)in->imm;
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) ||
                !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs) || !reg_ok(exp_r, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "cas reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }
        case GIR_ATOMIC_CAS_I128: {
            uint16_t exp_lo = (uint16_t)in->imm;
            uint16_t exp_hi = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 16);
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) ||
                !xmm_pair_ok(in->src2, n_regs) ||
                !reg_ok(exp_lo, n_regs) || !reg_ok(exp_hi, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "cas128 reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        }

        case GIR_STACK_PUSH:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "push reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_STACK_POP:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "pop dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_STACK_ALLOC: case GIR_STACK_FREE:
            /* purely imm-driven, no reg checks. */
            break;

        case GIR_TRY_BEGIN: case GIR_TRY_END:
            if (in->imm >= mod->n_seh) { say(err, err_sz, "try scope oob"); return 0; }
            if (mod->seh[in->imm].fn_idx != fi) { say(err, err_sz, "try scope owner mismatch"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_RAISE: case GIR_RESUME:
            /* imm carries exception code / target; nothing to check beyond that. */
            if (op == GIR_RESUME && in->imm >= n_insns) { say(err, err_sz, "resume target oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_CFG_CHECK:
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "cfg reg oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        /* sse int ops - all use xmm pairs. */
        case GIR_XMM_PXOR: case GIR_XMM_POR: case GIR_XMM_PAND: case GIR_XMM_PANDN:
        case GIR_XMM_PADDB: case GIR_XMM_PADDW: case GIR_XMM_PADDD: case GIR_XMM_PADDQ:
        case GIR_XMM_PSUBB: case GIR_XMM_PSUBW: case GIR_XMM_PSUBD: case GIR_XMM_PSUBQ:
        case GIR_XMM_PCMPEQB: case GIR_XMM_PCMPEQW: case GIR_XMM_PCMPEQD:
        case GIR_XMM_PSHUFB:
        case GIR_XMM_PUNPCKLBW: case GIR_XMM_PUNPCKHBW:
            if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "sse xmm oob"); return 0;
            }
            break;
        case GIR_XMM_PMOVMSKB:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "pmovmskb oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_XMM_PSLLQ_IMM: case GIR_XMM_PSRLQ_IMM:
            if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "sse shift imm oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_XMM_MOVQ_TO_GPR:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !xmm_pair_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "movq2gpr oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_XMM_MOVQ_FROM_GPR:
            if (!xmm_pair_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "movq2xmm oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_REP_MOVSB: case GIR_REP_STOSB: case GIR_REP_CMPSB: case GIR_REP_SCASB:
        case GIR_REP_MOVSW: case GIR_REP_STOSW:
        case GIR_REP_MOVSD: case GIR_REP_STOSD:
        case GIR_REP_MOVSQ: case GIR_REP_STOSQ: {
            uint16_t cnt = (uint16_t)(in->imm >> 16);
            if (!reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs) || !reg_ok(cnt, n_regs)) {
                say(err, err_sz, "rep reg oob"); return 0;
            }
            break;
        }

        case GIR_CONST_F32: case GIR_CONST_F64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "const_f dst oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_FNEG_F32: case GIR_FNEG_F64:
        case GIR_FABS_F32: case GIR_FABS_F64:
        case GIR_FSQRT_F32: case GIR_FSQRT_F64:
        case GIR_FCEIL_F32: case GIR_FCEIL_F64:
        case GIR_FFLOOR_F32: case GIR_FFLOOR_F64:
        case GIR_FTRUNC_F32: case GIR_FTRUNC_F64:
        case GIR_FNEAREST_F32: case GIR_FNEAREST_F64:
        case GIR_F32_TO_F64: case GIR_F64_TO_F32:
        case GIR_F32_TO_I32_S: case GIR_F32_TO_I32_U:
        case GIR_F32_TO_I64_S: case GIR_F32_TO_I64_U:
        case GIR_F64_TO_I32_S: case GIR_F64_TO_I32_U:
        case GIR_F64_TO_I64_S: case GIR_F64_TO_I64_U:
        case GIR_I32_S_TO_F32: case GIR_I32_U_TO_F32:
        case GIR_I32_S_TO_F64: case GIR_I32_U_TO_F64:
        case GIR_I64_S_TO_F32: case GIR_I64_U_TO_F32:
        case GIR_I64_S_TO_F64: case GIR_I64_U_TO_F64:
        case GIR_F32_REINT_I32: case GIR_F64_REINT_I64:
        case GIR_I32_REINT_F32: case GIR_I64_REINT_F64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "f unary oob"); return 0; }
            break;
        case GIR_FADD_F32: case GIR_FADD_F64:
        case GIR_FSUB_F32: case GIR_FSUB_F64:
        case GIR_FMUL_F32: case GIR_FMUL_F64:
        case GIR_FDIV_F32: case GIR_FDIV_F64:
        case GIR_FMIN_F32: case GIR_FMIN_F64:
        case GIR_FMAX_F32: case GIR_FMAX_F64:
        case GIR_FCOPYSIGN_F32: case GIR_FCOPYSIGN_F64:
        case GIR_FEQ_F32: case GIR_FEQ_F64:
        case GIR_FNE_F32: case GIR_FNE_F64:
        case GIR_FLT_F32: case GIR_FLT_F64:
        case GIR_FLE_F32: case GIR_FLE_F64:
        case GIR_FGT_F32: case GIR_FGT_F64:
        case GIR_FGE_F32: case GIR_FGE_F64:
            if (!reg_ok(in->dst, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src1, n_regs) || !reg_ok(in->src2, n_regs)) { say(err, err_sz, "f bin oob"); return 0; }
            break;

        case GIR_PHI:
            say(err, err_sz, "phi survived to verifier"); return 0;

        default:
            say(err, err_sz, "opcode not covered by verifier"); return 0;
        }

        uint32_t need = 0;
        if (op_needs_caps(op, &need) && (mod->caps & need) != need) {
            say(err, err_sz, "op denied by caps"); return 0;
        }
    }

    /* last insn must terminate. RETURN / BR / TRAP / UNREACHABLE / HALT / RAISE. */
    const gir_insn* last = &fn->insns[n_insns - 1];
    if (last->op != GIR_RETURN && last->op != GIR_BR && last->op != GIR_TRAP &&
        last->op != GIR_UNREACHABLE && last->op != GIR_HALT && last->op != GIR_RAISE) {
        say(err, err_sz, "fn falls off end without terminator"); return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

gexec_status_t
gexec_verify(const gexec_module* mod, char* err, uint32_t err_sz)
{
    if (!mod) return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_ftable; i++)
        if (mod->ftable[i] >= mod->n_fns) { say(err, err_sz, "ftable entry oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_exports; i++)
        if (mod->exports[i].fn_idx >= mod->n_fns) { say(err, err_sz, "export fn_idx oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_imports; i++)
        if (mod->imports[i].host_idx == 0xFFFFFFFFu) { say(err, err_sz, "unresolved import"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    if (mod->entry_fn != 0xFFFFFFFFu && mod->entry_fn >= mod->n_fns) { say(err, err_sz, "entry_fn oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_seh; i++) {
        const gir_seh_scope* s = &mod->seh[i];
        if (s->fn_idx >= mod->n_fns) { say(err, err_sz, "seh fn_idx oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
        const gexec_function* fn = &mod->fns[s->fn_idx];
        if (s->begin_insn >= fn->n_insns || s->end_insn > fn->n_insns || s->begin_insn > s->end_insn) {
            say(err, err_sz, "seh range oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;
        }
        if (s->handler_fn >= mod->n_fns) { say(err, err_sz, "seh handler oob"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
        if (s->kind != GIR_SEH_EXCEPT && s->kind != GIR_SEH_FINALLY) { say(err, err_sz, "seh kind"); return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT; }
    }

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mod->n_fns; i++)
        if (!verify_fn(mod, i, err, err_sz)) return GEXEC_STATUS_INVALID_FORMAT;

    return GEXEC_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

```

```c
#define MAX_IMPORTS   512
#define MAX_EXPORTS   512
#define MAX_FUNCS     4096
#define MAX_LABELS    2048
#define MAX_DATA      128
#define MAX_SEH       1024
#define MAX_FTABLE    2048

typedef struct { char name[GIR_NAME_LEN]; uint32_t insn_index; } label_t;

typedef struct {
    char        name[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint16_t    n_regs, n_args, returns, _pad;
    uint32_t    stack_slots;
    gir_insn*   insns;
    uint32_t    n_insns, cap_insns;
    label_t*    labels;
    uint32_t    n_labels;
    struct {
        uint32_t insn;
        char     symbol[GIR_NAME_LEN];
        int      kind;   /* 0 = label, 1 = fn symbol */
    }* fixups;
    uint32_t    n_fixups, cap_fixups;
} func_t;

typedef struct { uint32_t offset; uint32_t length; uint8_t* bytes; } data_seg_t;

typedef struct {
    char        fn[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    char        begin_label[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    char        end_label[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    char        handler[GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint32_t    kind;
} seh_pending_t;

typedef struct {
    char        mod_name[64];
    uint32_t    caps;
    uint32_t    mem_pages;
    uint32_t    stack_pages;
    uint32_t    flags;
    char        imports[MAX_IMPORTS][GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint32_t    n_imports;
    struct { char name[GIR_NAME_LEN]; uint32_t fn_idx; } exports[MAX_EXPORTS];
    uint32_t    n_exports;
    char        ftable_syms[MAX_FTABLE][GIR_NAME_LEN];
    uint32_t    n_ftable;
    func_t      funcs[MAX_FUNCS];
    uint32_t    n_funcs;
    data_seg_t  data[MAX_DATA];
    uint32_t    n_data;
    seh_pending_t sehs[MAX_SEH];
    uint32_t    n_sehs;
} unit_t;

static unit_t g_unit;

static void die(const char* fmt, ...) {
    va_list a; va_start(a, fmt);
    fprintf(stderr, "gasm: "); vfprintf(stderr, fmt, a); fprintf(stderr, "\n");
    va_end(a); exit(1);
}

static char* strip(char* s) {
    while (*s == ' ' || *s == '\t' || *s == '\r' || *s == '\n') s++;
    char* e = s + strlen(s);
    while (e > s && (e[-1] == ' ' || e[-1] == '\t' || e[-1] == '\r' || e[-1] == '\n')) *--e = 0;
    return s;
}

static int str_ci_eq(const char* a, const char* b) {
    for (;;) {
        char c = *a++, d = *b++;
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c += 32;
        if (d >= 'A' && d <= 'Z') d += 32;
        if (c != d) return 0;
        if (c == 0) return 1;
    }
}

static const op_spec* lookup_op(const char* m) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(g_ops) / sizeof(g_ops[0]); i++)
        if (str_ci_eq(g_ops[i].mnemonic, m)) return &g_ops[i];
    return NULL;
}

static uint16_t parse_reg(const char* t) {
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "none")) return 0xFFFF;
    if (t[0] != 'r' && t[0] != 'R') die("expected register, got '%s'", t);
    long v = strtol(t + 1, NULL, 10);
    if (v < 0 || v >= GIR_MAX_REGS) die("register out of range: %s", t);
    return (uint16_t)v;
}

static int64_t parse_imm(const char* t) {
    if (t[0] == '-') {
        if (t[1] == '0' && (t[2] == 'x' || t[2] == 'X')) return -(int64_t)strtoull(t + 3, NULL, 16);
        return (int64_t)strtoll(t, NULL, 10);
    }
    if (t[0] == '0' && (t[1] == 'x' || t[1] == 'X'))
        return (int64_t)strtoull(t + 2, NULL, 16);
    return (int64_t)strtoll(t, NULL, 10);
}

static uint32_t parse_cc(const char* t) {
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "o"))  return GIR_CC_O;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "no")) return GIR_CC_NO;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "b") || str_ci_eq(t, "c")   || str_ci_eq(t, "nae")) return GIR_CC_B;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "ae")|| str_ci_eq(t, "nc") || str_ci_eq(t, "nb"))  return GIR_CC_AE;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "e") || str_ci_eq(t, "z"))  return GIR_CC_E;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "ne")|| str_ci_eq(t, "nz")) return GIR_CC_NE;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "be")|| str_ci_eq(t, "na")) return GIR_CC_BE;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "a") || str_ci_eq(t, "nbe")) return GIR_CC_A;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "s"))  return GIR_CC_S;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "ns")) return GIR_CC_NS;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "p") || str_ci_eq(t, "pe")) return GIR_CC_P;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "np")|| str_ci_eq(t, "po")) return GIR_CC_NP;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "l") || str_ci_eq(t, "nge")) return GIR_CC_L;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "ge")|| str_ci_eq(t, "nl"))  return GIR_CC_GE;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "le")|| str_ci_eq(t, "ng"))  return GIR_CC_LE;
    if (str_ci_eq(t, "g") || str_ci_eq(t, "nle")) return GIR_CC_G;
    die("bad cc: %s", t);
    return 0;
}

static uint32_t parse_caps(const char* s) {
    uint32_t v = 0;
    char buf[512]; strncpy(buf, s, sizeof(buf) - 1); buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = 0;
    char* p = buf;
    while (*p) {
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '|' || *p == '\t') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        char* start = p;
        while (*p && *p != '|' && *p != ' ' && *p != '\t') p++;
        char save = *p; *p = 0;
        if (start[0] == '0' && (start[1] == 'x' || start[1] == 'X'))            v |= (uint32_t)strtoul(start + 2, NULL, 16);
        else if (start[0] >= '0' && start[0] <= '9')                             v |= (uint32_t)strtoul(start, NULL, 10);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "alloc"))       v |= (1u << 0);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "read_kmem"))   v |= (1u << 1);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "write_kmem"))  v |= (1u << 2);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "msr_read"))    v |= (1u << 3);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "msr_write"))   v |= (1u << 4);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "physmem"))     v |= (1u << 5);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "cpuid_tsc"))   v |= (1u << 6);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "callbacks"))   v |= (1u << 7);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "hostcall"))    v |= (1u << 8);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "introspect"))  v |= (1u << 9);
        else if (str_ci_eq(start, "all"))         v |= 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        else die("unknown cap: %s", start);
        *p = save;
    }
    return v;
}

static int parse_c_string(const char* in, uint8_t** out_bytes, uint32_t* out_len) {
    if (*in != '"') return 0;
    in++;
    size_t cap = 32, n = 0;
    uint8_t* b = malloc(cap);
    while (*in && *in != '"') {
        uint8_t c = (uint8_t)*in++;
        if (c == '\\' && *in) {
            char e = *in++;
            switch (e) {
            case 'n': c = '\n'; break;
            case 't': c = '\t'; break;
            case 'r': c = '\r'; break;
            case '\\': c = '\\'; break;
            case '"': c = '"'; break;
            case '0': c = 0; break;
            case 'x': { char h[3] = { in[0], in[1], 0 }; c = (uint8_t)strtoul(h, NULL, 16); in += 2; break; }
            default: c = (uint8_t)e; break;
            }
        }
        if (n >= cap) { cap *= 2; b = realloc(b, cap); }
        b[n++] = c;
    }
    *out_bytes = b; *out_len = (uint32_t)n;
    return 1;
}

static func_t* cur_func = NULL;

static void func_reserve_insn(func_t* f) {
    if (f->n_insns >= f->cap_insns) {
        f->cap_insns = f->cap_insns ? f->cap_insns * 2 : 128;
        f->insns = realloc(f->insns, f->cap_insns * sizeof(gir_insn));
    }
}
static void func_reserve_fixup(func_t* f) {
    if (f->n_fixups >= f->cap_fixups) {
        f->cap_fixups = f->cap_fixups ? f->cap_fixups * 2 : 32;
        f->fixups = realloc(f->fixups, f->cap_fixups * sizeof(f->fixups[0]));
    }
}
static void func_reserve_label(func_t* f) {
    if (f->labels == NULL) f->labels = calloc(MAX_LABELS, sizeof(label_t));
}

static void name_copy(char dst[GIR_NAME_LEN], const char* src) {
    memset(dst, 0, GIR_NAME_LEN);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < GIR_NAME_LEN - 1 && src[i]; i++) dst[i] = src[i];
}

static void tokenize(char* line, char* toks[], int max, int* n) {
    *n = 0;
    char* p = line;
    while (*p && *n < max) {
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == ',') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        if (*p == '"') {
            toks[(*n)++] = p; p++;
            while (*p && *p != '"') { if (*p == '\\' && p[1]) p++; p++; }
            if (*p == '"') p++;
            if (*p) *p++ = 0;
            continue;
        }
        toks[(*n)++] = p;
        while (*p && *p != ' ' && *p != '\t' && *p != ',') p++;
        if (*p) *p++ = 0;
    }
}

static uint32_t add_import(const char* n) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_imports; i++)
        if (strcmp(g_unit.imports[i], n) == 0) return i;
    if (g_unit.n_imports >= MAX_IMPORTS) die("too many imports");
    name_copy(g_unit.imports[g_unit.n_imports], n);
    return g_unit.n_imports++;
}

static uint32_t find_func(const char* n) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_funcs; i++)
        if (strcmp(g_unit.funcs[i].name, n) == 0) return i;
    die("unknown function: %s", n);
    return 0;
}

static void emit_insn(func_t* f, uint16_t op, uint16_t dst, uint16_t s1, uint16_t s2, uint64_t imm) {
    func_reserve_insn(f);
    gir_insn* in = &f->insns[f->n_insns++];
    in->op = op; in->dst = dst; in->src1 = s1; in->src2 = s2; in->imm = imm;
}

static void add_fixup(func_t* f, uint32_t insn_i, const char* sym, int kind) {
    func_reserve_fixup(f);
    f->fixups[f->n_fixups].insn = insn_i;
    name_copy(f->fixups[f->n_fixups].symbol, sym);
    f->fixups[f->n_fixups].kind = kind;
    f->n_fixups++;
}

static void add_label(func_t* f, const char* name) {
    func_reserve_label(f);
    if (f->n_labels >= MAX_LABELS) die("too many labels");
    name_copy(f->labels[f->n_labels].name, name);
    f->labels[f->n_labels].insn_index = f->n_insns;
    f->n_labels++;
}

static void
parse_line(char* line, unsigned lno)
{
    for (char* p = line; *p; p++) if (*p == ';') { *p = 0; break; }
    char* s = strip(line);
    if (!*s) return;

    char* colon = strchr(s, ':');
    if (colon && (!strchr(s, ' ') || colon < strchr(s, ' '))) {
        *colon = 0;
        char* lab = strip(s);
        if (!cur_func) die("line %u: label outside function", lno);
        add_label(cur_func, lab);
        char* rest = strip(colon + 1);
        if (*rest) parse_line(rest, lno);
        return;
    }

    char* toks[32];
    int n = 0;
    tokenize(s, toks, 32, &n);
    if (n == 0) return;

    if (toks[0][0] == '.') {
        const char* d = toks[0] + 1;
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "module")) {
            if (n < 2) die("line %u: .module needs name", lno);
            uint8_t* b = NULL; uint32_t bl = 0;
            if (parse_c_string(toks[1], &b, &bl)) {
                uint32_t c = bl < 63 ? bl : 63;
                memcpy(g_unit.mod_name, b, c); g_unit.mod_name[c] = 0;
                free(b);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "caps")) {
            char rest[512] = {0};
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { strncat(rest, toks[i], sizeof(rest) - strlen(rest) - 1); strncat(rest, " ", sizeof(rest) - strlen(rest) - 1); }
            g_unit.caps = parse_caps(rest);
            return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "mem_pages")) {
            if (n < 2) die("line %u: .mem_pages needs value", lno);
            g_unit.mem_pages = (uint32_t)parse_imm(toks[1]); return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "stack_pages")) {
            if (n < 2) die("line %u: .stack_pages needs value", lno);
            g_unit.stack_pages = (uint32_t)parse_imm(toks[1]);
            g_unit.flags |= GIR_FLAG_USES_STACK; return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "import")) {
            if (n < 2) die("line %u: .import needs name", lno);
            add_import(toks[1]); return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "export")) {
            if (n < 2) die("line %u: .export needs fn name", lno);
            if (g_unit.n_exports >= MAX_EXPORTS) die("too many exports");
            name_copy(g_unit.exports[g_unit.n_exports].name, toks[1]);
            g_unit.exports[g_unit.n_exports].fn_idx = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
            g_unit.n_exports++; return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "data")) {
            if (n < 3) die("line %u: .data needs offset and string", lno);
            uint32_t off = (uint32_t)parse_imm(toks[1]);
            uint8_t* b = NULL; uint32_t bl = 0;
            if (!parse_c_string(toks[2], &b, &bl)) die("line %u: .data value not string", lno);
            if (g_unit.n_data >= MAX_DATA) die("too many data segments");
            g_unit.data[g_unit.n_data].offset = off;
            g_unit.data[g_unit.n_data].length = bl;
            g_unit.data[g_unit.n_data].bytes  = b;
            g_unit.n_data++; return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "ftable")) {
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (g_unit.n_ftable >= MAX_FTABLE) die("too many ftable entries");
                name_copy(g_unit.ftable_syms[g_unit.n_ftable++], toks[i]);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "seh")) {
            if (n < 6) die("line %u: .seh needs 5 fields", lno);
            if (g_unit.n_sehs >= MAX_SEH) die("too many seh scopes");
            seh_pending_t* s2 = &g_unit.sehs[g_unit.n_sehs++];
            memset(s2, 0, sizeof(*s2));
            name_copy(s2->fn, toks[1]);
            for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) {
                if (strncmp(toks[i], "begin=", 6) == 0)   name_copy(s2->begin_label, toks[i] + 6);
                else if (strncmp(toks[i], "end=", 4) == 0)     name_copy(s2->end_label, toks[i] + 4);
                else if (strncmp(toks[i], "handler=", 8) == 0) name_copy(s2->handler, toks[i] + 8);
                else if (strncmp(toks[i], "kind=", 5) == 0)    s2->kind = str_ci_eq(toks[i]+5, "except") ? GIR_SEH_EXCEPT : GIR_SEH_FINALLY;
                else die("line %u: unknown .seh field %s", lno, toks[i]);
            }
            g_unit.flags |= GIR_FLAG_HAS_SEH;
            return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "func")) {
            if (n < 2) die("line %u: .func needs name", lno);
            if (g_unit.n_funcs >= MAX_FUNCS) die("too many funcs");
            cur_func = &g_unit.funcs[g_unit.n_funcs++];
            memset(cur_func, 0, sizeof(*cur_func));
            name_copy(cur_func->name, toks[1]);
            cur_func->n_regs = 8;
            cur_func->returns = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) {
                if (strncmp(toks[i], "regs=", 5) == 0)      cur_func->n_regs = (uint16_t)parse_imm(toks[i] + 5);
                else if (strncmp(toks[i], "args=", 5) == 0) cur_func->n_args = (uint16_t)parse_imm(toks[i] + 5);
                else if (strncmp(toks[i], "returns=", 8) == 0) cur_func->returns = (uint16_t)parse_imm(toks[i] + 8);
                else if (strncmp(toks[i], "stack_slots=", 12) == 0) cur_func->stack_slots = (uint32_t)parse_imm(toks[i] + 12);
                else die("line %u: unknown .func attr %s", lno, toks[i]);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (str_ci_eq(d, "end")) { cur_func = NULL; return; }
        die("line %u: unknown directive .%s", lno, d);
    }

    if (!cur_func) die("line %u: instruction outside function", lno);
    const op_spec* sp = lookup_op(toks[0]);
    if (!sp) die("line %u: unknown mnemonic '%s'", lno, toks[0]);

    uint16_t dst = 0, s1 = 0, s2 = 0;
    uint64_t imm = 0;

    int ti = 1;
    for (const char* fp = sp->form; *fp; fp++) {
        if (ti >= n && *fp != 'R') die("line %u: missing operand for %s", lno, toks[0]);
        switch (*fp) {
        case 'd': dst = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); break;
        case '1': s1  = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); break;
        case '2': s2  = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); break;
        case 'e': { uint16_t r = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); imm = (imm & ~0xFFFFull) | r; break; }
        case 'i': imm = (uint64_t)parse_imm(toks[ti++]); break;
        case 'l': add_fixup(cur_func, cur_func->n_insns, toks[ti++], 0); imm = 0xFFFFFFFFull; break;
        case 's': add_fixup(cur_func, cur_func->n_insns, toks[ti++], 1); imm = 0xFFFFFFFFull; break;
        case 'n': imm = add_import(toks[ti++]); break;
        case 'a': {
            uint16_t argc = (uint16_t)parse_imm(toks[ti++]);
            if (sp->op == GIR_HOST_CALL) s2 = argc;
            else imm |= ((uint64_t)argc) << 32;
            break;
        }
        case 'c': {
            uint32_t cc = parse_cc(toks[ti++]);
            if (sp->op == GIR_JCC)        dst = (uint16_t)cc;
            else if (sp->op == GIR_SETCC) s2  = (uint16_t)cc;
            else                           imm = (imm & ~0xFFFFull) | cc;
            break;
        }
        case 'f': s1 = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); break;
        case 'F': { uint16_t fr = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); imm = (imm & ~0xFFFFull) | fr; break; }
        case 'D': { int32_t d = (int32_t)parse_imm(toks[ti++]); imm = (imm & ~0xFFFFFFFFull) | (uint32_t)d; break; }
        case 'S': {
            uint64_t sc = (uint64_t)parse_imm(toks[ti++]);
            uint8_t log2 = sc == 1 ? 0 : sc == 2 ? 1 : sc == 4 ? 2 : sc == 8 ? 3 : 255;
            if (log2 == 255) die("line %u: bad scale %llu", lno, (unsigned long long)sc);
            imm = (imm & ~(0xFFull << 40)) | ((uint64_t)log2 << 40);
            break;
        }
        case 'I': { uint16_t r = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); imm = (imm & ~(0xFFFFull << 32)) | ((uint64_t)r << 32); break; }
        case 'B': s1 = parse_reg(toks[ti++]); break;
        case 'R': s1 = (ti < n) ? parse_reg(toks[ti++]) : 0xFFFF; break;
        case 'X': imm = (uint64_t)parse_imm(toks[ti++]); break;
        case 'E': imm = (uint64_t)parse_imm(toks[ti++]); break;
        default: die("line %u: bad form char %c in %s", lno, *fp, sp->mnemonic);
        }
    }

    /* rep string ops have variable trailing params: cnt reg + optional df reg */
    if (sp->op >= GIR_REP_MOVSB && sp->op <= GIR_REP_STOSQ) {
        if (ti >= n) die("line %u: rep needs count register", lno);
        uint16_t cnt = parse_reg(toks[ti++]);
        imm = (imm & ~(0xFFFFull << 16)) | ((uint64_t)cnt << 16);
        uint16_t df = 0xFFFF;
        if (ti < n) df = parse_reg(toks[ti++]);
        imm = (imm & ~(0xFFFFull << 32)) | ((uint64_t)df << 32);
    }

    emit_insn(cur_func, sp->op, dst, s1, s2, imm);
}

static void
resolve_fixups(void)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_exports; i++) {
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < g_unit.n_funcs; j++)
            if (strcmp(g_unit.exports[i].name, g_unit.funcs[j].name) == 0) { g_unit.exports[i].fn_idx = j; break; }
        if (g_unit.exports[i].fn_idx == 0xFFFFFFFFu)
            die("exported function not defined: %s", g_unit.exports[i].name);
    }
    for (uint32_t fi = 0; fi < g_unit.n_funcs; fi++) {
        func_t* f = &g_unit.funcs[fi];
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < f->n_fixups; k++) {
            const char* sym = f->fixups[k].symbol;
            uint32_t insn = f->fixups[k].insn;
            if (f->fixups[k].kind == 0) {
                int found = -1;
                for (uint32_t l = 0; l < f->n_labels; l++)
                    if (strcmp(f->labels[l].name, sym) == 0) { found = (int)f->labels[l].insn_index; break; }
                if (found < 0) die("%s: undefined label %s", f->name, sym);
                f->insns[insn].imm = (uint64_t)found;
            } else {
                f->insns[insn].imm = find_func(sym);
            }
        }
    }
}

static gir_seh_scope*
resolve_sehs(uint32_t* out_count)
{
    if (g_unit.n_sehs == 0) { *out_count = 0; return NULL; }
    gir_seh_scope* out = calloc(g_unit.n_sehs, sizeof(gir_seh_scope));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_sehs; i++) {
        seh_pending_t* s = &g_unit.sehs[i];
        uint32_t fi = find_func(s->fn);
        func_t* f = &g_unit.funcs[fi];
        int b = -1, e = -1;
        for (uint32_t l = 0; l < f->n_labels; l++) {
            if (strcmp(f->labels[l].name, s->begin_label) == 0) b = (int)f->labels[l].insn_index;
            if (strcmp(f->labels[l].name, s->end_label) == 0)   e = (int)f->labels[l].insn_index;
        }
        if (b < 0 || e < 0) die(".seh missing label(s) for fn %s", s->fn);
        out[i].fn_idx     = fi;
        out[i].begin_insn = (uint32_t)b;
        out[i].end_insn   = (uint32_t)e;
        out[i].handler_fn = find_func(s->handler);
        out[i].kind       = s->kind ? s->kind : GIR_SEH_EXCEPT;
    }
    *out_count = g_unit.n_sehs;
    return out;
}

static void write_all(FILE* out, const void* p, size_t n) { if (fwrite(p, 1, n, out) != n) die("write failed"); }

static void
emit_gmod(const char* path)
{
    resolve_fixups();
    uint32_t n_seh = 0;
    gir_seh_scope* sehs = resolve_sehs(&n_seh);

    FILE* out = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!out) die("cant open output %s", path);

    gir_file_header hdr = { 0 };
    hdr.magic       = GIR_MAGIC;
    hdr.version     = GIR_VERSION;
    hdr.flags       = g_unit.flags | GIR_FLAG_HAND_ASM;
    hdr.caps        = g_unit.caps;
    hdr.mem_pages   = g_unit.mem_pages ? g_unit.mem_pages : 1;
    hdr.stack_pages = g_unit.stack_pages;
    hdr.n_imports   = g_unit.n_imports;
    hdr.n_exports   = g_unit.n_exports;
    hdr.n_functions = g_unit.n_funcs;
    hdr.n_data      = g_unit.n_data;
    hdr.n_ftable    = g_unit.n_ftable;
    hdr.n_seh       = n_seh;
    hdr.entry_fn    = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    write_all(out, &hdr, sizeof(hdr));

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_imports; i++) {
        char nb[GIR_NAME_LEN] = {0};
        strncpy(nb, g_unit.imports[i], GIR_NAME_LEN - 1);
        write_all(out, nb, GIR_NAME_LEN);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_exports; i++) {
        gir_export e = { 0 };
        memcpy(e.name, g_unit.exports[i].name, GIR_NAME_LEN);
        e.fn_idx = g_unit.exports[i].fn_idx;
        write_all(out, &e, sizeof(e));
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_funcs; i++) {
        func_t* f = &g_unit.funcs[i];
        gir_fn_header fh = { 0 };
        fh.n_regs      = f->n_regs;
        fh.n_insns     = f->n_insns;
        fh.n_args      = f->n_args;
        fh.returns     = f->returns;
        fh.stack_slots = f->stack_slots;
        write_all(out, &fh, sizeof(fh));
        if (f->n_insns) write_all(out, f->insns, f->n_insns * sizeof(gir_insn));
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_data; i++) {
        gir_data_header dh = { g_unit.data[i].offset, g_unit.data[i].length };
        write_all(out, &dh, sizeof(dh));
        if (dh.length) write_all(out, g_unit.data[i].bytes, dh.length);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_unit.n_ftable; i++) {
        uint32_t fi = find_func(g_unit.ftable_syms[i]);
        write_all(out, &fi, 4);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n_seh; i++) write_all(out, &sehs[i], sizeof(gir_seh_scope));

    if (sehs) free(sehs);
    fclose(out);
    fprintf(stderr, "gasm: wrote %s  imports=%u exports=%u funcs=%u data=%u seh=%u\n",
            path, g_unit.n_imports, g_unit.n_exports, g_unit.n_funcs, g_unit.n_data, n_seh);
}

int
main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    const char* in_path = NULL;
    const char* out_path = "out.gmod";
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) { out_path = argv[++i]; continue; }
        if (argv[i][0] == '-') die("unknown flag %s", argv[i]);
        in_path = argv[i];
    }
    if (!in_path) die("usage: gasm input.gasm -o output.gmod");

    FILE* f = fopen(in_path, "rb");
    if (!f) die("cant open %s", in_path);
    char line[2048];
    unsigned lno = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) { lno++; parse_line(line, lno); }
    fclose(f);

    emit_gmod(out_path);
    return 0;
}

```

`tools/gmodinfo/gmodinfo.c`:

```c
/* gmod-info.c - dump the structure of a .gmod file.
 * usage: gmod-info file.gmod
 * validates the header, prints imports/exports/functions/data/seh, and
 * emits a per-function insn count so bad emits can be spotted quickly. */
#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include <gexec/gir.h>

static uint8_t*
slurp(const char* p, size_t* sz)
{
    FILE* f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t* b = malloc(n);
    if (fread(b, 1, n, f) != (size_t)n) { free(b); fclose(f); return NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    *sz = (size_t)n;
    return b;
}

int
main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gmod-info file.gmod\n"); return 1; }
    size_t sz;
    uint8_t* buf = slurp(argv[1], &sz);
    if (!buf) { fprintf(stderr, "cant open %s\n", argv[1]); return 2; }
    if (sz < sizeof(gir_file_header)) { fprintf(stderr, "short\n"); return 3; }

    gir_file_header h;
    memcpy(&h, buf, sizeof(h));
    if (h.magic != GIR_MAGIC) { fprintf(stderr, "bad magic %08x\n", h.magic); return 4; }

    printf("== %s ==\n", argv[1]);
    printf("magic       %08x\n", h.magic);
    printf("version     %u\n", h.version);
    printf("flags       %08x", h.flags);
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_LIFTED_PE)  printf(" LIFTED_PE");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_HAND_ASM)   printf(" HAND_ASM");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_STRIPPED)   printf(" STRIPPED");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_HAS_SEH)    printf(" HAS_SEH");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_USES_SSE)   printf(" USES_SSE");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_USES_STACK) printf(" USES_STACK");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_GUARD_CF)   printf(" GUARD_CF");
    if (h.flags & GIR_FLAG_DEBUG_INFO) printf(" DEBUG_INFO");
    printf("\n");
    printf("caps        %08x\n", h.caps);
    printf("mem_pages   %u  (%u bytes)\n", h.mem_pages, h.mem_pages * GIR_PAGE_SIZE);
    printf("stack_pages %u\n", h.stack_pages);
    printf("imports     %u\n", h.n_imports);
    printf("exports     %u\n", h.n_exports);
    printf("functions   %u\n", h.n_functions);
    printf("data segs   %u\n", h.n_data);
    printf("ftable      %u\n", h.n_ftable);
    printf("seh scopes  %u\n", h.n_seh);
    printf("entry_fn    %s%u\n", h.entry_fn == 0xFFFFFFFFu ? "(none) " : "", h.entry_fn);

    size_t pos = sizeof(h);

    printf("\nimports:\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.n_imports; i++) {
        char nm[GIR_NAME_LEN + 1] = {0};
        memcpy(nm, buf + pos, GIR_NAME_LEN);
        printf("  [%u] %s\n", i, nm);
        pos += GIR_NAME_LEN;
    }

    printf("\nexports:\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.n_exports; i++) {
        gir_export e; memcpy(&e, buf + pos, sizeof(e)); pos += sizeof(e);
        char nm[GIR_NAME_LEN + 1] = {0};
        memcpy(nm, e.name, GIR_NAME_LEN);
        printf("  [%u] %-30s -> fn %u\n", i, nm, e.fn_idx);
    }

    printf("\nfunctions:\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.n_functions; i++) {
        gir_fn_header fh; memcpy(&fh, buf + pos, sizeof(fh)); pos += sizeof(fh);
        printf("  [%u] regs=%u args=%u returns=%u stack_slots=%u insns=%u\n",
               i, fh.n_regs, fh.n_args, fh.returns, fh.stack_slots, fh.n_insns);
        pos += (size_t)fh.n_insns * sizeof(gir_insn);
    }

    printf("\ndata:\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.n_data; i++) {
        gir_data_header dh; memcpy(&dh, buf + pos, sizeof(dh)); pos += sizeof(dh);
        printf("  [%u] offset=%u length=%u\n", i, dh.offset, dh.length);
        pos += dh.length;
    }

    printf("\nftable:\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.n_ftable; i++) {
        uint32_t f; memcpy(&f, buf + pos, 4); pos += 4;
        printf("  [%u] -> fn %u\n", i, f);
    }

    printf("\nseh:\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.n_seh; i++) {
        gir_seh_scope s; memcpy(&s, buf + pos, sizeof(s)); pos += sizeof(s);
        printf("  [%u] fn=%u insns[%u..%u) handler=fn%u kind=%s\n",
               i, s.fn_idx, s.begin_insn, s.end_insn, s.handler_fn,
               s.kind == GIR_SEH_EXCEPT ? "except" : (s.kind == GIR_SEH_FINALLY ? "finally" : "?"));
    }

    printf("\ntotal bytes consumed = %zu / %zu\n", pos, sz);
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}

```

```txt
    add_executable("Test${test}" "tests/${test}.cpp")

    set_target_properties("Test${test}" PROPERTIES
        LANGUAGE CXX
        CXX_STANDARD 17
        CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF
        CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        FOLDER "Tests"
    )
    target_compile_definitions("Test${test}" PRIVATE "_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS")
    zyan_maybe_enable_wpo("Test${test}")
    add_test("${test}" "Test${test}")
endfunction ()

    enable_testing()
```

`tools/gvmlift/deps/zycore/README.md`:

```md
# Zyan Core Library for C

<a href="./LICENSE"><img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg" alt="License: MIT"></a>
<a href="https://github.com/zyantific/zycore-c/actions"><img src="https://github.com/zyantific/zycore-c/workflows/GitHub%20Actions%20CI/badge.svg" alt="GitHub Actions"></a>
<a href="https://discord.zyantific.com/"><img src="https://img.shields.io/discord/390136917779415060.svg?logo=discord&label=Discord" alt="Discord"></a>

Internal library providing platform independent types, macros and a fallback for environments without LibC.

## Features

- Platform independent types
  - Integer types (`ZyanU8`, `ZyanI32`, `ZyanUSize`, ...)
  - `ZyanBool` (+ `ZYAN_FALSE`, `ZYAN_TRUE`)
  - `ZYAN_NULL`
- Macros
  - Compiler/Platform/Architecture detection
  - Asserts and static asserts
  - Utils (`ARRAY_LENGTH`, `FALLTHROUGH`, `UNUSED`, ...)
- Common types
  - `ZyanBitset`
  - `ZyanString`/`ZyanStringView`
- Container types
  - `ZyanVector`
  - `ZyanList`
- LibC abstraction (WiP)

## License

Zycore is licensed under the MIT license.
```

`tools/gvmlift/deps/zycore/cmake/zyan-functions.cmake`:

```cmake
# =============================================================================================== #
# Exported functions                                                                              #
# =============================================================================================== #

function (zyan_set_common_flags target)
    if (MSVC)
        # MSVC support for C11 is still pretty lacking, so we instead just disable the warnings
        # about using non-standard C extensions.
        target_compile_options("${target}" PUBLIC "/wd4201")
    else ()
        # For the more civilized compilers, we go with C11.
        set_target_properties("${target}" PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11)
    endif ()

    if (ZYAN_DEV_MODE)
        # If in developer mode, be pedantic.
        if (MSVC)
            target_compile_options("${target}" PUBLIC "/WX" "/W4")
        else ()
            target_compile_options("${target}" PUBLIC "-Wall" "-pedantic" "-Wextra" "-Werror")
        endif ()
    endif ()
endfunction ()

function (zyan_set_source_group target)
    if (ZYAN_DEV_MODE)
        if (((CMAKE_MAJOR_VERSION GREATER 3) OR (CMAKE_MAJOR_VERSION EQUAL 3)) AND
            ((CMAKE_MINOR_VERSION GREATER 8) OR (CMAKE_MINOR_VERSION EQUAL 8)))
            # Mirror directory structure in project files
            get_property("TARGET_SOURCE_FILES" TARGET "${target}" PROPERTY SOURCES)
            source_group(TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" FILES ${TARGET_SOURCE_FILES})
        endif ()
    endif ()
endfunction ()

function (zyan_maybe_enable_wpo target)
    if (ZYAN_WHOLE_PROGRAM_OPTIMIZATION)
        set_property(TARGET "${target}" PROPERTY INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)
    endif ()
endfunction ()

# deprecated alias for `zyan_maybe_enable_wpo`, for backward compatibility.
function (zyan_maybe_enable_wpo_for_lib target)
    zyan_maybe_enable_wpo("${target}")
endfunction ()
```

```c
/***************************************************************************************************

  Zyan Core Library (Zycore-C)

  Original Author : Florian Bernd

 * Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
 * of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
 * in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
 * to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
 * copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
 * furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:
 *
 * The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all
 * copies or substantial portions of the Software.
 *
 * THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
 * IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
 * FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
 * AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
 * LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
 * OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
 * SOFTWARE.

***************************************************************************************************/

/**
 * @file
 * Demonstrates the `String` implementation.
 */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <Zycore/Allocator.h>
#include <Zycore/Defines.h>
#include <Zycore/LibC.h>
#include <Zycore/String.h>
#include <Zycore/Types.h>

/* ============================================================================================== */
/* Enums and types                                                                                */
/* ============================================================================================== */


/* ============================================================================================== */
/* Helper functions                                                                               */
/* ============================================================================================== */

static ZyanStatus PrintString(ZyanString* string) {
    const char* cstring;
    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringGetData(string, &cstring));

    printf("(*ZyanString)%p = %s\n", (void*)string, cstring);

    return ZYAN_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/* ============================================================================================== */
/* Tests                                                                                          */
/* ============================================================================================== */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Basic tests                                                                                    */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * Performs some basic test on the given `ZyanString` instance.
 *
 * @param   string  A pointer to the `ZyanString` instance.
 *
 * @return  A zyan status code.
 */
static ZyanStatus PerformBasicTests(ZyanString* string) {
    ZYAN_ASSERT(string);

    ZyanUSize size;
    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringGetSize(string, &size));

    ZyanStringView view1 = ZYAN_DEFINE_STRING_VIEW("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog");
    ZyanStringView view2 = ZYAN_DEFINE_STRING_VIEW("big ");

    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringAppend(string, &view1));
    PrintString(string);

    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringInsert(string, 4, &view2));
    PrintString(string);

    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringSetChar(string, 7, ','));
    PrintString(string);

    return ZYAN_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/**
 * Performs basic tests on a string that dynamically manages memory.
 *
 * @return  A zyan status code.
 */
static ZyanStatus TestDynamic(void) {
    ZyanString string;

    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringInit(&string, 10));

    ZYAN_CHECK(PerformBasicTests(&string));

    return ZyanStringDestroy(&string);
}

/**
 * Performs basic tests on a string that uses a static buffer.
 *
 * @return  A zyan status code.
 */
static ZyanStatus TestStatic(void) {
    static char buffer[50];
    ZyanString string;

    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringInitCustomBuffer(&string, buffer, sizeof(buffer)));

    ZYAN_CHECK(PerformBasicTests(&string));

    return ZyanStringDestroy(&string);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Custom allocator                                                                               */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static ZyanStatus AllocatorAllocate(
    ZyanAllocator* allocator, void** p, ZyanUSize element_size, ZyanUSize n) {
    ZYAN_ASSERT(allocator);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(p);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(element_size);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(n);

    ZYAN_UNUSED(allocator);

    *p = ZYAN_MALLOC(element_size * n);
    if (!*p) {
        return ZYAN_STATUS_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
    }

    return ZYAN_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

static ZyanStatus AllocatorReallocate(
    ZyanAllocator* allocator, void** p, ZyanUSize element_size, ZyanUSize n) {
    ZYAN_ASSERT(allocator);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(p);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(element_size);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(n);

    ZYAN_UNUSED(allocator);

    void* const x = ZYAN_REALLOC(*p, element_size * n);
    if (!x) {
        return ZYAN_STATUS_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
    }
    *p = x;

    return ZYAN_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

static ZyanStatus AllocatorDeallocate(
    ZyanAllocator* allocator, void* p, ZyanUSize element_size, ZyanUSize n) {
    ZYAN_ASSERT(allocator);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(p);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(element_size);
    ZYAN_ASSERT(n);

    ZYAN_UNUSED(allocator);
    ZYAN_UNUSED(element_size);
    ZYAN_UNUSED(n);

    ZYAN_FREE(p);

    return ZYAN_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * Performs basic tests on a vector that dynamically manages memory using a custom
 * allocator and modified growth-factor/shrink-threshold.
 *
 * @return  A zyan status code.
 */
static ZyanStatus TestAllocator(void) {
    ZyanAllocator allocator;
    ZYAN_CHECK(
        ZyanAllocatorInit(&allocator, AllocatorAllocate, AllocatorReallocate, AllocatorDeallocate));

    ZyanString string;
    ZYAN_CHECK(ZyanStringInitEx(&string, 20, &allocator, 10, 0));

    ZYAN_CHECK(PerformBasicTests(&string));

    return ZyanStringDestroy(&string);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* ============================================================================================== */
/* Entry point                                                                                    */
/* ============================================================================================== */

int main(void) {
    if (!ZYAN_SUCCESS(TestDynamic())) {
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (!ZYAN_SUCCESS(TestStatic())) {
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (!ZYAN_SUCCESS(TestAllocator())) {
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

/* ============================================================================================== */

```
