`tools/gvmlift/lift.c`:

```c
/* lift.c - x86-64 -> GIR lifting.
 *
 * pipeline per pe function:
 *   1. CFG walker: BFS from the .pdata BeginAddress, following every
 *      branch target and CALL fallthrough. every reachable RVA emits GIR
 *      exactly once and gets a RVA -> gir-index entry in the fixup map.
 *   2. instruction lift: each x86 op emits one or more GIR insns. flag-
 *      writing arith uses the *_F variants targeting the packed flags reg
 *      GIR_REG_FLAGS. cmovcc/setcc/jcc read the flag reg via a CC code.
 *   3. IAT thunk resolution: CALL rel32 whose target is a JMP [rip+disp]
 *      lands on an import trampoline; the lifter follows the disp to the
 *      IAT slot and looks up the import name; if the driver's host table
 *      knows that name (or wants to expose it), the CALL becomes a
 *      HOST_CALL with argc taken from the calling convention (v1: assumes
 *      up to 4 register args following Windows x64 ABI).
 *   4. branch fixups: after the function is fully lifted, all recorded
 *      branch/jcc placeholders get patched to their target insn indices.
 *
 * register convention (from shared/gir_format.h):
 *   r0..r15 = x86 GPRs; r16 = packed EFLAGS; r17..r24 = temporaries;
 *   r25 = FS base, r26 = GS base; r32+ = xmm pairs.
 */
#include "gvmlift.h"

extern int dx_decode(const uint8_t* bytes, uint32_t rem, uint32_t rva, void* out);

typedef enum {
    DX_UNKNOWN=0, DX_NOP, DX_INT3, DX_HLT, DX_ENDBR64,
    DX_MOV_RR, DX_MOV_RI, DX_MOV_MR, DX_MOV_RM, DX_MOV_MI,
    DX_MOVZX_R, DX_MOVSX_R, DX_MOVSXD_R,
    DX_ADD_RR, DX_ADD_RI, DX_ADD_RM,
    DX_SUB_RR, DX_SUB_RI, DX_SUB_RM,
    DX_AND_RR, DX_AND_RI, DX_AND_RM,
    DX_OR_RR,  DX_OR_RI,  DX_OR_RM,
    DX_XOR_RR, DX_XOR_RI, DX_XOR_RM,
    DX_ADC_RR, DX_ADC_RI,
    DX_SBB_RR, DX_SBB_RI,
    DX_CMP_RR, DX_CMP_RI, DX_CMP_RM,
    DX_TEST_RR, DX_TEST_RI,
    DX_INC_R, DX_DEC_R, DX_NEG_R, DX_NOT_R,
    DX_LEA,
    DX_MUL_R, DX_IMUL_R, DX_DIV_R, DX_IDIV_R,
    DX_IMUL_RR, DX_IMUL_RRI,
    DX_SHL_R1, DX_SHL_RCL, DX_SHL_RI,
    DX_SHR_R1, DX_SHR_RCL, DX_SHR_RI,
    DX_SAR_R1, DX_SAR_RCL, DX_SAR_RI,
    DX_ROL_RI, DX_ROR_RI, DX_ROL_RCL, DX_ROR_RCL,
    DX_PUSH_R, DX_POP_R, DX_PUSH_I,
    DX_CALL_REL, DX_CALL_IND, DX_JMP_REL, DX_JMP_IND, DX_JCC_REL,
    DX_RET, DX_RET_IMM,
    DX_CDQE, DX_CDQ, DX_CQO,
    DX_XCHG_RR, DX_XADD, DX_CMPXCHG,
    DX_BT, DX_BTS, DX_BTR, DX_BTC,
    DX_BSF, DX_BSR, DX_BSWAP,
    DX_POPCNT, DX_LZCNT, DX_TZCNT,
    DX_CMOVCC, DX_SETCC
} dx_kind;

typedef enum {
    DX_CC_O=0, DX_CC_NO, DX_CC_B, DX_CC_AE, DX_CC_E, DX_CC_NE, DX_CC_BE, DX_CC_A,
    DX_CC_S,   DX_CC_NS, DX_CC_P, DX_CC_NP, DX_CC_L, DX_CC_GE, DX_CC_LE, DX_CC_G
} dx_cc;

typedef struct {
    dx_kind  kind;
    dx_cc    cc;
    uint8_t  op_size, src_size, reg, rm_reg, base, index, scale, mem;
    uint8_t  has_lock, has_rep;
    int32_t  disp;
    int64_t  imm;
    uint32_t src_len;
    uint32_t src_rva;
} dx_insn_t;

#define R_FLAGS   16
#define R_TMP0    17
#define R_TMP1    18
#define R_TMP2    19
#define R_TMP3    20

#define N_LIFT_REGS 64

static void
grow_insns(lift_func* f, uint32_t need)
{
    while (f->n_insns + need > f->cap_insns) {
        f->cap_insns = f->cap_insns ? f->cap_insns * 2 : 128;
        f->insns = realloc(f->insns, f->cap_insns * sizeof(gir_insn));
    }
}

static void
emit(lift_func* f, uint16_t op, uint16_t dst, uint16_t s1, uint16_t s2, uint64_t imm)
{
    grow_insns(f, 1);
    gir_insn* in = &f->insns[f->n_insns++];
    in->op = op; in->dst = dst; in->src1 = s1; in->src2 = s2; in->imm = imm;
}

typedef struct {
    uint32_t rva;
    uint32_t insn;
} rva_map_ent;

typedef struct {
    rva_map_ent* map;
    uint32_t     n, cap;
    uint32_t*    worklist;
    uint32_t     wl_n, wl_cap;
    struct {
        uint32_t insn_i;
        uint32_t target_rva;
    }* fixups;
    uint32_t     n_fix, cap_fix;
} lift_pass;

static void
add_map(lift_pass* p, uint32_t rva, uint32_t insn)
{
    if (p->n >= p->cap) { p->cap = p->cap ? p->cap * 2 : 128; p->map = realloc(p->map, p->cap * sizeof(rva_map_ent)); }
    p->map[p->n].rva = rva; p->map[p->n].insn = insn; p->n++;
}
static int
find_map(lift_pass* p, uint32_t rva)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n; i++) if (p->map[i].rva == rva) return (int)p->map[i].insn;
    return -1;
}
static void
add_worklist(lift_pass* p, uint32_t rva)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->wl_n; i++) if (p->worklist[i] == rva) return;
    if (find_map(p, rva) >= 0) return;
    if (p->wl_n >= p->wl_cap) { p->wl_cap = p->wl_cap ? p->wl_cap * 2 : 32; p->worklist = realloc(p->worklist, p->wl_cap * sizeof(uint32_t)); }
    p->worklist[p->wl_n++] = rva;
}
static uint32_t
pop_worklist(lift_pass* p)
{
    if (p->wl_n == 0) return 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    return p->worklist[--p->wl_n];
}
static void
add_fix(lift_pass* p, uint32_t insn_i, uint32_t target)
{
    if (p->n_fix >= p->cap_fix) { p->cap_fix = p->cap_fix ? p->cap_fix * 2 : 32; p->fixups = realloc(p->fixups, p->cap_fix * sizeof(p->fixups[0])); }
    p->fixups[p->n_fix].insn_i = insn_i;
    p->fixups[p->n_fix].target_rva = target;
    p->n_fix++;
}

/* try to detect an IAT thunk: at target_rva, do we see FF 25 disp32? if so
 * return the RVA of the IAT entry (the pointer table slot). caller then
 * cross-references against pe->imports to find the name. */
static int
detect_iat_thunk(const pe_image* pe, uint32_t target_rva, uint32_t* out_iat_rva)
{
    const uint8_t* p = pe_ptr(pe, target_rva);
    if (!p) return 0;
    /* rex prefix optional before FF 25 */
    uint32_t o = 0;
    if ((p[0] & 0xF0) == 0x40) o = 1;
    if (p[o] != 0xFF || p[o + 1] != 0x25) return 0;
    int32_t disp; memcpy(&disp, p + o + 2, 4);
    uint32_t next = target_rva + o + 2 + 4;
    *out_iat_rva = (uint32_t)((int64_t)next + disp);
    return 1;
}

static const char*
find_import_by_iat(const pe_image* pe, uint32_t iat_rva)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pe->n_imports; i++) if (pe->imports[i].iat_rva == iat_rva) return pe->imports[i].name;
    return NULL;
}

/* import-name -> host-import table shared with the driver runtime. we hold
 * a small local mapping so the lifter knows which imports to expose as
 * HOST_CALLs. everything else falls back to CALL_ABS_KVA at runtime. */
typedef struct {
    const char* nt_name;      /* export from ntoskrnl / hal etc. */
    const char* host_name;    /* corresponding gexec host import name */
    uint8_t     argc;
    uint8_t     returns;
} import_map;

static const import_map g_import_map[] = {
    { "MmIsAddressValid",       "k.probe",       2, 1 },   /* addr, len */
    { "KeGetCurrentIrql",       "irql.get",      0, 1 },
    { "PsGetCurrentProcessId",  "proc.pid",      0, 1 },
    { "PsGetCurrentThreadId",   "proc.tid",      0, 1 },
    { "PsGetCurrentProcess",    "proc.eprocess_current", 0, 1 },
    { "PsGetCurrentThread",     "thread.ethread_current", 0, 1 },
    { "PsLookupProcessByProcessId", "proc.by_pid", 1, 1 },
    { "ObfDereferenceObject",   "proc.deref",    1, 0 },
    { "MmGetSystemRoutineAddress", "nt.resolve", 2, 1 },   /* wraps to (name_off, len) */
    { "RtlCopyMemory",          "mem.copy",      3, 0 },
    { "RtlZeroMemory",          "mem.zero",      2, 0 },
    { "RtlFillMemory",          "mem.fill",      3, 0 },
    { "ExAllocatePool2",        "mem.alloc",     1, 1 },
    { "ExFreePoolWithTag",      "mem.free",      1, 0 },
};

static const import_map*
find_import_map(const char* name)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(g_import_map) / sizeof(g_import_map[0]); i++) if (strcmp(g_import_map[i].nt_name, name) == 0) return &g_import_map[i];
    return NULL;
}

/* lifter helpers */

static uint16_t
size_op(uint16_t base_op, uint8_t size)
{
    /* many arith ops come in _I32 / _I64 pairs contiguous in the enum. */
    return (size == 8) ? (uint16_t)(base_op + 1) : base_op;
}

static void
lift_flag_binop(lift_func* f, uint16_t base_op_i32, uint8_t reg, uint8_t rhs_reg, uint8_t size)
{
    uint16_t op = size_op(base_op_i32, size);
    emit(f, op, reg, reg, rhs_reg, R_FLAGS);
}

static void
lift_flag_binop_imm(lift_func* f, uint16_t base_op_i32, uint8_t reg, int64_t imm, uint8_t size)
{
    /* materialize imm into a scratch reg then use the flag-writing form. */
    emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)imm);
    uint16_t op = size_op(base_op_i32, size);
    emit(f, op, reg, reg, R_TMP0, R_FLAGS);
}

/* single-op lift: returns 0 on success, -1 to signal control-flow terminator
 * (the block's basic block ends here so the walker stops advancing). */
static int
lift_one(const pe_image* pe, lift_func* f, const dx_insn_t* dx, lift_pass* pass, int32_t rip_next_rva)
{
    switch (dx->kind) {
    case DX_NOP: case DX_ENDBR64:
        emit(f, GIR_NOP, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    case DX_INT3:
        emit(f, GIR_INT3, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    case DX_HLT:
        emit(f, GIR_HALT, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return -1;

    case DX_MOV_RR:
        emit(f, GIR_MOV, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_MOV_RI:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_CONST_I64 : GIR_CONST_I32, dx->reg, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm);
        return 0;

    case DX_MOVZX_R:
        if (dx->src_size == 1)      emit(f, GIR_EXTEND_I8_U,  dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        else                        emit(f, GIR_EXTEND_I16_U, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    case DX_MOVSX_R:
        if (dx->src_size == 1)      emit(f, GIR_EXTEND_I8_S,  dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        else                        emit(f, GIR_EXTEND_I16_S, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    case DX_MOVSXD_R:
        emit(f, GIR_EXTEND_I32_S, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_ADD_RR: lift_flag_binop(f, GIR_ADD_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_SUB_RR: lift_flag_binop(f, GIR_SUB_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_AND_RR: lift_flag_binop(f, GIR_AND_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_OR_RR:  lift_flag_binop(f, GIR_OR_F_I32,  dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_XOR_RR: lift_flag_binop(f, GIR_XOR_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, dx->op_size); return 0;

    case DX_ADD_RI: lift_flag_binop_imm(f, GIR_ADD_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->imm, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_SUB_RI: lift_flag_binop_imm(f, GIR_SUB_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->imm, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_AND_RI: lift_flag_binop_imm(f, GIR_AND_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->imm, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_OR_RI:  lift_flag_binop_imm(f, GIR_OR_F_I32,  dx->reg, dx->imm, dx->op_size); return 0;
    case DX_XOR_RI: lift_flag_binop_imm(f, GIR_XOR_F_I32, dx->reg, dx->imm, dx->op_size); return 0;

    case DX_CMP_RR:
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_CMP_F_I32, dx->op_size), 0, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_CMP_RI:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm);
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_CMP_F_I32, dx->op_size), 0, dx->reg, R_TMP0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_TEST_RR:
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_TEST_F_I32, dx->op_size), 0, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_TEST_RI:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm);
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_TEST_F_I32, dx->op_size), 0, dx->reg, R_TMP0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;

    case DX_INC_R:
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_INC_F_I32, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, 0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_DEC_R:
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_DEC_F_I32, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, 0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_NEG_R:
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_NEG_F_I32, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, 0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_NOT_R:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_NOT_I64 : GIR_NOT_I32, dx->reg, dx->reg, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_SHL_RI: case DX_SHL_R1:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)(dx->kind == DX_SHL_R1 ? 1 : dx->imm));
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_SHL_F_I32, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, R_TMP0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_SHR_RI: case DX_SHR_R1:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)(dx->kind == DX_SHR_R1 ? 1 : dx->imm));
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_SHR_U_F_I32, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, R_TMP0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_SAR_RI: case DX_SAR_R1:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)(dx->kind == DX_SAR_R1 ? 1 : dx->imm));
        emit(f, size_op(GIR_SHR_S_F_I32, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, R_TMP0, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    case DX_SHL_RCL: case DX_SHR_RCL: case DX_SAR_RCL: {
        uint16_t base = (dx->kind == DX_SHL_RCL) ? GIR_SHL_F_I32 :
                        (dx->kind == DX_SHR_RCL) ? GIR_SHR_U_F_I32 : GIR_SHR_S_F_I32;
        emit(f, size_op(base, dx->op_size), dx->reg, dx->reg, 1 /* CL is low byte of RCX = r1 */, R_FLAGS);
        return 0;
    }
    case DX_ROL_RI: emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_ROTL_I64 : GIR_ROTL_I32, dx->reg, dx->reg, R_TMP0, 0);
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm); return 0;
    case DX_ROR_RI: emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_ROTR_I64 : GIR_ROTR_I32, dx->reg, dx->reg, R_TMP0, 0);
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm); return 0;

    case DX_LEA:
        if (dx->base == 0xFE) {
            emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, dx->reg, 0, 0, (uint64_t)((int64_t)rip_next_rva + dx->disp));
        } else if (dx->base != 0xFF && dx->index == 0xFF) {
            emit(f, GIR_ADD_IMM_I64, dx->reg, dx->base, 0, (uint64_t)(int64_t)dx->disp);
        } else if (dx->base != 0xFF && dx->index != 0xFF) {
            /* base + index*scale + disp */
            uint8_t sc = dx->scale == 1 ? 0 : dx->scale == 2 ? 1 : dx->scale == 4 ? 2 : 3;
            emit(f, GIR_SHL_IMM_I64, R_TMP0, dx->index, 0, sc);
            emit(f, GIR_ADD_I64, R_TMP0, R_TMP0, dx->base, 0);
            emit(f, GIR_ADD_IMM_I64, dx->reg, R_TMP0, 0, (uint64_t)(int64_t)dx->disp);
        } else {
            emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, dx->reg, 0, 0, (uint64_t)(int64_t)dx->disp);
        }
        return 0;

    case DX_MOV_RM: {
        if (dx->base == 0xFE) {
            uint64_t abs = (uint64_t)((int64_t)rip_next_rva + dx->disp);
            emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, abs);
            emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_LOAD_I64 : GIR_LOAD_I32_U, dx->reg, R_TMP0, 0, 0);
        } else if (dx->base != 0xFF && dx->index == 0xFF) {
            emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_LOAD_I64 : GIR_LOAD_I32_U, dx->reg, dx->base, 0, (uint64_t)(int64_t)dx->disp);
        } else if (dx->base != 0xFF && dx->index != 0xFF) {
            uint8_t sc = dx->scale == 1 ? 0 : dx->scale == 2 ? 1 : dx->scale == 4 ? 2 : 3;
            uint64_t imm = (uint32_t)dx->disp | ((uint64_t)dx->index << 32) | ((uint64_t)sc << 40);
            emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_LOAD_IDX_I64 : GIR_LOAD_IDX_I32_U, dx->reg, dx->base, 0, imm);
        } else {
            emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case DX_MOV_MR: {
        if (dx->base == 0xFE) {
            uint64_t abs = (uint64_t)((int64_t)rip_next_rva + dx->disp);
            emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, abs);
            emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_STORE_I64 : GIR_STORE_I32, 0, R_TMP0, dx->reg, 0);
        } else if (dx->base != 0xFF && dx->index == 0xFF) {
            emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_STORE_I64 : GIR_STORE_I32, 0, dx->base, dx->reg, (uint64_t)(int64_t)dx->disp);
        } else if (dx->base != 0xFF && dx->index != 0xFF) {
            uint8_t sc = dx->scale == 1 ? 0 : dx->scale == 2 ? 1 : dx->scale == 4 ? 2 : 3;
            uint64_t imm = (uint32_t)dx->disp | ((uint64_t)dx->index << 32) | ((uint64_t)sc << 40);
            emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_STORE_IDX_I64 : GIR_STORE_IDX_I32, 0, dx->base, dx->reg, imm);
        } else emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    }
    case DX_MOV_MI:
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);   /* store-immediate: needs materialize + store, skipped for v1 */
        return 0;

    case DX_PUSH_R: emit(f, GIR_STACK_PUSH, 0, dx->reg, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_POP_R:  emit(f, GIR_STACK_POP,  dx->reg, 0, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_PUSH_I:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm);
        emit(f, GIR_STACK_PUSH, 0, R_TMP0, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_JMP_REL: {
        uint32_t target = (uint32_t)((int64_t)rip_next_rva + dx->disp);
        add_worklist(pass, target);
        add_fix(pass, f->n_insns, target);
        emit(f, GIR_BR, 0, 0, 0, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
        return -1;   /* terminator */
    }
    case DX_JCC_REL: {
        uint32_t target = (uint32_t)((int64_t)rip_next_rva + dx->disp);
        add_worklist(pass, target);
        add_worklist(pass, rip_next_rva);   /* fallthrough */
        add_fix(pass, f->n_insns, target);
        emit(f, GIR_JCC, (uint16_t)dx->cc, R_FLAGS, 0, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
        return 0;
    }
    case DX_CMOVCC:
        /* dst = cc(flags) ? rm_reg : dst - but current cmov reads src2 as source when cc true. */
        emit(f, GIR_CMOV, dx->reg, R_FLAGS, dx->rm_reg, (uint64_t)dx->cc);
        return 0;
    case DX_SETCC:
        emit(f, GIR_SETCC, dx->reg, R_FLAGS, (uint16_t)dx->cc, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_CALL_REL: {
        uint32_t target = (uint32_t)((int64_t)rip_next_rva + dx->disp);
        uint32_t iat_rva;
        if (detect_iat_thunk(pe, target, &iat_rva)) {
            const char* nt_name = find_import_by_iat(pe, iat_rva);
            if (nt_name) {
                const import_map* im = find_import_map(nt_name);
                if (im) {
                    /* HOST_CALL: dst = rax(r0), name -> imm (we stash raw import
                     * index; the emitter will need to add this import). for now
                     * mark with UNREACHABLE + comment; a follow-up pass would
                     * grow lift_unit with an imports list and rewrite here. */
                    (void)im;
                    emit(f, GIR_NOP, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }
        /* internal call: link across functions handled by lift_pe. for now
         * emit an UNREACHABLE placeholder so verifier rejects unhandled
         * intra-module calls until we wire them. */
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    }
    case DX_JMP_IND:
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return -1;
    case DX_CALL_IND:
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_RET: case DX_RET_IMM:
        emit(f, GIR_RETURN, 0, 0, 0, 0);   /* returns rax by convention (reg 0) */
        return -1;

    case DX_CDQE:
        emit(f, GIR_EXTEND_I32_S, 0, 0, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_CDQ:
        /* edx:eax = sign-extended eax. we set edx = sar(eax, 31). */
        emit(f, GIR_SHR_S_IMM_I64, 2, 0, 0, 31); return 0;
    case DX_CQO:
        emit(f, GIR_SHR_S_IMM_I64, 2, 0, 0, 63); return 0;

    case DX_BSWAP:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_BSWAP_I64 : GIR_BSWAP_I32, dx->reg, dx->reg, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_BSF:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_BSF_I64 : GIR_BSF_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_BSR:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_BSR_I64 : GIR_BSR_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_POPCNT:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_POPCNT_I64 : GIR_POPCNT_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0); return 0;
    case DX_BT:  emit(f, GIR_BT_I64,  R_TMP0, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0); return 0;
    case DX_BTS: emit(f, GIR_BTS_I64, R_TMP0, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0); return 0;
    case DX_BTR: emit(f, GIR_BTR_I64, R_TMP0, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0); return 0;
    case DX_BTC: emit(f, GIR_BTC_I64, R_TMP0, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0); return 0;

    case DX_XCHG_RR:
        emit(f, GIR_MOV, R_TMP0, dx->reg, 0, 0);
        emit(f, GIR_MOV, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0, 0);
        emit(f, GIR_MOV, dx->rm_reg, R_TMP0, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_IMUL_RR:
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_MUL_I64 : GIR_MUL_I32, dx->reg, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, 0);
        return 0;
    case DX_IMUL_RRI:
        emit(f, GIR_CONST_I64, R_TMP0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)dx->imm);
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_MUL_I64 : GIR_MUL_I32, dx->reg, dx->rm_reg, R_TMP0, 0);
        return 0;
    case DX_MUL_R:  case DX_IMUL_R: case DX_DIV_R: case DX_IDIV_R:
        /* single-operand mul/div use implicit rax:rdx pair. modeled as
         * rax = rax * r/m for MUL (low half only, no rdx update for v1). */
        emit(f, dx->op_size == 8 ? GIR_MUL_I64 : GIR_MUL_I32, 0, 0, dx->rm_reg, 0);
        return 0;

    case DX_XADD:
    case DX_CMPXCHG:
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;

    default:
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    }
}

static void
lift_one_function(const pe_image* pe, lift_func* f)
{
    lift_pass pass = { 0 };
    add_worklist(&pass, f->src_begin_rva);

    while (pass.wl_n > 0) {
        uint32_t rva = pop_worklist(&pass);
        if (find_map(&pass, rva) >= 0) continue;
        /* stay within the function */
        if (rva < f->src_begin_rva || rva >= f->src_end_rva) continue;

        /* lift a straight-line block starting at rva */
        while (rva < f->src_end_rva) {
            if (find_map(&pass, rva) >= 0) {
                /* already lifted; emit a BR to that point */
                int t = find_map(&pass, rva);
                add_fix(&pass, f->n_insns, rva);
                emit(f, GIR_BR, 0, 0, 0, (uint64_t)t);
                break;
            }
            const uint8_t* p = pe_ptr(pe, rva);
            if (!p) { emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0); break; }
            dx_insn_t dx;
            if (dx_decode(p, f->src_end_rva - rva, rva, &dx) < 0) { emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0); break; }
            if (dx.src_len == 0) { emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0); break; }
            add_map(&pass, rva, f->n_insns);
            int term = lift_one(pe, f, &dx, &pass, rva + dx.src_len);
            rva += dx.src_len;
            if (term < 0) break;
        }
    }

    /* ensure last emitted insn terminates. */
    if (f->n_insns == 0 || (f->insns[f->n_insns - 1].op != GIR_RETURN &&
                            f->insns[f->n_insns - 1].op != GIR_BR &&
                            f->insns[f->n_insns - 1].op != GIR_UNREACHABLE &&
                            f->insns[f->n_insns - 1].op != GIR_TRAP &&
                            f->insns[f->n_insns - 1].op != GIR_HALT)) {
        emit(f, GIR_UNREACHABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    /* patch branch fixups. any target we never lifted becomes UNREACHABLE
     * so the verifier accepts the module and the specific code path traps
     * only if actually executed. */
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < pass.n_fix; k++) {
        int t = find_map(&pass, pass.fixups[k].target_rva);
        gir_insn* in = &f->insns[pass.fixups[k].insn_i];
        if (t >= 0) {
            in->imm = (uint64_t)t;
        } else {
            in->op   = GIR_UNREACHABLE;
            in->dst  = 0;
            in->src1 = 0;
            in->src2 = 0;
            in->imm  = 0;
        }
    }

    free(pass.map); free(pass.worklist); free(pass.fixups);

    f->n_regs  = N_LIFT_REGS;
    f->n_args  = 4;   /* windows x64 abi: rcx, rdx, r8, r9 */
    f->returns = 1;
}

int
lift_pe(const pe_image* pe, lift_unit* out)
{
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    out->cap_funcs = pe->n_pdata ? pe->n_pdata : 1;
    out->funcs = calloc(out->cap_funcs, sizeof(lift_func));

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pe->n_pdata; i++) {
        lift_func* f = &out->funcs[out->n_funcs++];
        f->src_begin_rva = pe->pdata[i].begin_rva;
        f->src_end_rva   = pe->pdata[i].end_rva;
        snprintf(f->name, sizeof(f->name), "fn_%08x", f->src_begin_rva);
        lift_one_function(pe, f);
    }
    return 0;
}

void
lift_free(lift_unit* u)
{
    if (!u) return;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < u->n_funcs; i++) if (u->funcs[i].insns) free(u->funcs[i].insns);
    free(u->funcs);
    memset(u, 0, sizeof(*u));
}
```

`tools/gvmlift/main.c`:

```c
/* main.c - gvmlift cli.
 * usage: gvmlift input.sys -o output.gmod
 */
#include "gvmlift.h"

int
main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    const char* in = NULL;
    const char* out = "out.gmod";
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) { out = argv[++i]; continue; }
        if (argv[i][0] == '-') { fprintf(stderr, "unknown flag %s\n", argv[i]); return 1; }
        in = argv[i];
    }
    if (!in) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gvmlift input.sys -o output.gmod\n"); return 1; }

    pe_image pe = { 0 };
    int r = pe_load(in, &pe);
    if (r < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "pe_load failed: %d\n", r); return 2; }

    fprintf(stderr, "gvmlift: %s -> %u sections, %u pdata entries, %u imports\n",
            in, pe.n_sections, pe.n_pdata, pe.n_imports);

    lift_unit u = { 0 };
    if (lift_pe(&pe, &u) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "lift failed\n"); return 3; }

    if (emit_gmod(&u, out) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "emit failed\n"); return 4; }

    lift_free(&u);
    pe_free(&pe);
    return 0;
}

```

`tools/gvmlift/pe.c`:

```c
/* pe.c - self-contained PE64 loader for driver binaries.
 * reads a .sys file into memory, maps sections into a virtual layout at
 * their RVAs, and extracts the pieces the lifter needs: sections, the
 * exception directory (.pdata function table), and the import descriptors.
 * relocations are applied against image_base = 0 so all RVAs stay RVAs. */
#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#include "gvmlift.h"

#pragma pack(push, 1)

typedef struct {
    uint16_t e_magic;
    uint8_t  _pad[58];
    uint32_t e_lfanew;
} dos_hdr;

typedef struct {
    uint16_t Machine;
    uint16_t NumberOfSections;
    uint32_t TimeDateStamp;
    uint32_t PointerToSymbolTable;
    uint32_t NumberOfSymbols;
    uint16_t SizeOfOptionalHeader;
    uint16_t Characteristics;
} coff_hdr;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t VirtualAddress;
    uint32_t Size;
} data_dir;

typedef struct {
    uint16_t Magic;
    uint8_t  MajorLinkerVersion;
    uint8_t  MinorLinkerVersion;
    uint32_t SizeOfCode;
    uint32_t SizeOfInitializedData;
    uint32_t SizeOfUninitializedData;
    uint32_t AddressOfEntryPoint;
    uint32_t BaseOfCode;
    uint64_t ImageBase;
    uint32_t SectionAlignment;
    uint32_t FileAlignment;
    uint16_t MajorOperatingSystemVersion;
    uint16_t MinorOperatingSystemVersion;
    uint16_t MajorImageVersion;
    uint16_t MinorImageVersion;
    uint16_t MajorSubsystemVersion;
    uint16_t MinorSubsystemVersion;
    uint32_t Win32VersionValue;
    uint32_t SizeOfImage;
    uint32_t SizeOfHeaders;
    uint32_t CheckSum;
    uint16_t Subsystem;
    uint16_t DllCharacteristics;
    uint64_t SizeOfStackReserve;
    uint64_t SizeOfStackCommit;
    uint64_t SizeOfHeapReserve;
    uint64_t SizeOfHeapCommit;
    uint32_t LoaderFlags;
    uint32_t NumberOfRvaAndSizes;
    data_dir DataDirectory[16];
} opt_hdr64;

typedef struct {
    char     Name[8];
    uint32_t VirtualSize;
    uint32_t VirtualAddress;
    uint32_t SizeOfRawData;
    uint32_t PointerToRawData;
    uint32_t PointerToRelocations;
    uint32_t PointerToLinenumbers;
    uint16_t NumberOfRelocations;
    uint16_t NumberOfLinenumbers;
    uint32_t Characteristics;
} sec_hdr;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t ImportLookupTable;
    uint32_t TimeStamp;
    uint32_t ForwarderChain;
    uint32_t NameRVA;
    uint32_t ImportAddressTable;
} import_desc;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t BeginAddress;
    uint32_t EndAddress;
    uint32_t UnwindInfoAddress;
} runtime_fn;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t VirtualAddress;
    uint32_t SizeOfBlock;
} reloc_block;

#pragma pack(pop)

#define DIR_EXPORT   0
#define DIR_IMPORT   1
#define DIR_EXCEPTION 3
#define DIR_BASERELOC 5

static uint8_t*
read_all(const char* path, size_t* sz)
{
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    if (n <= 0) { fclose(f); return NULL; }
    uint8_t* b = malloc(n);
    if (!b) { fclose(f); return NULL; }
    if ((long)fread(b, 1, n, f) != n) { free(b); fclose(f); return NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    *sz = (size_t)n;
    return b;
}

const pe_section*
pe_section_for_rva(const pe_image* p, uint32_t rva)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n_sections; i++) {
        const pe_section* s = &p->sections[i];
        if (rva >= s->rva && rva < s->rva + s->size) return s;
    }
    return NULL;
}

const uint8_t*
pe_ptr(const pe_image* p, uint32_t rva)
{
    if (rva >= p->image_alloc) return NULL;
    return p->image + rva;
}

static void
apply_relocs(pe_image* p, const uint8_t* file, const opt_hdr64* opt)
{
    /* rewrite based on target base = 0 (image_base = 0). so delta = 0 - opt->ImageBase. */
    int64_t delta = 0 - (int64_t)opt->ImageBase;
    if (opt->NumberOfRvaAndSizes <= DIR_BASERELOC) return;
    uint32_t r_rva  = opt->DataDirectory[DIR_BASERELOC].VirtualAddress;
    uint32_t r_size = opt->DataDirectory[DIR_BASERELOC].Size;
    if (!r_rva || !r_size) return;

    (void)file;
    uint8_t* base = p->image;
    uint32_t off = r_rva;
    uint32_t end = r_rva + r_size;
    while (off + sizeof(reloc_block) <= end) {
        reloc_block b;
        memcpy(&b, base + off, sizeof(b));
        if (b.SizeOfBlock < sizeof(reloc_block)) break;
        uint32_t n = (b.SizeOfBlock - (uint32_t)sizeof(reloc_block)) / 2;
        const uint16_t* entries = (const uint16_t*)(base + off + sizeof(reloc_block));
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            uint16_t e = entries[i];
            uint32_t type = e >> 12;
            uint32_t at   = b.VirtualAddress + (e & 0x0FFF);
            if (type == 0) continue;   /* absolute, no fixup */
            if (type == 10) {          /* IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 */
                uint64_t v;
                memcpy(&v, base + at, 8);
                v = (uint64_t)((int64_t)v + delta);
                memcpy(base + at, &v, 8);
            }
        }
        off += b.SizeOfBlock;
    }
}

int
pe_load(const char* path, pe_image* out)
{
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    size_t fsz = 0;
    uint8_t* file = read_all(path, &fsz);
    if (!file) return -1;

    if (fsz < sizeof(dos_hdr)) { free(file); return -2; }
    dos_hdr* d = (dos_hdr*)file;
    if (d->e_magic != 0x5A4D) { free(file); return -3; }

    uint32_t peoff = d->e_lfanew;
    if (peoff + 4 + sizeof(coff_hdr) + sizeof(opt_hdr64) > fsz) { free(file); return -4; }
    uint32_t sig;
    memcpy(&sig, file + peoff, 4);
    if (sig != 0x00004550) { free(file); return -5; }

    coff_hdr coff;
    memcpy(&coff, file + peoff + 4, sizeof(coff));
    if (coff.Machine != 0x8664) { free(file); return -6; }

    opt_hdr64 opt;
    memcpy(&opt, file + peoff + 4 + sizeof(coff), sizeof(opt));
    if (opt.Magic != 0x20B) { free(file); return -7; }

    out->image_base = 0;   /* rebase to zero */
    out->image_size = opt.SizeOfImage;
    out->entry_rva  = opt.AddressOfEntryPoint;
    out->file       = file;
    out->file_size  = fsz;
    out->image_alloc = opt.SizeOfImage;
    out->image = calloc(1, out->image_alloc);
    if (!out->image) { free(file); return -8; }

    out->n_sections = coff.NumberOfSections;
    out->sections   = calloc(out->n_sections, sizeof(pe_section));

    uint32_t so = peoff + 4 + (uint32_t)sizeof(coff) + coff.SizeOfOptionalHeader;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < out->n_sections; i++) {
        sec_hdr h;
        memcpy(&h, file + so + i * sizeof(sec_hdr), sizeof(h));
        pe_section* s = &out->sections[i];
        s->rva  = h.VirtualAddress;
        s->size = h.VirtualSize;
        s->raw_size = h.SizeOfRawData;
        s->raw = file + h.PointerToRawData;
        s->characteristics = h.Characteristics;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) s->name[k] = h.Name[k];
        s->name[8] = 0;

        uint32_t copy = h.VirtualSize < h.SizeOfRawData ? h.VirtualSize : h.SizeOfRawData;
        if (s->rva + copy <= out->image_alloc && h.PointerToRawData + copy <= fsz)
            memcpy(out->image + s->rva, file + h.PointerToRawData, copy);
    }

    /* copy header bytes 0..SizeOfHeaders into the image for tools that scan headers. */
    if (opt.SizeOfHeaders <= out->image_alloc && opt.SizeOfHeaders <= fsz)
        memcpy(out->image, file, opt.SizeOfHeaders);

    apply_relocs(out, file, &opt);

    /* exception directory -> function table */
    if (opt.NumberOfRvaAndSizes > DIR_EXCEPTION) {
        uint32_t rva = opt.DataDirectory[DIR_EXCEPTION].VirtualAddress;
        uint32_t sz  = opt.DataDirectory[DIR_EXCEPTION].Size;
        if (rva && sz && rva + sz <= out->image_alloc) {
            uint32_t n = sz / (uint32_t)sizeof(runtime_fn);
            out->pdata = calloc(n, sizeof(*out->pdata));
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                runtime_fn rf;
                memcpy(&rf, out->image + rva + i * sizeof(rf), sizeof(rf));
                out->pdata[i].begin_rva  = rf.BeginAddress;
                out->pdata[i].end_rva    = rf.EndAddress;
                out->pdata[i].unwind_rva = rf.UnwindInfoAddress;
            }
            out->n_pdata = n;
        }
    }

    /* import descriptors */
    if (opt.NumberOfRvaAndSizes > DIR_IMPORT) {
        uint32_t rva = opt.DataDirectory[DIR_IMPORT].VirtualAddress;
        if (rva && rva < out->image_alloc) {
            uint32_t cap = 64;
            out->imports = calloc(cap, sizeof(*out->imports));
            uint32_t off = rva;
            for (;;) {
                import_desc id;
                if (off + sizeof(id) > out->image_alloc) break;
                memcpy(&id, out->image + off, sizeof(id));
                if (id.NameRVA == 0 && id.ImportLookupTable == 0) break;
                off += (uint32_t)sizeof(id);

                char dll[64] = {0};
                const uint8_t* np = out->image + id.NameRVA;
                for (int k = 0; k < 63 && np[k]; k++) dll[k] = (char)np[k];

                uint32_t ilt = id.ImportLookupTable ? id.ImportLookupTable : id.ImportAddressTable;
                uint32_t iat = id.ImportAddressTable;
                for (uint32_t k = 0;; k++) {
                    uint64_t entry;
                    memcpy(&entry, out->image + ilt + k * 8, 8);
                    if (entry == 0) break;
                    char name[128] = {0};
                    if ((entry >> 63) & 1) {
                        snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "ordinal_%u", (unsigned)(entry & 0xFFFF));
                    } else {
                        uint32_t hint_rva = (uint32_t)(entry & 0x7FFFFFFF);
                        const uint8_t* nm = out->image + hint_rva + 2;
                        for (int q = 0; q < 127 && nm[q]; q++) name[q] = (char)nm[q];
                    }
                    if (out->n_imports >= cap) { cap *= 2; out->imports = realloc(out->imports, cap * sizeof(*out->imports)); }
                    memcpy(out->imports[out->n_imports].dll, dll, sizeof(dll));
                    memcpy(out->imports[out->n_imports].name, name, sizeof(name));
                    out->imports[out->n_imports].iat_rva = iat + k * 8;
                    out->n_imports++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

void
pe_free(pe_image* p)
{
    if (!p) return;
    if (p->image)    free(p->image);
    if (p->sections) free(p->sections);
    if (p->pdata)    free(p->pdata);
    if (p->imports)  free(p->imports);
    if (p->file)     free((void*)p->file);
    memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
}
```
